rules.title: Shell Invocation via Apt - Linux
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects the use of the "apt" and "apt-get" commands to execute a shell or proxy commands.
Such behavior may be associated with privilege escalation, unauthorized command execution, or to break out from restricted environments.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/apt' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/apt-get' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%APT::Update::Pre-Invoke::=%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Invocation of Shell via AWK - Linux
rules.author: Li Ling, Andy Parkidomo, Robert Rakowski, Blake Hartstein (Bloomberg L.P.)
rules.description:
Detects the execution of "awk" or it's sibling commands, to invoke a shell using the system() function.
This behavior is commonly associated with attempts to execute arbitrary commands or escalate privileges, potentially leading to unauthorized access or further exploitation.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%/awk' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/gawk' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/mawk' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/nawk' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%BEGIN {system%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/bash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/dash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/fish%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/zsh%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Linux Base64 Encoded Pipe to Shell
rules.author: pH-T (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious process command line that uses base64 encoded input for execution with a shell
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%base64 %' ESCAPE '\' AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%| bash %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%| sh %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%|bash %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%|sh %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% |sh' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%| bash' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%| sh' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%|bash' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Linux Base64 Encoded Shebang In CLI
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the presence of a base64 version of the shebang in the commandline, which could indicate a malicious payload about to be decoded
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%IyEvYmluL2Jhc2%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%IyEvYmluL2Rhc2%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%IyEvYmluL3pza%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%IyEvYmluL2Zpc2%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%IyEvYmluL3No%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Enable BPF Kprobes Tracing
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects common command used to enable bpf kprobes tracing
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%echo 1 >%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/sys/kernel/debug/tracing/events/kprobes/%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/myprobe/enable%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/myretprobe/enable%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: BPFtrace Unsafe Option Usage
rules.author: Andreas Hunkeler (@Karneades)
rules.description: Detects the usage of the unsafe bpftrace option
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of the unsafe option
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%bpftrace' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--unsafe%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Capsh Shell Invocation - Linux
rules.author: Li Ling, Andy Parkidomo, Robert Rakowski, Blake Hartstein (Bloomberg L.P.)
rules.description: Detects the use of the "capsh" utility to invoke a shell.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/capsh' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% --' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Remove Immutable File Attribute
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the 'chattr' utility to remove immutable file attribute.
falsepositives: Administrator interacting with immutable files (e.g. for instance backups).
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/chattr' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -i %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Chmod Targeting Sensitive Directories
rules.author: Christopher Peacock @SecurePeacock, SCYTHE @scythe_io
rules.description:
Detects chmod targeting files in sensitive directory paths on Linux systems.
Attackers may use chmod to change permissions of files in these directories to maintain persistence, escalate privileges, or disrupt system operations.
falsepositives: Some false positives are to be expected. Apply additional filters as needed before pushing to production.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/chmod' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/tmp/%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/.Library/%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/etc/%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/opt/%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((CommandLine LIKE '%chmod --reference=/etc/shells%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%/update-shells' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/etc/%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%/var/lib/dpkg/info/%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%.postinst configure%' ESCAPE '\')) OR CommandLine LIKE 'chmod 700 /tmp/apt-key-gpghome.%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE 'chmod 755 /var/tmp/mkinitramfs%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine='chmod 0775 /etc/landscape/' OR CommandLine='chmod 644 /etc/apparmor.d/tunables/home.d/ubuntu'), 0))

rules.title: Linux Logs Clearing Attempts
rules.author: Ömer Günal, oscd.community
rules.description:
Detects logs clearing attempts on Linux systems via utilities such as 'rm', 'rmdir', 'shred', and 'unlink' targeting log files and directories.
Adversaries often try to clear logs to cover their tracks after performing malicious activities.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%/rm' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/rmdir' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/shred' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/unlink' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/var/log%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/var/spool/mail%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((Image LIKE '%/rm' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE 'rm -f /var/log/sysstat/%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%/rm' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE 'rm -f -- /var/log//dmesg%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Syslog Clearing or Removal Via System Utilities
rules.author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems), Roberto Rodriguez (Cyb3rWard0g), OTR (Open Threat Research), MSTIC
rules.description: Detects specific commands commonly used to remove or empty the syslog. Which is a technique often used by attacker as a method to hide their tracks
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%/var/log/syslog%' ESCAPE '\' AND ((Image LIKE '%/rm' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -r %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -f %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -rf %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/var/log/syslog%' ESCAPE '\')) OR Image LIKE '%/unlink' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/mv' ESCAPE '\' OR (Image LIKE '%/truncate' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%0 %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/var/log/syslog%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-s %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--size%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%/ln' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/dev/null %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/var/log/syslog%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-sf %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-sfn %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-sfT %' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%/cp' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/dev/null%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%/shred' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-u %' ESCAPE '\'))) OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% > /var/log/syslog%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% >/var/log/syslog%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% >| /var/log/syslog%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%: > /var/log/syslog%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:> /var/log/syslog%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:>/var/log/syslog%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%>|/var/log/syslog%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%journalctl --vacuum%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%journalctl --rotate%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Copy Passwd Or Shadow From TMP Path
rules.author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk
rules.description: Detects when the file "passwd" or "shadow" is copied from tmp path
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/cp' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/tmp/%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%passwd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%shadow%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Remove Scheduled Cron Task/Job
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects usage of the 'crontab' utility to remove the current crontab.
This is a common occurrence where cryptocurrency miners compete against each other by removing traces of other miners to hijack the maximum amount of resources possible
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%crontab' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -r%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Linux Crypto Mining Indicators
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects command line parameters or strings often used by crypto miners
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '% --cpu-priority=%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--donate-level=0%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -o pool.%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --nicehash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --algo=rx/0 %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%stratum+tcp://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%stratum+udp://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%sh -c /sbin/modprobe msr allow\_writes=on%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%LS1kb25hdGUtbGV2ZWw9%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%0tZG9uYXRlLWxldmVsP%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%tLWRvbmF0ZS1sZXZlbD%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%c3RyYXR1bSt0Y3A6Ly%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%N0cmF0dW0rdGNwOi8v%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%zdHJhdHVtK3RjcDovL%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%c3RyYXR1bSt1ZHA6Ly%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%N0cmF0dW0rdWRwOi8v%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%zdHJhdHVtK3VkcDovL%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Linux Process Code Injection Via DD Utility
rules.author: Joseph Kamau
rules.description: Detects the injection of code by overwriting the memory map of a Linux process using the "dd" Linux command.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/dd' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%of=%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/proc/%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/mem%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: UFW Disable Attempt
rules.author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk
rules.description:
Detects attempts to disable the Uncomplicated Firewall (UFW) on Linux systems.
UFW is a popular firewall management tool that provides an easy-to-use interface for configuring firewall rules.
Disabling UFW can leave a system vulnerable to attacks, as it may allow unauthorized access to network services and resources.
falsepositives: Legitimate actions by system administrators to disable UFW.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/ufw-init' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% force-stop%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% stop%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% flush%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%ufw %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%disable%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Shell Invocation via Env Command - Linux
rules.author: Li Ling, Andy Parkidomo, Robert Rakowski, Blake Hartstein (Bloomberg L.P.)
rules.description: Detects the use of the env command to invoke a shell. This may indicate an attempt to bypass restricted environments, escalate privileges, or execute arbitrary commands.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/env' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/bash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/dash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/fish%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/zsh%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: ESXi Network Configuration Discovery Via ESXCLI
rules.author: Cedric Maurugeon
rules.description: Detects execution of the "esxcli" command with the "network" flag in order to retrieve information about the network configuration.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/esxcli' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%network%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% get%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% list%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: ESXi Admin Permission Assigned To Account Via ESXCLI
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of the "esxcli" command with the "system" and "permission" flags in order to assign admin permissions to an account.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/esxcli' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%system%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% permission %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% set%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Admin%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: ESXi Storage Information Discovery Via ESXCLI
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Cedric Maurugeon
rules.description: Detects execution of the "esxcli" command with the "storage" flag in order to retrieve information about the storage status and other related information. Seen used by malware such as DarkSide and LockBit.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/esxcli' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%storage%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% get%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% list%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: ESXi Syslog Configuration Change Via ESXCLI
rules.author: Cedric Maurugeon
rules.description: Detects changes to the ESXi syslog configuration via "esxcli"
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/esxcli' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%system%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%syslog%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%config%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '% set%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: ESXi System Information Discovery Via ESXCLI
rules.author: Cedric Maurugeon
rules.description: Detects execution of the "esxcli" command with the "system" flag in order to retrieve information about the different component of the system. Such as accounts, modules, NTP, etc.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/esxcli' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%system%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% get%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% list%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: ESXi Account Creation Via ESXCLI
rules.author: Cedric Maurugeon
rules.description: Detects user account creation on ESXi system via esxcli
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/esxcli' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%system %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%account %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%add %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: ESXi VM List Discovery Via ESXCLI
rules.author: Cedric Maurugeon
rules.description: Detects execution of the "esxcli" command with the "vm" flag in order to retrieve information about the installed VMs.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/esxcli' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%vm process%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% list' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: ESXi VM Kill Via ESXCLI
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Cedric Maurugeon
rules.description: Detects execution of the "esxcli" command with the "vm" and "kill" flag in order to kill/shutdown a specific VM.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/esxcli' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%vm process%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%kill%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: ESXi VSAN Information Discovery Via ESXCLI
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Cedric Maurugeon
rules.description: Detects execution of the "esxcli" command with the "vsan" flag in order to retrieve information about virtual storage. Seen used by malware such as DarkSide.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/esxcli' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%vsan%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% get%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% list%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Shell Execution via Find - Linux
rules.author: Li Ling, Andy Parkidomo, Robert Rakowski, Blake Hartstein (Bloomberg L.P.)
rules.description: Detects the use of the find command to execute a shell. Such behavior may be associated with privilege escalation, unauthorized command execution, or exploitation attempt.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/find' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% . %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-exec%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/bash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/dash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/fish%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/zsh%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Shell Execution via Flock - Linux
rules.author: Li Ling, Andy Parkidomo, Robert Rakowski, Blake Hartstein (Bloomberg L.P.)
rules.description: Detects the use of the "flock" command to execute a shell. Such behavior may be associated with privilege escalation, unauthorized command execution, or to break out from restricted environments.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/flock' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -u %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/bash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/dash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/fish%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/zsh%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Shell Execution GCC  - Linux
rules.author: Li Ling, Andy Parkidomo, Robert Rakowski, Blake Hartstein (Bloomberg L.P.)
rules.description: Detects the use of the "gcc" utility to execute a shell. Such behavior may be associated with privilege escalation, unauthorized command execution, or to break out from restricted environments.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%/c89' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/c99' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/gcc' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%-wrapper%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/bash,-s%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/dash,-s%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/fish,-s%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/sh,-s%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/zsh,-s%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Shell Execution via Git - Linux
rules.author: Li Ling, Andy Parkidomo, Robert Rakowski, Blake Hartstein (Bloomberg L.P.)
rules.description: Detects the use of the "git" utility to execute a shell. Such behavior may be associated with privilege escalation, unauthorized command execution, or to break out from restricted environments.
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%/git' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentCommandLine LIKE '% -p %' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%help%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%bash 0<&1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dash 0<&1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%sh 0<&1%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Group Has Been Deleted Via Groupdel
rules.author: Tuan Le (NCSGroup)
rules.description: Detects execution of the "groupdel" binary. Which is used to delete a group. This is sometimes abused by threat actors in order to cover their tracks
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/groupdel' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Package Installed - Linux
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects installation of suspicious packages using system installation utilities
rules.sql: (((Image LIKE '%/apt' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/apt-get' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%install%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%/yum' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%localinstall%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%install%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%/rpm' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-i%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%/dpkg' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--install%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-i%' ESCAPE '\'))) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%nmap%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% nc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%netcat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wireshark%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%tshark%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%openconnect%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%proxychains%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%socat%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Flush Iptables Ufw Chain
rules.author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk
rules.description: Detect use of iptables to flush all firewall rules, tables and chains and allow all network traffic
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/iptables' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/xtables-legacy-multi' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/iptables-legacy-multi' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/ip6tables' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/ip6tables-legacy-multi' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-F%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-Z%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-X%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ufw-logging-deny%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ufw-logging-allow%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ufw6-logging-deny%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ufw6-logging-allow%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential GobRAT File Discovery Via Grep
rules.author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk
rules.description: Detects the use of grep to discover specific files created by the GobRAT malware
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/grep' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%apached%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%frpc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%sshd.sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%zone.arm%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Named Pipe Created Via Mkfifo
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the creation of a new named pipe using the "mkfifo" utility in a potentially suspicious location
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/mkfifo' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /tmp/%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Mount Execution With Hidepid Parameter
rules.author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk
rules.description: Detects execution of the "mount" command with "hidepid" parameter to make invisible processes to other users from the system
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/mount' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%hidepid=2%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -o %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Netcat Reverse Shell Execution
rules.author: @d4ns4n_, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of netcat with the "-e" flag followed by common shells. This could be a sign of a potential reverse shell setup.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/nc' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/ncat' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -e %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% ash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% bash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% bsh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% csh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ksh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% pdksh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% tcsh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/ash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/bash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/bsh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/csh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/ksh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/pdksh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/tcsh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/zsh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%$IFSash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%$IFSbash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%$IFSbsh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%$IFScsh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%$IFSksh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%$IFSpdksh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%$IFSsh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%$IFStcsh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%$IFSzsh%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Shell Execution via Nice - Linux
rules.author: Li Ling, Andy Parkidomo, Robert Rakowski, Blake Hartstein (Bloomberg L.P.)
rules.description: Detects the use of the "nice" utility to execute a shell. Such behavior may be associated with privilege escalation, unauthorized command execution, or to break out from restricted environments.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/nice' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/bash' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/dash' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/fish' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/sh' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/zsh' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Nohup Execution
rules.author: Christopher Peacock @SecurePeacock, SCYTHE @scythe_io
rules.description: Detects usage of nohup which could be leveraged by an attacker to keep a process running or break out from restricted environments
falsepositives: Administrators or installed processes that leverage nohup
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/nohup' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Nohup Execution
rules.author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk
rules.description: Detects execution of binaries located in potentially suspicious locations via "nohup"
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/nohup' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/tmp/%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: OMIGOD SCX RunAsProvider ExecuteScript
rules.author: Roberto Rodriguez (Cyb3rWard0g), OTR (Open Threat Research), MSTIC
rules.description:
Rule to detect the use of the SCX RunAsProvider ExecuteScript to execute any UNIX/Linux script using the /bin/sh shell.
Script being executed gets created as a temp file in /tmp folder with a scx* prefix.
Then it is invoked from the following directory /etc/opt/microsoft/scx/conf/tmpdir/.
The file in that directory has the same prefix scx*. SCXcore, started as the Microsoft Operations Manager UNIX/Linux Agent, is now used in a host of products including
Microsoft Operations Manager, Microsoft Azure, and Microsoft Operations Management Suite.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of SCX RunAsProvider ExecuteScript.
rules.sql: User='root' AND LogonId=0 AND CurrentDirectory='/var/opt/microsoft/scx/tmp' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/etc/opt/microsoft/scx/conf/tmpdir/scx%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: OMIGOD SCX RunAsProvider ExecuteShellCommand
rules.author: Roberto Rodriguez (Cyb3rWard0g), OTR (Open Threat Research), MSTIC
rules.description:
Rule to detect the use of the SCX RunAsProvider Invoke_ExecuteShellCommand to execute any UNIX/Linux command using the /bin/sh shell.
SCXcore, started as the Microsoft Operations Manager UNIX/Linux Agent, is now used in a host of products including
Microsoft Operations Manager, Microsoft Azure, and Microsoft Operations Management Suite.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of SCX RunAsProvider Invoke_ExecuteShellCommand.
rules.sql: User='root' AND LogonId=0 AND CurrentDirectory='/var/opt/microsoft/scx/tmp' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/sh%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Perl Reverse Shell Execution
rules.author: @d4ns4n_, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of the perl binary with the "-e" flag and common strings related to potential reverse shell activity
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/perl' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -e %' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%fdopen(%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%::Socket::INET%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%Socket%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%connect%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%open%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%exec%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Potential PHP Reverse Shell
rules.author: @d4ns4n_
rules.description:
Detects usage of the PHP CLI with the "-r" flag which allows it to run inline PHP code. The rule looks for calls to the "fsockopen" function which allows the creation of sockets.
Attackers often leverage this in combination with functions such as "exec" or "fopen" to initiate a reverse shell connection.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/php%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -r %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%fsockopen%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%bash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%bsh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%csh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ksh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%pdksh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%tcsh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%zsh%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Pnscan Binary Data Transmission Activity
rules.author: David Burkett (@signalblur)
rules.description:
Detects command line patterns associated with the use of Pnscan for sending and receiving binary data across the network.
This behavior has been identified in a Linux malware campaign targeting Docker, Apache Hadoop, Redis, and Confluence and was previously used by the threat actor known as TeamTNT

rules.title: Python Spawning Pretty TTY Via PTY Module
rules.author: Nextron Systems
rules.description: Detects a python process calling to the PTY module in order to spawn a pretty tty which could be indicative of potential reverse shell activity.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%/python' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/python2' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/python3' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%/python2.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/python3.%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%import pty%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%from pty %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%spawn%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Python Reverse Shell Execution Via PTY And Socket Modules
rules.author: @d4ns4n_, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of python with calls to the socket and pty module in order to connect and spawn a potential reverse shell.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%python%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%import%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%pty%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%socket%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%spawn%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.connect%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Inline Python Execution - Spawn Shell Via OS System Library
rules.author: Li Ling, Andy Parkidomo, Robert Rakowski, Blake Hartstein (Bloomberg L.P.)
rules.description: Detects execution of inline Python code via the "-c" in order to call the "system" function from the "os" library, and spawn a shell.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%/python' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/python2' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/python3' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%/python2.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/python3.%' ESCAPE '\')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%os.system(%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/bash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/dash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/fish%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/zsh%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Potential Ruby Reverse Shell
rules.author: @d4ns4n_
rules.description: Detects execution of ruby with the "-e" flag and calls to "socket" related functions. This could be an indication of a potential attempt to setup a reverse shell
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%ruby%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -e%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%rsocket%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%TCPSocket%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% ash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% bash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% bsh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% csh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ksh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% pdksh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% tcsh%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Scheduled Cron Task/Job - Linux
rules.author: Alejandro Ortuno, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects abuse of the cron utility to perform task scheduling for initial or recurring execution of malicious code. Detection will focus on crontab jobs uploaded from the tmp folder.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%crontab' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/tmp/%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Disabling Security Tools
rules.author: Ömer Günal, Alejandro Ortuno, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects disabling security tools
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/service' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%iptables%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%stop%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%/service' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ip6tables%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%stop%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%/chkconfig' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%iptables%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%stop%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%/chkconfig' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ip6tables%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%stop%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%/systemctl' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%firewalld%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%stop%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%/systemctl' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%firewalld%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%disable%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%/service' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cbdaemon%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%stop%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%/chkconfig' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cbdaemon%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%off%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%/systemctl' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cbdaemon%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%stop%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%/systemctl' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cbdaemon%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%disable%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%/setenforce' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%0%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%/systemctl' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%stop%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%falcon-sensor%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%/systemctl' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%disable%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%falcon-sensor%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Disable Or Stop Services
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects the usage of utilities such as 'systemctl', 'service'...etc to stop or disable tools and services on Linux systems.
Attackers may stop or disable security tools and services to evade detection, maintain persistence, or disrupt system operations.
falsepositives: Some false positives are to be expected. Apply additional filters as needed before pushing to production.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%/service' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/systemctl' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/chkconfig' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% stop %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% disable %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((Image LIKE '%/systemctl' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--no-reload disable snap-snapd-%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% stop snap-snapd-%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%/systemctl' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%tmp.ci/preinst upgrade%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% stop %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ssh.%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%/dpkg/info/ubuntu-pro-client.prerm upgrade%' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%/systemctl' ESCAPE '\')), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%/systemctl' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%snap.amazon-ssm-agent.amazon-ssm-agent.service' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Shell Invocation Via Ssh - Linux
rules.author: Li Ling, Andy Parkidomo, Robert Rakowski, Blake Hartstein (Bloomberg L.P.)
rules.description: Detects the use of the "ssh" utility to execute a shell. Such behavior may be associated with privilege escalation, unauthorized command execution, or to break out from restricted environments.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/ssh' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ProxyCommand=;%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%permitlocalcommand=yes%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%localhost%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/bash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/dash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/fish%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/zsh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%sh 0<&2 1>&2%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%sh 1>&2 0<&2%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Linux Amazon SSM Agent Hijacking
rules.author: Muhammad Faisal
rules.description: Detects potential Amazon SSM agent hijack attempts as outlined in the Mitiga research report.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/amazon-ssm-agent' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-register %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-code %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-id %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-region %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Curl File Upload - Linux
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Cedric MAURUGEON (Update)
rules.description: Detects a suspicious curl process start the adds a file to a web request
falsepositives: Scripts created by developers and admins
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/curl' ESCAPE '\' AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% --form%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --upload-file %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --data %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --data-%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine REGEXP '\s-[FTd]\s')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%://localhost%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://127.0.0.1%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Curl Change User Agents - Linux
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a suspicious curl process start on linux with set useragent options
falsepositives: Scripts created by developers and admins
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/curl' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -A %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --user-agent %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Execution From Tmp Folder
rules.author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk
rules.description: Detects a potentially suspicious execution of a process located in the '/tmp/' folder
rules.sql: Image LIKE '/tmp/%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%/usr/bin/nextcloud' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Potential Discovery Activity Using Find - Linux
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of "find" binary in a suspicious manner to perform discovery
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/find' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-perm -4000%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-perm -2000%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-perm 0777%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-perm -222%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-perm -o w%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-perm -o x%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-perm -u=s%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-perm -g=s%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Git Clone - Linux
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "git" in order to clone a remote repository that contain suspicious keywords which might be suspicious
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/git' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% clone %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%exploit%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Vulns%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%vulnerability%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%RCE%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%RemoteCodeExecution%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%CVE-%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%poc-%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ProofOfConcept%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%proxyshell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%log4shell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%eternalblue%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%eternal-blue%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%MS17-%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: History File Deletion
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects events in which a history file gets deleted, e.g. the ~/bash_history to remove traces of malicious activity
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/rm' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/unlink' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/shred' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%/.bash\_history%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/.zsh\_history%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%\_history' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.history' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%zhistory' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Print History File Contents
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects events in which someone prints the contents of history files to the commandline or redirects it to a file for reconnaissance
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/cat' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/head' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/tail' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/more' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%/.bash\_history%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/.zsh\_history%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%\_history' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.history' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%zhistory' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Linux HackTool Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Georg Lauenstein (sure[secure])
rules.description: Detects known hacktool execution based on image name.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/crackmapexec' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/havoc' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/merlin-agent' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/merlinServer-Linux-x64' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/msfconsole' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/msfvenom' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/ps-empire server' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/ps-empire' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/sliver-client' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/sliver-server' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/Villain.py' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%/cobaltstrike%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/teamserver%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%/autorecon' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/httpx' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/legion' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/naabu' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/netdiscover' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/nuclei' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/recon-ng' ESCAPE '\') OR Image LIKE '%/sniper%' ESCAPE '\' OR (Image LIKE '%/dirb' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/dirbuster' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/eyewitness' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/feroxbuster' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/ffuf' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/gobuster' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/wfuzz' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/whatweb' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%/joomscan' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/nikto' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/wpscan' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%/aircrack-ng' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/bloodhound-python' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/bpfdos' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/ebpfki' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/evil-winrm' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/hashcat' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/hoaxshell.py' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/hydra' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/john' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/ncrack' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/nxc-ubuntu-latest' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/pidhide' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/pspy32' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/pspy32s' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/pspy64' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/pspy64s' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/setoolkit' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/sqlmap' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/writeblocker' ESCAPE '\') OR Image LIKE '%/linpeas%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Interactive Bash Suspicious Children
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious interactive bash as a parent to rather uncommon child processes
falsepositives: Legitimate software that uses these patterns
rules.sql: ParentCommandLine='bash -i' AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%-c import %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%base64%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%pty.spawn%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%whoami' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%iptables' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/ncat' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/nc' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/netcat' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Suspicious Java Children Processes
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects java process spawning suspicious children
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%/java' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%bash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ksh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%zsh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%csh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%fish%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%curl%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wget%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%python%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Linux Shell Pipe to Shell
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious process command line that starts with a shell that executes something and finally gets piped into another shell
falsepositives: Legitimate software that uses these patterns
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE 'sh -c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE 'bash -c %' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%| bash %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%| sh %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%|bash %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%|sh %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%| bash' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%| sh' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%|bash' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% |sh' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Access of Sudoers File Content
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of a text-based file access or inspection utilities to read the content of /etc/sudoers in order to potentially list all users that have sudo rights.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/cat' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/ed' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/egrep' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/emacs' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/fgrep' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/grep' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/head' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/less' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/more' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/nano' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/tail' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '% /etc/sudoers%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Linux Recon Indicators
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects events with patterns found in commands used for reconnaissance on linux systems
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '% -name .htpasswd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -perm -4000 %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Suspicious Change To Sensitive/Critical Files
rules.author: @d4ns4n_ (Wuerth-Phoenix)
rules.description:
Detects changes of sensitive and critical files. Monitors files that you don't expect to change without planning on Linux system.
These files include, but are not limited to, system configuration files, authentication files, and critical application files.
Attackers often target these files to maintain persistence, escalate privileges, or disrupt system operations.
falsepositives: Some false positives are to be expected on user or administrator machines. Apply additional filters as needed.
rules.sql: (((Image LIKE '%/cat' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/echo' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/grep' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/head' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/more' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/tail' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%>%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%/emacs' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/nano' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/sed' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/vi' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/vim' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/login%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/passwd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/boot/%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/etc/%.conf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/etc/cron.%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/etc/crontab%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/etc/hosts%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/etc/init.d%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/etc/sudoers%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/opt/bin/%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/sbin%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/usr/bin/%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/usr/local/bin/%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%/bin/sed' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE 'sed -i /^%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE 'sed -ne s/^%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%/etc/mdadm/mdadm.conf' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Shell Execution Of Process Located In Tmp Directory
rules.author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk
rules.description: Detects execution of shells from a parent process located in a temporary (/tmp) directory
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '/tmp/%' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%/bash' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/csh' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/dash' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/fish' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/ksh' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/sh' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/zsh' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Execution Of Script Located In Potentially Suspicious Directory
rules.author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk
rules.description: Detects executions of scripts located in potentially suspicious locations such as "/tmp" via a shell such as "bash", "sh", etc.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/bash' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/csh' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/dash' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/fish' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/ksh' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/sh' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/zsh' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/tmp/%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Touch Suspicious Service File
rules.author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk
rules.description: Detects usage of the "touch" process in service file.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/touch' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -t %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.service' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Triple Cross eBPF Rootkit Execve Hijack
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of a the file "execve_hijack" which is used by the Triple Cross rootkit as a way to elevate privileges
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/sudo' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%execve\_hijack%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Triple Cross eBPF Rootkit Install Commands
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects default install commands of the Triple Cross eBPF rootkit based on the "deployer.sh" script
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/sudo' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% tc %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% enp0s3 %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% qdisc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% filter %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: User Has Been Deleted Via Userdel
rules.author: Tuan Le (NCSGroup)
rules.description: Detects execution of the "userdel" binary. Which is used to delete a user account and related files. This is sometimes abused by threat actors in order to cover their tracks
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/userdel' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: User Added To Root/Sudoers Group Using Usermod
rules.author: TuanLe (GTSC)
rules.description: Detects usage of the "usermod" binary to add users add users to the root or suoders groups
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/usermod' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-aG root%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-aG sudoers%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Vim GTFOBin Abuse - Linux
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Luc Génaux
rules.description:
Detects the use of "vim" and it's siblings commands to execute a shell or proxy commands.
Such behavior may be associated with privilege escalation, unauthorized command execution, or to break out from restricted environments.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%/rvim' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/vi' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/vim' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/vimdiff' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% --cmd %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -c%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:!/%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:!$%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:!..%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:lua %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:py %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:shell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/bash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/dash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/fish%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/csh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/ksh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/zsh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/bin/tmux%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Linux Webshell Indicators
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious sub processes of web server processes
falsepositives: Web applications that invoke Linux command line tools
rules.sql: ((ParentImage LIKE '%/httpd' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%/lighttpd' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%/nginx' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%/apache2' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%/node' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%/caddy' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%/bin/java%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%tomcat%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%/bin/java%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%websphere%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (Image LIKE '%/whoami' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/ifconfig' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/ip' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/bin/uname' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/bin/cat' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/bin/crontab' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/hostname' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/iptables' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/netstat' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/pwd' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/route' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Download File To Potentially Suspicious Directory Via Wget
rules.author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk
rules.description: Detects the use of wget to download content to a suspicious directory
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/wget' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine REGEXP '\s-O\s' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--output-document%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%/tmp/%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Xterm Reverse Shell
rules.author: @d4ns4n_
rules.description: Detects usage of "xterm" as a potential reverse shell tunnel
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%xterm%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-display%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%:1' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: MacOS Scripting Interpreter AppleScript
rules.author: Alejandro Ortuno, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects execution of AppleScript of the macOS scripting language AppleScript.
falsepositives: Application installers might contain scripts as part of the installation process.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/osascript' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.scpt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.js%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%opencode' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%osascript%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -e %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%set imageData to the clipboard%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%set fileRef%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Binary Padding - MacOS
rules.author: Igor Fits, Mikhail Larin, oscd.community
rules.description: Adversaries may use binary padding to add junk data and change the on-disk representation of malware. This rule detect using dd and truncate to add a junk data to file.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/truncate' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-s +%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%/dd' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%if=/dev/zero%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%if=/dev/random%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%if=/dev/urandom%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: File Time Attribute Change
rules.author: Igor Fits, Mikhail Larin, oscd.community
rules.description: Detect file time attribute change to hide new or changes to existing files
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/touch' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-t%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-acmr%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-d%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-r%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Hidden Flag Set On File/Directory Via Chflags - MacOS
rules.author: Omar Khaled (@beacon_exe)
rules.description:
Detects the execution of the "chflags" utility with the "hidden" flag, in order to hide files on MacOS.
When a file or directory has this hidden flag set, it becomes invisible to the default file listing commands and in graphical file browsers.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of chflags by administrators and users.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/chflags' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%hidden %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Indicator Removal on Host - Clear Mac System Logs
rules.author: remotephone, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects deletion of local audit logs
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/rm' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/unlink' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/shred' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/var/log%' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/Users/%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Library/Logs/%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Clipboard Access Via OSAScript
rules.author: Sohan G (D4rkCiph3r)
rules.description: Detects access to clipboard content via osascript, which may be used for data collection but also occurs in legitimate clipboard utilities and automation scripts
falsepositives: Legitimate clipboard utilities and automation scripts that read or write clipboard content
Developer tools and IDEs that use osascript for clipboard integration
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/osascript' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -e %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%clipboard%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%opencode' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%osascript%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -e %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%set imageData to the clipboard%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%set fileRef%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Hidden User Creation
rules.author: Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects creation of a hidden user account on macOS (UserID < 500) or with IsHidden option
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%/dscl' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%create%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%UniqueID%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine REGEXP '([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|[1-4][0-9]{2})')) OR ((Image LIKE '%/dscl' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%create%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%IsHidden%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%true%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%yes%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%1%' ESCAPE '\')))

rules.title: Credentials from Password Stores - Keychain
rules.author: Tim Ismilyaev, oscd.community, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects passwords dumps from Keychain
rules.sql: (Image='/usr/bin/security' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%find-certificate%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% export %' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '% dump-keychain %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% login-keychain %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: System Integrity Protection (SIP) Disabled
rules.author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk
rules.description: Detects the use of csrutil to disable the Configure System Integrity Protection (SIP). This technique is used in post-exploit scenarios.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/csrutil' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%disable%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Disable Security Tools
rules.author: Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects disabling security tools
rules.sql: ((Image='/bin/launchctl' AND CommandLine LIKE '%unload%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%com.objective-see.lulu.plist%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%com.objective-see.blockblock.plist%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%com.google.santad.plist%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%com.carbonblack.defense.daemon.plist%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%com.carbonblack.daemon.plist%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%at.obdev.littlesnitchd.plist%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%com.tenablesecurity.nessusagent.plist%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%com.opendns.osx.RoamingClientConfigUpdater.plist%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%com.crowdstrike.falcond.plist%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%com.crowdstrike.userdaemon.plist%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%osquery%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%filebeat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%auditbeat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%packetbeat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%td-agent%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image='/usr/sbin/spctl' AND CommandLine LIKE '%disable%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: User Added To Admin Group Via Dscl
rules.author: Sohan G (D4rkCiph3r)
rules.description: Detects attempts to create and add an account to the admin group via "dscl"
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/dscl' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -append %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /Groups/admin %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% GroupMembership %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: User Added To Admin Group Via DseditGroup
rules.author: Sohan G (D4rkCiph3r)
rules.description: Detects attempts to create and/or add an account to the admin group, thus granting admin privileges.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/dseditgroup' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -o edit %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -a %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -t user%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%admin%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Root Account Enable Via Dsenableroot
rules.author: Sohan G (D4rkCiph3r)
rules.description: Detects attempts to enable the root account via "dsenableroot"
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/dsenableroot' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% -d %' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Credentials In Files
rules.author: Igor Fits, Mikhail Larin, oscd.community
rules.description: Detecting attempts to extract passwords with grep and laZagne
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/grep' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%password%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%laZagne%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Disk Image Creation Via Hdiutil - MacOS
rules.author: Omar Khaled (@beacon_exe)
rules.description: Detects the execution of the hdiutil utility in order to create a disk image.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of hdiutil by administrators and users.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/hdiutil' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%create%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Disk Image Mounting Via Hdiutil - MacOS
rules.author: Omar Khaled (@beacon_exe)
rules.description: Detects the execution of the hdiutil utility in order to mount disk images.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of hdiutil by administrators and users.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/hdiutil' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%attach %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mount %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Installer Package Child Process
rules.author: Sohan G (D4rkCiph3r)
rules.description: Detects the execution of suspicious child processes from macOS installer package parent process. This includes osascript, JXA, curl and wget amongst other interpreters
falsepositives: Legitimate software uses the scripts (preinstall, postinstall)
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%/package\_script\_service' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%/installer' ESCAPE '\') AND (Image LIKE '%/sh' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/bash' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/dash' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/python' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/ruby' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/perl' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/php' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/javascript' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/osascript' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/tclsh' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/curl' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/wget' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%preinstall%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%postinstall%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: System Information Discovery Using Ioreg
rules.author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk
rules.description:
Detects the use of "ioreg" which will show I/O Kit registry information.
This process is used for system information discovery.
It has been observed in-the-wild by calling this process directly or using bash and grep to look for specific strings.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/ioreg' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ioreg%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-l%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-c%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%AppleAHCIDiskDriver%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%IOPlatformExpertDevice%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Oracle%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Parallels%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%USB Vendor Name%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%VirtualBox%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%VMware%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: JAMF MDM Potential Suspicious Child Process
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects potential suspicious child processes of "jamf". Could be a sign of potential abuse of Jamf as a C2 server as seen by Typhon MythicAgent.
falsepositives: Legitimate execution of custom scripts or commands by Jamf administrators. Apply additional filters accordingly
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%/jamf' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%/bash' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/sh' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: JXA In-memory Execution Via OSAScript
rules.author: Sohan G (D4rkCiph3r)
rules.description: Detects possible malicious execution of JXA in-memory via OSAScript
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%osascript%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -e %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%eval%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%NSData.dataWithContentsOfURL%' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% -l %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%JavaScript%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%.js%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Launch Agent/Daemon Execution Via Launchctl
rules.author: Pratinav Chandra
rules.description: Detects the execution of programs as Launch Agents or Launch Daemons using launchctl on macOS.
falsepositives: Legitimate administration activities is expected to trigger false positives. Investigate the command line being passed to determine if the service or launch agent are suspicious.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/launchctl' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%submit%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%load%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%start%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: File Download Via Nscurl - MacOS
rules.author: Daniel Cortez
rules.description: Detects the execution of the nscurl utility in order to download files.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of nscurl by administrators and users.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/nscurl' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--download %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--download-directory %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--output %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-dir %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-dl %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-ld%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-o %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Microsoft Office Child Process - MacOS
rules.author: Sohan G (D4rkCiph3r)
rules.description: Detects suspicious child processes spawning from microsoft office suite applications such as word or excel. This could indicates malicious macro execution
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%Microsoft Word%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%Microsoft Excel%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%Microsoft PowerPoint%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%Microsoft OneNote%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Image LIKE '%/bash' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/curl' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/dash' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/fish' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/osacompile' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/osascript' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/sh' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/zsh' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/python' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/python3' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/wget' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: OSACompile Run-Only Execution
rules.author: Sohan G (D4rkCiph3r)
rules.description: Detects potential suspicious run-only executions compiled using OSACompile
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%osacompile%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -x %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -e %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Payload Decoded and Decrypted via Built-in Utilities
rules.author: Tim Rauch (rule), Elastic (idea)
rules.description: Detects when a built-in utility is used to decode and decrypt a payload after a macOS disk image (DMG) is executed. Malware authors may attempt to evade detection and trick users into executing malicious code by encoding and encrypting their payload and placing it in a disk image file. This behavior is consistent with adware or malware families such as Bundlore and Shlayer.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/openssl' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/Volumes/%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%enc%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-base64%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -d %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Persistence Via PlistBuddy
rules.author: Sohan G (D4rkCiph3r)
rules.description: Detects potential persistence activity using LaunchAgents or LaunchDaemons via the PlistBuddy utility
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/PlistBuddy' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%RunAtLoad%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%true%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%LaunchAgents%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%LaunchDaemons%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Scheduled Cron Task/Job - MacOs
rules.author: Alejandro Ortuno, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects abuse of the cron utility to perform task scheduling for initial or recurring execution of malicious code. Detection will focus on crontab jobs uploaded from the tmp folder.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/crontab' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/tmp/%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Security Software Discovery - MacOs
rules.author: Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects usage of system utilities (only grep for now) to discover security software discovery
rules.sql: Image='/usr/bin/grep' AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%nessusd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%santad%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%CbDefense%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%falcond%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%td-agent%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%packetbeat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%filebeat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%auditbeat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%osqueryd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%BlockBlock%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%LuLu%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%Little%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Snitch%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Suspicious Browser Child Process - MacOS
rules.author: Sohan G (D4rkCiph3r)
rules.description: Detects suspicious child processes spawned from browsers. This could be a result of a potential web browser exploitation.
falsepositives: Legitimate browser install, update and recovery scripts
rules.sql: ((ParentImage LIKE '%com.apple.WebKit.WebContent%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%firefox%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%Google Chrome Helper%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%Google Chrome%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%Microsoft Edge%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%Opera%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%Safari%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%Tor Browser%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Image LIKE '%/bash' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/curl' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/dash' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/ksh' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/osascript' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/perl' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/php' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/pwsh' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/python' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/sh' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/tcsh' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/wget' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/zsh' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%--defaults-torrc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/Library/Application Support/Microsoft/MAU%/Microsoft AutoUpdate.app/Contents/MacOS/msupdate%' ESCAPE '\' OR ((ParentImage LIKE '%Google Chrome Helper%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%Google Chrome%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/Volumes/Google Chrome/Google Chrome.app/Contents/Frameworks/%/Resources/install.sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/Frameworks/Google Chrome Framework.framework/%/Resources/keystone\_promote\_preflight.sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/Frameworks/Google Chrome Framework.framework/%/Resources/keystone\_promote\_postflight.sh%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (ParentImage LIKE '%Microsoft Edge%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%IOPlatformExpertDevice%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%hw.model%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((ParentImage LIKE '%Google Chrome Helper%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%Google Chrome%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/Users/%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Library/Application Support/Google/Chrome/recovery/%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/ChromeRecovery%' ESCAPE '\'))), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine IS NULL OR CommandLine=''), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Execution via macOS Script Editor
rules.author: Tim Rauch (rule), Elastic (idea)
rules.description: Detects when the macOS Script Editor utility spawns an unusual child process.
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%/Script Editor' ESCAPE '\' AND ((Image LIKE '%/curl' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/bash' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/sh' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/zsh' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/dash' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/fish' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/osascript' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/mktemp' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/chmod' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/php' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/nohup' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/openssl' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/plutil' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/PlistBuddy' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/xattr' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/sqlite' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/funzip' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/popen' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%python%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%perl%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Potential Discovery Activity Using Find - MacOS
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of "find" binary in a suspicious manner to perform discovery
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/find' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-perm -4000%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-perm -2000%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-perm 0777%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-perm -222%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-perm -o w%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-perm -o x%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-perm -u=s%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-perm -g=s%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious History File Operations
rules.author: Mikhail Larin, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects commandline operations on shell history files
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%.bash\_history%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.zsh\_history%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.zhistory%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.history%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.sh\_history%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%fish\_history%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential In-Memory Download And Compile Of Payloads
rules.author: Sohan G (D4rkCiph3r), Red Canary (idea)
rules.description: Detects potential in-memory downloading and compiling of applets using curl and osacompile as seen used by XCSSET malware
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%osacompile%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%curl%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious MacOS Firmware Activity
rules.author: Austin Songer @austinsonger
rules.description: Detects when a user manipulates with Firmward Password on MacOS. NOTE - this command has been disabled on silicon-based apple computers.
rules.sql: Image='/usr/sbin/firmwarepasswd' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%setpasswd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%full%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%delete%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%check%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Osacompile Execution By Potentially Suspicious Applet/Osascript
rules.author: Sohan G (D4rkCiph3r), Red Canary (Idea)
rules.description: Detects potential suspicious applet or osascript executing "osacompile".
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%/applet' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%/osascript' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%osacompile%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: System Information Discovery Using sw_vers
rules.author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk
rules.description: Detects the use of "sw_vers" for system information discovery
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/sw\_vers' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-buildVersion%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-productName%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-productVersion%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: User Added To Admin Group Via Sysadminctl
rules.author: Sohan G (D4rkCiph3r)
rules.description: Detects attempts to create and add an account to the admin group via "sysadminctl"
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/sysadminctl' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -addUser %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -admin %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: System Information Discovery Via Sysctl - MacOS
rules.author: Pratinav Chandra
rules.description:
Detects the execution of "sysctl" with specific arguments that have been used by threat actors and malware. It provides system hardware information.
This process is primarily used to detect and avoid virtualization and analysis environments.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/sysctl' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%sysctl%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%hw.%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%kern.%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%machdep.%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: System Information Discovery Using System_Profiler
rules.author: Stephen Lincoln `@slincoln_aiq` (AttackIQ)
rules.description:
Detects the execution of "system_profiler" with specific "Data Types" that have been seen being used by threat actors and malware. It provides system hardware and software configuration information.
This process is primarily used for system information discovery. However, "system_profiler" can also be used to determine if virtualization software is being run for defense evasion purposes.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/system\_profiler' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%system\_profiler%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%SPApplicationsDataType%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SPHardwareDataType%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SPNetworkDataType%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SPUSBDataType%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Base64 Decoded From Images
rules.author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk
rules.description: Detects the use of tail to extract bytes at an offset from an image and then decode the base64 value to create a new file with the decoded content. The detected execution is a bash one-liner.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%/bash' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%tail%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-c%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%base64%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-d%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%>%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.avif%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.gif%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jfif%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpeg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.pjp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.pjpeg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.png%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.svg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.webp%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Time Machine Backup Deletion Attempt Via Tmutil - MacOS
rules.author: Pratinav Chandra
rules.description:
Detects deletion attempts of MacOS Time Machine backups via the native backup utility "tmutil".
An adversary may perform this action before launching a ransonware attack to prevent the victim from restoring their files.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/tmutil' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%tmutil%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%delete%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Time Machine Backup Disabled Via Tmutil - MacOS
rules.author: Pratinav Chandra
rules.description:
Detects disabling of Time Machine (Apple's automated backup utility software) via the native macOS backup utility "tmutil".
An attacker can use this to prevent backups from occurring.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/tmutil' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%tmutil%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%disable%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: New File Exclusion Added To Time Machine Via Tmutil - MacOS
rules.author: Pratinav Chandra
rules.description:
Detects the addition of a new file or path exclusion to MacOS Time Machine via the "tmutil" utility.
An adversary could exclude a path from Time Machine backups to prevent certain files from being backed up.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/tmutil' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%tmutil%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%addexclusion%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential WizardUpdate Malware Infection
rules.author: Tim Rauch (rule), Elastic (idea)
rules.description: Detects the execution traces of the WizardUpdate malware. WizardUpdate is a macOS trojan that attempts to infiltrate macOS machines to steal data and it is associated with other types of malicious payloads, increasing the chances of multiple infections on a device.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%/sh' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%=$(curl %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%eval%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%/curl' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\_intermediate\_agent\_%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential XCSSET Malware Infection
rules.author: Tim Rauch (rule), Elastic (idea)
rules.description: Identifies the execution traces of the XCSSET malware. XCSSET is a macOS trojan that primarily spreads via Xcode projects and maliciously modifies applications. Infected users are also vulnerable to having their credentials, accounts, and other vital data stolen.
