rules.sql: ((ParentImage LIKE '%/bash' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%/curl' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/sys/log.php%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/sys/prepod.php%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/sys/bin/Pods%' ESCAPE '\')) AND CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((ParentImage LIKE '%/bash' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%/osacompile' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/Users/%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Library/Group Containers/%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (ParentImage LIKE '%/bash' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%/plutil' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%LSUIElement%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Users/%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Library/Group Containers/%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%/zip' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-r%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Users/%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Library/Group Containers/%' ESCAPE '\')))

rules.title: AADInternals PowerShell Cmdlets Execution - PsScript
rules.author: Austin Songer (@austinsonger), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects ADDInternals Cmdlet execution. A tool for administering Azure AD and Office 365. Which can be abused by threat actors to attack Azure AD or Office 365.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of the library for administrative activity
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ConvertTo-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Disable-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Enable-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Export-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Find-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Grant-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Initialize-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Install-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Join-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Open-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Read-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Register-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Reset-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Resolve-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Restore-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Save-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Search-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Send-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Start-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Unprotect-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Update-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Access to Browser Login Data
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may acquire credentials from web browsers by reading files specific to the target browser.
Web browsers commonly save credentials such as website usernames and passwords so that they do not need to be entered manually in the future.
Web browsers typically store the credentials in an encrypted format within a credential store.
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Copy-Item%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Destination%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\Opera Software\\Opera Stable\\Login Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data\\Default%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\Default\\Login Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\Default\\Login Data For Account%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Active Directory Enumeration Using AD Module - PsScript
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali
rules.description: Detects usage of the "Import-Module" cmdlet to load the "Microsoft.ActiveDirectory.Management.dl" DLL. Which is often used by attackers to perform AD enumeration.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of the library for administrative activity
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Import-Module %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Microsoft.ActiveDirectory.Management.dll%' ESCAPE '\') OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ipmo Microsoft.ActiveDirectory.Management.dll%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Powershell Add Name Resolution Policy Table Rule
rules.author: Borna Talebi
rules.description:
Detects powershell scripts that adds a Name Resolution Policy Table (NRPT) rule for the specified namespace.
This will bypass the default DNS server and uses a specified server for answering the query.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-DnsClientNrptRule%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Namesp%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-NameSe%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Add Windows Capability Via PowerShell Script
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the "Add-WindowsCapability" cmdlet to add Windows capabilities. Notable capabilities could be "OpenSSH" and others.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of the capabilities by administrators or users. Add additional filters accordingly.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-WindowsCapability %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Name OpenSSH.%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PowerShell ADRecon Execution
rules.author: Bhabesh Raj
rules.description: Detects execution of ADRecon.ps1 for AD reconnaissance which has been reported to be actively used by FIN7
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Function Get-ADRExcelComOb%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADRGPO%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADRDomainController%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ADRecon-Report.xlsx%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: AMSI Bypass Pattern Assembly GetType
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects code fragments found in small and obfuscated AMSI bypass PowerShell scripts
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[Ref].Assembly.GetType%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SetValue($null,$true)%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%NonPublic,Static%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential AMSI Bypass Script Using NULL Bits
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of special strings/null bits in order to potentially bypass AMSI functionalities
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%if(0){{{0}}}'' -f $(0 -as [char]) +%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%#<NULL>%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Silence.EDA Detection
rules.author: Alina Stepchenkova, Group-IB, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Silence EmpireDNSAgent as described in the Group-IP report
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.Diagnostics.Process%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Stop-Computer%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Restart-Computer%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Exception in execution%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%$cmdargs%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Close-Dnscat2Tunnel%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%set type=$LookupType`nserver%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%$Command | nslookup 2>&1 | Out-String%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-RandomDNSField%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[Convert]::ToString($SYNOptions, 16)%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%$Session.Dead = $True%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%$Session["Driver"] -eq%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Get-ADUser Enumeration Using UserAccountControl Flags
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects AS-REP roasting is an attack that is often-overlooked. It is not very common as you have to explicitly set accounts that do not require pre-authentication.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADUser%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Filter%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%useraccountcontrol%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-band%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%4194304%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Data Exfiltration Via Audio File
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects potential exfiltration attempt via audio file using PowerShell
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[System.Math]::%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[IO.FileMode]::%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%BinaryWriter%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0x52%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0x49%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0x46%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0x57%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0x41%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0x56%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0x45%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0xAC%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Automated Collection Command PowerShell
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Once established within a system or network, an adversary may use automated techniques for collecting internal data.
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.doc%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.docx%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.xls%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.xlsx%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.ppt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.pptx%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.rtf%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.pdf%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.txt%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ChildItem%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -Recurse %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -Include %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Windows Screen Capture with CopyFromScreen
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may attempt to take screen captures of the desktop to gather information over the course of an operation.
Screen capturing functionality may be included as a feature of a remote access tool used in post-compromise operations
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.CopyFromScreen%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Clear PowerShell History - PowerShell
rules.author: Ilyas Ochkov, Jonhnathan Ribeiro, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects keywords that could indicate clearing PowerShell history
rules.sql: ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-PSReadlineOption%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%–HistorySaveStyle%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SaveNothing%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-PSReadlineOption%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-HistorySaveStyle%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SaveNothing%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%del%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-Item%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%rm%' ESCAPE '\') AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%(Get-PSReadlineOption).HistorySavePath%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Clearing Windows Console History
rules.author: Austin Songer @austinsonger
rules.description: Identifies when a user attempts to clear console history. An adversary may clear the command history of a compromised account to conceal the actions undertaken during an intrusion.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Clear-History%' ESCAPE '\' OR ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-Item%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%rm%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ConsoleHost\_history.txt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%(Get-PSReadlineOption).HistorySavePath%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Powershell Create Scheduled Task
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Adversaries may abuse the Windows Task Scheduler to perform task scheduling for initial or recurring execution of malicious code
rules.sql: ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-ScheduledTaskAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-ScheduledTaskTrigger%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-ScheduledTask%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Register-ScheduledTask%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-CimMethod%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ClassName%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%PS\_ScheduledTask%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-NameSpace%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Root\\Microsoft\\Windows\\TaskScheduler%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Microsoft.PowerShell.Core\\Export-ModuleMember%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Microsoft.Management.Infrastructure.CimInstance%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\_\_cmdletization\_methodParameter%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Computer Discovery And Export Via Get-ADComputer Cmdlet - PowerShell
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the Get-ADComputer cmdlet to collect computer information and output it to a file
falsepositives: Legitimate admin scripts may use the same technique, it's better to exclude specific computers or users who execute these commands or scripts often
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADComputer %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -Filter *%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '% | Select %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Out-File%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-Content%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-Content%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Powershell Install a DLL in System Directory
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Uses PowerShell to install/copy a file into a system directory such as "System32" or "SysWOW64"
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText REGEXP '(Copy-Item|cpi) .{2,128} -Destination .{1,32}\\Windows\\(System32|SysWOW64)'

rules.title: Registry-Free Process Scope COR_PROFILER
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may leverage the COR_PROFILER environment variable to hijack the execution flow of programs that load the .NET CLR.
The COR_PROFILER is a .NET Framework feature which allows developers to specify an unmanaged (or external of .NET) profiling DLL to be loaded into each .NET process that loads the Common Language Runtime (CLR).
These profiliers are designed to monitor, troubleshoot, and debug managed code executed by the .NET CLR.
(Citation: Microsoft Profiling Mar 2017)
(Citation: Microsoft COR_PROFILER Feb 2013)
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%$env:COR\_ENABLE\_PROFILING%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%$env:COR\_PROFILER%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%$env:COR\_PROFILER\_PATH%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PowerShell Create Local User
rules.author: @ROxPinTeddy
rules.description: Detects creation of a local user via PowerShell
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-LocalUser%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Create Volume Shadow Copy with Powershell
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Adversaries may attempt to access or create a copy of the Active Directory domain database in order to steal credential information
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Win32\_ShadowCopy%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%).Create(%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ClientAccessible%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Powershell Detect Virtualization Environment
rules.author: frack113, Duc.Le-GTSC
rules.description:
Adversaries may employ various system checks to detect and avoid virtualization and analysis environments.
This may include changing behaviors based on the results of checks for the presence of artifacts indicative of a virtual machine environment (VME) or sandbox
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-WmiObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%gwmi%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%MSAcpi\_ThermalZoneTemperature%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Win32\_ComputerSystem%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: DirectorySearcher Powershell Exploitation
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Enumerates Active Directory to determine computers that are joined to the domain
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-Object %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.DirectoryServices.DirectorySearcher%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.PropertiesToLoad.Add%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.findall()%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Properties.name%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Manipulation of User Computer or Group Security Principals Across AD
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may create a domain account to maintain access to victim systems.
Domain accounts are those managed by Active Directory Domain Services where access and permissions are configured across systems and services that are part of that domain..
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.DirectoryServices.AccountManagement%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Disable Powershell Command History
rules.author: Ali Alwashali
rules.description: Detects scripts or commands that disabled the Powershell command history by removing psreadline module
falsepositives: Legitimate script that disables the command history
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-Module%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%psreadline%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature Command PowerShell
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Detect built in PowerShell cmdlet Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature, Deployment Image Servicing and Management tool.
Similar to DISM.exe, this cmdlet is used to enumerate, install, uninstall, configure, and update features and packages in Windows images
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Online%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-FeatureName%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Windows-Defender-Gui%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Windows-Defender-Features%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Windows-Defender%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Windows-Defender-ApplicationGuard%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential In-Memory Execution Using Reflection.Assembly
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects usage of "Reflection.Assembly" load functions to dynamically load assemblies in memory
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[Reflection.Assembly]::load%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential COM Objects Download Cradles Usage - PS Script
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects usage of COM objects that can be abused to download files in PowerShell by CLSID
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[Type]::GetTypeFromCLSID(%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0002DF01-0000-0000-C000-000000000046%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%F6D90F16-9C73-11D3-B32E-00C04F990BB4%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%F5078F35-C551-11D3-89B9-0000F81FE221%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%88d96a0a-f192-11d4-a65f-0040963251e5%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%AFBA6B42-5692-48EA-8141-DC517DCF0EF1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%AFB40FFD-B609-40A3-9828-F88BBE11E4E3%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%88d96a0b-f192-11d4-a65f-0040963251e5%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%2087c2f4-2cef-4953-a8ab-66779b670495%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%000209FF-0000-0000-C000-000000000046%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%00024500-0000-0000-C000-000000000046%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: DSInternals Suspicious PowerShell Cmdlets - ScriptBlock
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects execution and usage of the DSInternals PowerShell module. Which can be used to perform what might be considered as suspicious activity such as dumping DPAPI backup keys or manipulating NTDS.DIT files.
The DSInternals PowerShell Module exposes several internal features of Active Directory and Azure Active Directory. These include FIDO2 and NGC key auditing, offline ntds.dit file manipulation, password auditing, DC recovery from IFM backups and password hash calculation.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of DSInternals for administration or audit purpose.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-ADDBSidHistory%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-ADNgcKey%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-ADReplNgcKey%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ConvertFrom-ADManagedPasswordBlob%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ConvertFrom-GPPrefPassword%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ConvertFrom-ManagedPasswordBlob%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ConvertFrom-UnattendXmlPassword%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ConvertFrom-UnicodePassword%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ConvertTo-AADHash%' ESCAPE '\' OR '%ConvertTo-UnicodePassword%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Disable-ADDBAccount%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Enable-ADDBAccount%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADDBAccount%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADDBBackupKey%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADDBDomainController%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADDBGroupManagedServiceAccount%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADDBKdsRootKey%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADDBSchemaAttribute%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADDBServiceAccount%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADDefaultPasswordPolicy%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADKeyCredential%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADPasswordPolicy%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADReplAccount%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADReplBackupKey%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADReplicationAccount%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADSIAccount%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-AzureADUserEx%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-BootKey%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-KeyCredential%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-LsaBackupKey%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-LsaPolicy%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-SamPasswordPolicy%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-SysKey%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-SystemKey%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-ADDBRestoreFromMediaScript%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-ADKeyCredential%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-ADNgcKey%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-NTHashSet%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-ADDBObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Save-DPAPIBlob%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-ADAccountPasswordHash%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-ADDBAccountPassword%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-ADDBBootKey%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-ADDBDomainController%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-ADDBPrimaryGroup%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-ADDBSysKey%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-AzureADUserEx%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-LsaPolicy%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-SamAccountPasswordHash%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-WinUserPasswordHash%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Test-ADDBPasswordQuality%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Test-ADPasswordQuality%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Test-ADReplPasswordQuality%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Test-PasswordQuality%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Unlock-ADDBAccount%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Write-ADNgcKey%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Write-ADReplNgcKey%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Dump Credentials from Windows Credential Manager With PowerShell
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may search for common password storage locations to obtain user credentials.
Passwords are stored in several places on a system, depending on the operating system or application holding the credentials.
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-PasswordVaultCredentials%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-CredManCreds%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-Object%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Windows.Security.Credentials.PasswordVault%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-Object%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Microsoft.CSharp.CSharpCodeProvider%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[System.Runtime.InteropServices.RuntimeEnvironment]::GetRuntimeDirectory())%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Collections.ArrayList%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.CodeDom.Compiler.CompilerParameters%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Enable Windows Remote Management
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Adversaries may use Valid Accounts to interact with remote systems using Windows Remote Management (WinRM). The adversary may then perform actions as the logged-on user.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Enable-PSRemoting %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Suspicious Windows Feature Enabled
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Detects usage of the built-in PowerShell cmdlet "Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature" used as a Deployment Image Servicing and Management tool.
Similar to DISM.exe, this cmdlet is used to enumerate, install, uninstall, configure, and update features and packages in Windows images
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of the features listed in the rule.
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Online%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-FeatureName%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TelnetServer%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Internet-Explorer-Optional-amd64%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TFTP%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SMB1Protocol%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Client-ProjFS%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Microsoft-Windows-Subsystem-Linux%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Enumerate Credentials from Windows Credential Manager With PowerShell
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may search for common password storage locations to obtain user credentials.
Passwords are stored in several places on a system, depending on the operating system or application holding the credentials.
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%vaultcmd%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%/listcreds:%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Windows Credentials%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Web Credentials%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Disable of ETW Trace - Powershell
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of powershell cmdlets to disable or remove ETW trace sessions
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-EtwTraceProvider %' ESCAPE '\' OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-EtwTraceProvider %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0x11%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Certificate Exported Via PowerShell - ScriptBlock
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects calls to cmdlets inside of PowerShell scripts that are used to export certificates from the local certificate store. Threat actors were seen abusing this to steal private keys from compromised machines.
falsepositives: Legitimate certificate exports by administrators. Additional filters might be required.
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Export-PfxCertificate%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Export-Certificate%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%CmdletsToExport = @(%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious FromBase64String Usage On Gzip Archive - Ps Script
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects attempts of decoding a base64 Gzip archive in a PowerShell script. This technique is often used as a method to load malicious content into memory afterward.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%MemoryStream%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%H4sI%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Service Registry Permissions Weakness Check
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may execute their own malicious payloads by hijacking the Registry entries used by services.
Adversaries may use flaws in the permissions for registry to redirect from the originally specified executable to one that they control, in order to launch their own code at Service start.
Windows stores local service configuration information in the Registry under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%get-acl%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%REGISTRY::HKLM\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Get-ADReplAccount
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
The DSInternals PowerShell Module exposes several internal features of Active Directory and Azure Active Directory.
These include FIDO2 and NGC key auditing, offline ntds.dit file manipulation, password auditing, DC recovery from IFM backups and password hash calculation.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADReplAccount%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-All %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Server %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Security Software Discovery Via Powershell Script
rules.author: frack113, Anish Bogati, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects calls to "get-process" where the output is piped to a "where-object" filter to search for security solution processes.
Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of security software, configurations, defensive tools, and sensors that are installed on a system or in a cloud environment. This may include things such as firewall rules and anti-virus
falsepositives: False positives might occur due to the nature of the ScriptBlock being ingested as a big blob. Initial tuning is required.
As the "selection_cmdlet" is common in scripts the matching engine might slow down the search. Change into regex or a more accurate string to avoid heavy resource consumption if experienced
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%get-process | ?%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%get-process | where%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%gps | ?%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%gps | where%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Company -like%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Description -like%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Name -like%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Path -like%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Product -like%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%*avira*%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%*carbonblack*%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%*cylance*%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%*defender*%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%*kaspersky*%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%*malware*%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%*sentinel*%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%*symantec*%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%*virus*%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - Rubeus Execution - ScriptBlock
rules.author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of the hacktool Rubeus using specific command line flags
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%asreproast %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%dump /service:krbtgt %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%dump /luid:0x%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%kerberoast %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%createnetonly /program:%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ptt /ticket:%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%/impersonateuser:%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%renew /ticket:%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%asktgt /user:%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%harvest /interval:%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%s4u /user:%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%s4u /ticket:%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%hash /password:%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%golden /aes256:%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%silver /user:%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: HackTool - WinPwn Execution - ScriptBlock
rules.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
rules.description: Detects scriptblock text keywords indicative of potential usge of the tool WinPwn. A tool for Windows and Active Directory reconnaissance and exploitation.
falsepositives: As the script block is a blob of text. False positive may occur with scripts that contain the keyword as a reference or simply use it for detection.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Offline\_Winpwn%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%WinPwn %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%WinPwn.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%WinPwn.ps1%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PowerShell Hotfix Enumeration
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects call to "Win32_QuickFixEngineering" in order to enumerate installed hotfixes often used in "enum" scripts by attackers
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Win32\_QuickFixEngineering%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%HotFixID%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PowerShell ICMP Exfiltration
rules.author: Bartlomiej Czyz @bczyz1, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol - ICMP. Adversaries may steal data by exfiltrating it over an un-encrypted network protocol other than that of the existing command and control channel.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-Object%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.Net.NetworkInformation.Ping%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.Send(%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Import PowerShell Modules From Suspicious Directories
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects powershell scripts that import modules from suspicious directories
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Import-Module "$Env:Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Import-Module ''$Env:Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Import-Module $Env:Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Import-Module "$Env:Appdata\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Import-Module ''$Env:Appdata\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Import-Module $Env:Appdata\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Import-Module C:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ipmo "$Env:Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ipmo ''$Env:Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ipmo $Env:Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ipmo "$Env:Appdata\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ipmo ''$Env:Appdata\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ipmo $Env:Appdata\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ipmo C:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Unsigned AppX Installation Attempt Using Add-AppxPackage - PsScript
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the "Add-AppxPackage" or it's alias "Add-AppPackage" to install unsigned AppX packages
falsepositives: Installation of unsigned packages for testing purposes
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-AppPackage %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-AppxPackage %' ESCAPE '\') AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -AllowUnsigned%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Execute Invoke-command on Remote Host
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Adversaries may use Valid Accounts to interact with remote systems using Windows Remote Management (WinRM). The adversary may then perform actions as the logged-on user.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%invoke-command %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -ComputerName %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Powershell DNSExfiltration
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: DNSExfiltrator allows for transferring (exfiltrate) a file over a DNS request covert channel
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-DNSExfiltrator%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -i %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -d %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -p %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -doh %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -t %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation CLIP+ Launcher - PowerShell
rules.author: Jonathan Cheong, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Obfuscated use of Clip.exe to execute PowerShell
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText REGEXP 'cmd.{0,5}(?:/c|/r).+clip(?:\.exe)?.{0,4}&&.+clipboard]::\(\s\\"\{\d\}.+-f.+"'

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation Obfuscated IEX Invocation - PowerShell
rules.author: Daniel Bohannon (@Mandiant/@FireEye), oscd.community
rules.description: Detects all variations of obfuscated powershell IEX invocation code generated by Invoke-Obfuscation framework from the following code block \u2014
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText REGEXP '\$PSHome\[\s*\d{1,3}\s*\]\s*\+\s*\$PSHome\[' OR ScriptBlockText REGEXP '\$ShellId\[\s*\d{1,3}\s*\]\s*\+\s*\$ShellId\[' OR ScriptBlockText REGEXP '\$env:Public\[\s*\d{1,3}\s*\]\s*\+\s*\$env:Public\[' OR ScriptBlockText REGEXP '\$env:ComSpec\[(\s*\d{1,3}\s*,){2}' OR ScriptBlockText REGEXP '\*mdr\*\W\s*\)\.Name' OR ScriptBlockText REGEXP '\$VerbosePreference\.ToString\('

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation STDIN+ Launcher - Powershell
rules.author: Jonathan Cheong, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Obfuscated use of stdin to execute PowerShell
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText REGEXP 'cmd.{0,5}(?:/c|/r).+powershell.+(?:\$?\{?input\}?|noexit).+"'

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation VAR+ Launcher - PowerShell
rules.author: Jonathan Cheong, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Obfuscated use of Environment Variables to execute PowerShell

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation COMPRESS OBFUSCATION - PowerShell
rules.author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via COMPRESS OBFUSCATION
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%new-object%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%text.encoding]::ascii%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%system.io.compression.deflatestream%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%system.io.streamreader%' ESCAPE '\') AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%readtoend' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation RUNDLL LAUNCHER - PowerShell
rules.author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via RUNDLL LAUNCHER
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%rundll32.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%shell32.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%shellexec\_rundll%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Stdin - Powershell
rules.author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via Stdin in Scripts
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText REGEXP '(?i)(set).*&&\s?set.*(environment|invoke|\$\{?input).*&&.*"'

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use Clip - Powershell
rules.author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use Clip.exe in Scripts
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText REGEXP '(?i)echo.*clip.*&&.*(Clipboard|i`?n`?v`?o`?k`?e`?)'

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use MSHTA - PowerShell
rules.author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use MSHTA in Scripts
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%set%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%&&%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%mshta%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%vbscript:createobject%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.run%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%(window.close)%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use Rundll32 - PowerShell
rules.author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use Rundll32 in Scripts
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%&&%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%shell32.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%shellexec\_rundll%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%value%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%invoke%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%comspec%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%iex%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation VAR++ LAUNCHER OBFUSCATION - PowerShell
rules.author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via VAR++ LAUNCHER
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText REGEXP '(?i)&&set.*(\{\d\}){2,}\\"\s+?-f.*&&.*cmd.*/c'

rules.title: Powershell Keylogging
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Adversaries may log user keystrokes to intercept credentials as the user types them.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-Keystrokes%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ProcAddress user32.dll GetAsyncKeyState%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ProcAddress user32.dll GetForegroundWindow%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Powershell LocalAccount Manipulation
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may manipulate accounts to maintain access to victim systems.
Account manipulation may consist of any action that preserves adversary access to a compromised account, such as modifying credentials or permission groups
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Disable-LocalUser%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Enable-LocalUser%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-LocalUser%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-LocalUser%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-LocalUser%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Rename-LocalUser%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-LocalUser%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious PowerShell Mailbox Export to Share - PS
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the powerShell New-MailboxExportRequest Cmdlet to exports a mailbox to a remote or local share, as used in ProxyShell exploitations
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-MailboxExportRequest%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -Mailbox %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -FilePath \\\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Malicious PowerShell Keywords
rules.author: Sean Metcalf (source), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects keywords from well-known PowerShell exploitation frameworks
falsepositives: Depending on the scripts, this rule might require some initial tuning to fit the environment
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%AdjustTokenPrivileges%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%IMAGE\_NT\_OPTIONAL\_HDR64\_MAGIC%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Metasploit%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Microsoft.Win32.UnsafeNativeMethods%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Mimikatz%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%MiniDumpWriteDump%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%PAGE\_EXECUTE\_READ%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ReadProcessMemory.Invoke%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SE\_PRIVILEGE\_ENABLED%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SECURITY\_DELEGATION%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TOKEN\_ADJUST\_PRIVILEGES%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TOKEN\_ALL\_ACCESS%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TOKEN\_ASSIGN\_PRIMARY%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TOKEN\_DUPLICATE%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TOKEN\_ELEVATION%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TOKEN\_IMPERSONATE%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TOKEN\_INFORMATION\_CLASS%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TOKEN\_PRIVILEGES%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TOKEN\_QUERY%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Live Memory Dump Using Powershell
rules.author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of a PowerShell command to dump the live memory of a Windows machine
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-StorageDiagnosticInfo%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-IncludeLiveDump%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Modify Group Policy Settings - ScriptBlockLogging
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detect malicious GPO modifications can be used to implement many other malicious behaviors.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows\\System%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%GroupPolicyRefreshTimeDC%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%GroupPolicyRefreshTimeOffsetDC%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%GroupPolicyRefreshTime%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%GroupPolicyRefreshTimeOffset%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%EnableSmartScreen%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ShellSmartScreenLevel%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Powershell MsXml COM Object
rules.author: frack113, MatilJ
rules.description:
Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for execution.
PowerShell is a powerful interactive command-line interface and scripting environment included in the Windows operating system. (Citation: TechNet PowerShell)
Adversaries can use PowerShell to perform a number of actions, including discovery of information and execution of code
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-Object%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ComObject%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%MsXml2.%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%XmlHttp%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Malicious Nishang PowerShell Commandlets
rules.author: Alec Costello

rules.title: NTFS Alternate Data Stream
rules.author: Sami Ruohonen
rules.description: Detects writing data into NTFS alternate data streams from powershell. Needs Script Block Logging.
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%set-content%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%add-content%' ESCAPE '\') AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-stream%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Code Executed Via Office Add-in XLL File
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may abuse Microsoft Office add-ins to obtain persistence on a compromised system.
Office add-ins can be used to add functionality to Office programs
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%new-object %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ComObject %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.application%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.RegisterXLL%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Packet Capture Activity Via Start-NetEventSession - ScriptBlock
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Detects the execution of powershell scripts with calls to the "Start-NetEventSession" cmdlet. Which allows an attacker to start event and packet capture for a network event session.
Adversaries may attempt to capture network to gather information over the course of an operation.
Data captured via this technique may include user credentials, especially those sent over an insecure, unencrypted protocol.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Start-NetEventSession%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Invoke-Mimikatz PowerShell Script
rules.author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)
rules.description: Detects Invoke-Mimikatz PowerShell script and alike. Mimikatz is a credential dumper capable of obtaining plaintext Windows account logins and passwords.
falsepositives: Mimikatz can be useful for testing the security of networks
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DumpCreds%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DumpCerts%' ESCAPE '\') OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%sekurlsa::logonpasswords%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%crypto::certificates%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%CERT\_SYSTEM\_STORE\_LOCAL\_MACHINE%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PowerShell Web Access Installation - PsScript
rules.author: Michael Haag
rules.description: Detects the installation and configuration of PowerShell Web Access, which could be used for remote access and potential abuse
falsepositives: Legitimate PowerShell Web Access installations by administrators
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Install-WindowsFeature WindowsPowerShellWebAccess%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Install-PswaWebApplication%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-PswaAuthorizationRule%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-UserName %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ComputerName %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PowerShell Credential Prompt
rules.author: John Lambert (idea), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects PowerShell calling a credential prompt
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%PromptForCredential%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PSAsyncShell - Asynchronous TCP Reverse Shell
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of PSAsyncShell an Asynchronous TCP Reverse Shell written in powershell
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%PSAsyncShell%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PowerShell PSAttack
rules.author: Sean Metcalf (source), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of PSAttack PowerShell hack tool
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%PS ATTACK!!!%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PowerShell Remote Session Creation
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for execution.
PowerShell is a powerful interactive command-line interface and scripting environment included in the Windows operating system
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-PSSession%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ComputerName %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential RemoteFXvGPUDisablement.EXE Abuse - PowerShell ScriptBlock
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects PowerShell module creation where the module Contents are set to "function Get-VMRemoteFXPhysicalVideoAdapter". This could be a sign of potential abuse of the "RemoteFXvGPUDisablement.exe" binary which is known to be vulnerable to module load-order hijacking.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE 'function Get-VMRemoteFXPhysicalVideoAdapter {%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Kerberos Ticket Request via PowerShell Script - ScriptBlock
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Detects PowerShell scripts that utilize native PowerShell Identity modules to request Kerberos tickets.
This behavior is typically seen during a Kerberos or silver ticket attack. A successful execution will output the SPNs for the endpoint in question.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.IdentityModel.Tokens.KerberosRequestorSecurityToken%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.GetRequest()%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PowerShell Script With File Hostname Resolving Capabilities
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects PowerShell scripts that have capabilities to read files, loop through them and resolve DNS host entries.
falsepositives: The same functionality can be implemented by admin scripts, correlate with name and creator
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-content %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%foreach%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[System.Net.Dns]::GetHostEntry%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Out-File%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Root Certificate Installed - PowerShell
rules.author: oscd.community, @redcanary, Zach Stanford @svch0st
rules.description: Adversaries may install a root certificate on a compromised system to avoid warnings when connecting to adversary controlled web servers.
falsepositives: Help Desk or IT may need to manually add a corporate Root CA on occasion. Need to test if GPO push doesn't trigger FP
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Move-Item%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Cert:\\LocalMachine\\Root%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Import-Certificate%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Cert:\\LocalMachine\\Root%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Invoke-Item From Mount-DiskImage
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Adversaries may abuse container files such as disk image (.iso, .vhd) file formats to deliver malicious payloads that may not be tagged with MOTW.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Mount-DiskImage %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ImagePath %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-Volume%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.DriveLetter%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%invoke-item %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%):\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Powershell Sensitive File Discovery
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detect adversaries enumerate sensitive files
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ls%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%get-childitem%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%gci%' ESCAPE '\') AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-recurse%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.pass%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.kdbx%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.kdb%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PowerShell Set-Acl On Windows Folder - PsScript
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects PowerShell scripts to set the ACL to a file in the Windows folder
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-Acl %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-AclObject %' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Path "C:\\Windows%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Path "C:/Windows%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Path ''C:\\Windows%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Path ''C:/Windows%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Path C:\\Windows%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Path C:/Windows%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Path $env:windir%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Path "$env:windir%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Path ''$env:windir%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%FullControl%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Allow%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Change PowerShell Policies to an Insecure Level - PowerShell
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects changing the PowerShell script execution policy to a potentially insecure level using the "Set-ExecutionPolicy" cmdlet.
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-ExecutionPolicy%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Unrestricted%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%bypass%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%(New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadString(''https://community.chocolatey.org/install.ps1'')%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%(New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadString(''https://chocolatey.org/install.ps1'')%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: PowerShell ShellCode
rules.author: David Ledbetter (shellcode), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects Base64 encoded Shellcode
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%OiCAAAAYInlM%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%OiJAAAAYInlM%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Malicious ShellIntel PowerShell Commandlets
rules.author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems), Tobias Michalski (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects Commandlet names from ShellIntel exploitation scripts.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-SMBAutoBrute%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-GPOLinks%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-Potato%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Detected Windows Software Discovery - PowerShell
rules.author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
rules.description: Adversaries may attempt to enumerate software for a variety of reasons, such as figuring out what security measures are present or if the compromised system has a version of software that is vulnerable.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%get-itemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\software\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%select-object%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%format-table%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Powershell Store File In Alternate Data Stream
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Storing files in Alternate Data Stream (ADS) similar to Astaroth malware.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Start-Process%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-FilePath "$env:comspec" %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ArgumentList %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%>%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Persistence Via Security Descriptors - ScriptBlock
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of certain functions and keywords that are used to manipulate security descriptors in order to potentially set a backdoor. As seen used in the DAMP project.
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%win32\_Trustee%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%win32\_Ace%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.AccessMask%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.AceType%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.SetSecurityDescriptor%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\Lsa\\JD%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\Lsa\\Skew1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\Lsa\\Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\Lsa\\GBG%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Eventlog Clear
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of known powershell cmdlets such as "Clear-EventLog" to clear the Windows event logs
falsepositives: Rare need to clear logs before doing something. Sometimes used by installers or cleaner scripts. The script should be investigated to determine if it's legitimate
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Clear-EventLog %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-EventLog %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Limit-EventLog %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Clear-WinEvent %' ESCAPE '\') OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Eventing.Reader.EventLogSession%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ClearLog%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Diagnostics.EventLog%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Clear%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Powershell Directory Enumeration
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects technique used by MAZE ransomware to enumerate directories using Powershell
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%foreach%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ChildItem%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Path %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ErrorAction %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SilentlyContinue%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Out-File %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-append%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious PowerShell Download - Powershell Script
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious PowerShell download command
falsepositives: PowerShell scripts that download content from the Internet
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.Net.WebClient%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.DownloadFile(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.DownloadFileAsync(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.DownloadString(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.DownloadStringAsync(%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Powershell Execute Batch Script
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may abuse the Windows command shell for execution.
The Windows command shell ([cmd](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0106)) is the primary command prompt on Windows systems.
The Windows command prompt can be used to control almost any aspect of a system, with various permission levels required for different subsets of commands.
Batch files (ex: .bat or .cmd) also provide the shell with a list of sequential commands to run, as well as normal scripting operations such as conditionals and loops.
Common uses of batch files include long or repetitive tasks, or the need to run the same set of commands on multiple system
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Start-Process%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.cmd%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.bat%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Extracting Information with PowerShell
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may search local file systems and remote file shares for files containing insecurely stored credentials.
These can be files created by users to store their own credentials, shared credential stores for a group of individuals,
configuration files containing passwords for a system or service, or source code/binary files containing embedded passwords.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ls%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -R%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%select-string %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Pattern %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Troubleshooting Pack Cmdlet Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "TroubleshootingPack" cmdlets to leverage CVE-2022-30190 or action similar to "msdt" lolbin (as described in LOLBAS)
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of "TroubleshootingPack" cmdlet for troubleshooting purposes
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-TroubleshootingPack%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\Diagnostics\\System\\PCW%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-AnswerFile%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Unattended%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PowerShell Get-Process LSASS in ScriptBlock
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a Get-Process command on lsass process, which is in almost all cases a sign of malicious activity
falsepositives: Legitimate certificate exports invoked by administrators or users (depends on processes in the environment - filter if unusable)
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-Process lsass%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious GetTypeFromCLSID ShellExecute
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects suspicious Powershell code that execute COM Objects
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%::GetTypeFromCLSID(%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.ShellExecute(%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Hyper-V Cmdlets
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Adversaries may carry out malicious operations using a virtual instance to avoid detection
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-VM%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-VMFirmware%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Start-VM%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious PowerShell invocation command parameters
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -EncodedCommand %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -ec %' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -w hidden %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -window hidden %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -windowstyle hidden %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -w 1 %' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -noni %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -noninteractive %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Change User Agents with WebRequest
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may communicate using application layer protocols associated with web traffic to avoid detection/network filtering by blending in with existing traffic.
Commands to the remote system, and often the results of those commands, will be embedded within the protocol traffic between the client and server.
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-WebRequest%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-RestMethod%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% irm %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%iwr %' ESCAPE '\') AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-UserAgent %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious IO.FileStream
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Open a handle on the drive volume via the \\.\ DOS device path specifier and perform direct access read of the first few bytes of the volume.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-Object%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%IO.FileStream%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\\\.\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Keylogger Activity
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects PowerShell scripts that contains reference to keystroke capturing functions
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[Windows.Input.Keyboard]::IsKeyDown([System.Windows.Input.Key]::%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Suspicious PowerShell Keywords
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Perez Diego (@darkquassar), Tuan Le (NCSGroup)
rules.description: Detects potentially suspicious keywords that could indicate the use of a PowerShell exploitation framework
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.Reflection.Assembly.Load($%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[System.Reflection.Assembly]::Load($%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[Reflection.Assembly]::Load($%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.Reflection.AssemblyName%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Reflection.Emit.AssemblyBuilderAccess%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Reflection.Emit.CustomAttributeBuilder%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Runtime.InteropServices.UnmanagedType%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Runtime.InteropServices.DllImportAttribute%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SuspendThread%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Powershell Local Email Collection
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may target user email on local systems to collect sensitive information.
Files containing email data can be acquired from a users local system, such as Outlook storage or cache files.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-Inbox.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Microsoft.Office.Interop.Outlook%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Microsoft.Office.Interop.Outlook.olDefaultFolders%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-comobject outlook.application%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PowerShell Deleted Mounted Share
rules.author: oscd.community, @redcanary, Zach Stanford @svch0st
rules.description: Detects when when a mounted share is removed. Adversaries may remove share connections that are no longer useful in order to clean up traces of their operation
falsepositives: Administrators or Power users may remove their shares via cmd line
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-SmbShare%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-FileShare%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%FileShare.cdxml%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Microsoft.PowerShell.Core\\Export-ModuleMember%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ROOT/Microsoft/Windows/Storage/MSFT\_FileShare%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ObjectModelWrapper%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Cmdletization.MethodParameter%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious New-PSDrive to Admin Share
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Adversaries may use to interact with a remote network share using Server Message Block (SMB). The adversary may then perform actions as the logged-on user.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-PSDrive%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-psprovider %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%filesystem%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-root %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%$%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious TCP Tunnel Via PowerShell Script
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects powershell scripts that creates sockets/listeners which could be indicative of tunneling activity
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[System.Net.HttpWebRequest]%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.Net.Sockets.TcpListener%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%AcceptTcpClient%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Recon Information for Export with PowerShell
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Once established within a system or network, an adversary may use automated techniques for collecting internal data
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-Service %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ChildItem %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-Process %' ESCAPE '\') AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%> $env:TEMP\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Remove Account From Domain Admin Group
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may interrupt availability of system and network resources by inhibiting access to accounts utilized by legitimate users.
Accounts may be deleted, locked, or manipulated (ex: changed credentials) to remove access to accounts.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-ADGroupMember%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Identity %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Members %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Service DACL Modification Via Set-Service Cmdlet - PS
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the "Set-Service" powershell cmdlet to configure a new SecurityDescriptor that allows a service to be hidden from other utilities such as "sc.exe", "Get-Service"...etc. (Works only in powershell 7)
falsepositives: Rare intended use of hidden services
Rare FP could occur due to the non linearity of the ScriptBlockText log
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-SecurityDescriptorSddl %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-sd %' ESCAPE '\') AND ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-Service %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%D;;%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%;;;IU%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%;;;SU%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%;;;BA%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%;;;SY%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%;;;WD%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Suspicious Start-Process PassThru
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Powershell use PassThru option to start in background
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Start-Process %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%saps %' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-PassThru %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-FilePath %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Unblock-File
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Remove the Zone.Identifier alternate data stream which identifies the file as downloaded from the internet.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Unblock-File %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Path %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Deletion of Volume Shadow Copies via WMI with PowerShell - PS Script
rules.author: Tim Rauch, frack113
rules.description: Detects deletion of Windows Volume Shadow Copies with PowerShell code and Get-WMIObject. This technique is used by numerous ransomware families such as Sodinokibi/REvil
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-WmiObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%gwmi%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-CimInstance%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%gcim%' ESCAPE '\') AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Win32\_ShadowCopy%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.Delete()%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-WmiObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%rwmi%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-CimInstance%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%rcim%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious PowerShell WindowStyle Option
rules.author: frack113, Tim Shelton (fp AWS)
rules.description:
Adversaries may use hidden windows to conceal malicious activity from the plain sight of users.
In some cases, windows that would typically be displayed when an application carries out an operation can be hidden
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%WindowStyle%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Hidden%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\Amazon\\WorkSpacesConfig\\Scripts\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%$PSScriptRoot\\Module\\WorkspaceScriptModule\\WorkspaceScriptModule%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: PowerShell Write-EventLog Usage
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the "Write-EventLog" cmdlet with 'RawData' flag. The cmdlet can be levreage to write malicious payloads to the EventLog and then retrieve them later for later use
falsepositives: Legitimate applications writing events via this cmdlet. Investigate alerts to determine if the action is benign
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Write-EventLog%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-RawData %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Zip A Folder With PowerShell For Staging In Temp - PowerShell Script
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113
rules.description:
Detects PowerShell scripts that make use of the "Compress-Archive" Cmdlet in order to compress folders and files where the output is stored in a potentially suspicious location that is used often by malware for exfiltration.
An adversary might compress data (e.g., sensitive documents) that is collected prior to exfiltration in order to make it portable and minimize the amount of data sent over the network.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Compress-Archive -Path%-DestinationPath $env:TEMP%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Compress-Archive -Path%-DestinationPath%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Compress-Archive -Path%-DestinationPath%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: SyncAppvPublishingServer Execution to Bypass Powershell Restriction
rules.author: Ensar Şamil, @sblmsrsn, OSCD Community
rules.description: Detects SyncAppvPublishingServer process execution which usually utilized by adversaries to bypass PowerShell execution restrictions.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SyncAppvPublishingServer.exe%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Tamper Windows Defender Remove-MpPreference - ScriptBlockLogging
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects attempts to remove Windows Defender configuration using the 'MpPreference' cmdlet
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ControlledFolderAccessProtectedFolders %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-AttackSurfaceReductionRules\_Ids %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-AttackSurfaceReductionRules\_Actions %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-CheckForSignaturesBeforeRunningScan %' ESCAPE '\')
