Allow%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%stdefac Allow%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Testing Usage of Uncommonly Used Port
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may communicate using a protocol and port paring that are typically not associated.
For example, HTTPS over port 8088(Citation: Symantec Elfin Mar 2019) or port 587(Citation: Fortinet Agent Tesla April 2018) as opposed to the traditional port 443.
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Test-NetConnection%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ComputerName %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-port %' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((ScriptBlockText LIKE '% 443 %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% 80 %' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Powershell Timestomp
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may modify file time attributes to hide new or changes to existing files.
Timestomping is a technique that modifies the timestamps of a file (the modify, access, create, and change times), often to mimic files that are in the same folder.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.CreationTime =%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.LastWriteTime =%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.LastAccessTime =%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[IO.File]::SetCreationTime%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[IO.File]::SetLastAccessTime%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[IO.File]::SetLastWriteTime%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: User Discovery And Export Via Get-ADUser Cmdlet - PowerShell
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the Get-ADUser cmdlet to collect user information and output it to a file
falsepositives: Legitimate admin scripts may use the same technique, it's better to exclude specific computers or users who execute these commands or scripts often
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADUser %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -Filter *%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '% > %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% | Select %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Out-File%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-Content%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-Content%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Persistence Via PowerShell User Profile Using Add-Content
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects calls to "Add-Content" cmdlet in order to modify the content of the user profile and potentially adding suspicious commands for persistence
falsepositives: Legitimate administration and tuning scripts that aim to add functionality to a user PowerShell session
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-Content $profile%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Value "IEX %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Value "Invoke-Expression%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Value "Invoke-WebRequest%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Value "Start-Process%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Value ''IEX %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Value ''Invoke-Expression%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Value ''Invoke-WebRequest%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Value ''Start-Process%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Abuse of Service Permissions to Hide Services Via Set-Service - PS
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the "Set-Service" powershell cmdlet to configure a new SecurityDescriptor that allows a service to be hidden from other utilities such as "sc.exe", "Get-Service"...etc. (Works only in powershell 7)
falsepositives: Rare intended use of hidden services
Rare FP could occur due to the non linearity of the ScriptBlockText log
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-Service %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DCLCWPDTSD%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-SecurityDescriptorSddl %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-sd %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Veeam Backup Servers Credential Dumping Script Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of a PowerShell script that contains calls to the "Veeam.Backup" class, in order to dump stored credentials.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[Credentials]%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[Veeam.Backup.Common.ProtectedStorage]::GetLocalString%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-Sqlcmd%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Veeam Backup and Replication%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Usage Of Web Request Commands And Cmdlets - ScriptBlock
rules.author: James Pemberton / @4A616D6573
rules.description: Detects the use of various web request commands with commandline tools and Windows PowerShell cmdlets (including aliases) via PowerShell scriptblock logs
falsepositives: Use of Get-Command and Get-Help modules to reference Invoke-WebRequest and Start-BitsTransfer.
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[System.Net.WebRequest]::create%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%curl %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-RestMethod%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-WebRequest%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% irm %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%iwr %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Resume-BitsTransfer%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Start-BitsTransfer%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%wget %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%WinHttp.WinHttpRequest%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((Path LIKE 'C:\\Packages\\Plugins\\Microsoft.GuestConfiguration.ConfigurationforWindows\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Call To Win32_NTEventlogFile Class - PSScript
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the WMI class "Win32_NTEventlogFile" in a potentially suspicious way (delete, backup, change permissions, etc.) from a PowerShell script
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Win32\_NTEventlogFile%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.BackupEventlog(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.ChangeSecurityPermissions(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.ChangeSecurityPermissionsEx(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.ClearEventLog(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.Delete(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.DeleteEx(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.Rename(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.TakeOwnerShip(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.TakeOwnerShipEx(%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PowerShell WMI Win32_Product Install MSI
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects the execution of an MSI file using PowerShell and the WMI Win32_Product class
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-CimMethod %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ClassName %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Win32\_Product %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-MethodName %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.msi%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential WinAPI Calls Via PowerShell Scripts
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
rules.description:
Detects usage of WinAPI functions in PowerShell scripts.
It may indicate attempts to perform actions such as process injection, token stealing, or other malicious activities that leverage Windows API calls.
These techniques are commonly used to evade traditional file-based detections by loading and executing code directly in memory.
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%VirtualAlloc%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%OpenProcess%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%WriteProcessMemory%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%CreateRemoteThread%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%OpenProcessToken%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%LookupPrivilegeValue%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%AdjustTokenPrivileges%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%OpenProcessToken%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DuplicateTokenEx%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%CloseHandle%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%WriteProcessMemory%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%VirtualAlloc%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ReadProcessMemory%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%VirtualFree%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%VirtualAlloc%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%GetDelegateForFunctionPointer%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Marshal.Copy%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Windows Defender Exclusions Added - PowerShell
rules.author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)
rules.description: Detects modifications to the Windows Defender configuration settings using PowerShell to add exclusions
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -ExclusionPath %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -ExclusionExtension %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -ExclusionProcess %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -ExclusionIpAddress %' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-MpPreference %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-MpPreference %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Windows Firewall Profile Disabled
rules.author: Austin Songer @austinsonger
rules.description: Detects when a user disables the Windows Firewall via a Profile to help evade defense.
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-NetFirewallProfile %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -Enabled %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '% False%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -All %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Public%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Domain%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Private%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Winlogon Helper DLL
rules.author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
rules.description:
Winlogon.exe is a Windows component responsible for actions at logon/logoff as well as the secure attention sequence (SAS) triggered by Ctrl-Alt-Delete.
Registry entries in HKLM\Software[Wow6432Node]Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\ and HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\ are
used to manage additional helper programs and functionalities that support Winlogon. Malicious modifications to these Registry keys may cause Winlogon to
load and execute malicious DLLs and/or executables.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%CurrentVersion\\Winlogon%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-Item%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Powershell WMI Persistence
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Adversaries may establish persistence and elevate privileges by executing malicious content triggered by a Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) event subscription.
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-CimInstance %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Namespace root/subscription %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ClassName \_\_EventFilter %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Property %' ESCAPE '\') OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-CimInstance %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Namespace root/subscription %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ClassName CommandLineEventConsumer %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Property %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: WMIC Unquoted Services Path Lookup - PowerShell
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects known WMI recon method to look for unquoted service paths, often used by pentest inside of powershell scripts attackers enum scripts
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-WmiObject %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%gwmi %' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '% Win32\_Service %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Name%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DisplayName%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%PathName%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%StartMode%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: WMImplant Hack Tool
rules.author: NVISO
rules.description: Detects parameters used by WMImplant
falsepositives: Administrative scripts that use the same keywords.
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%WMImplant%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% change\_user %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% gen\_cli %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% command\_exec %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% disable\_wdigest %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% disable\_winrm %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% enable\_wdigest %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% enable\_winrm %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% registry\_mod %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% remote\_posh %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% sched\_job %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% service\_mod %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% process\_kill %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% active\_users %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% basic\_info %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% power\_off %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% vacant\_system %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% logon\_events %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious X509Enrollment - Ps Script
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detect use of X509Enrollment
rules.sql: ScriptBlockText LIKE '%X509Enrollment.CBinaryConverter%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%884e2002-217d-11da-b2a4-000e7bbb2b09%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Powershell XML Execute Command
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for execution.
PowerShell is a powerful interactive command-line interface and scripting environment included in the Windows operating system. (Citation: TechNet PowerShell)
Adversaries can use PowerShell to perform a number of actions, including discovery of information and execution of code
rules.sql: (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-Object%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.Xml.XmlDocument%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.Load%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%IEX %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-Expression %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-Command %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ICM -%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: 7Zip Compressing Dump Files
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of 7z in order to compress a file with a ".dmp"/".dump" extension, which could be a step in a process of dump file exfiltration.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of 7z with a command line in which ".dmp" or ".dump" appears accidentally
Legitimate use of 7z to compress WER ".dmp" files for troubleshooting
rules.sql: (Description LIKE '%7-Zip%' ESCAPE '\' OR (Image LIKE '%\\7z.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\7zr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\7za.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='7z.exe' OR OriginalFileName='7za.exe' OR OriginalFileName='7zr.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.dmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dump%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.hdmp%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Compress Data and Lock With Password for Exfiltration With 7-ZIP
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: An adversary may compress or encrypt data that is collected prior to exfiltration using 3rd party utilities
falsepositives: Legitimate activity is expected since compressing files with a password is common.
rules.sql: (Description LIKE '%7-Zip%' ESCAPE '\' OR (Image LIKE '%\\7z.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\7zr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\7za.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='7z.exe' OR OriginalFileName='7za.exe' OR OriginalFileName='7zr.exe')) AND CommandLine LIKE '% -p%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% a %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% u %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential DLL Injection Via AccCheckConsole
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects the execution "AccCheckConsole" a command-line tool for verifying the accessibility implementation of an application's UI.
One of the tests that this checker can run are called "verification routine", which tests for things like Consistency, Navigation, etc.
The tool allows a user to provide a DLL that can contain a custom "verification routine". An attacker can build such DLLs and pass it via the CLI, which would then be loaded in the context of the "AccCheckConsole" utility.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of the UI Accessibility Checker
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\AccCheckConsole.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='AccCheckConsole.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -hwnd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -process %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -window %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious AddinUtil.EXE CommandLine Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Michael McKinley (@McKinleyMike), Tony Latteri (@TheLatteri)
rules.description: Detects execution of the Add-In deployment cache updating utility (AddInutil.exe) with suspicious Addinroot or Pipelineroot paths. An adversary may execute AddinUtil.exe with uncommon Addinroot/Pipelineroot paths that point to the adversaries Addins.Store payload.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\addinutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='AddInUtil.exe') AND (((CommandLine LIKE '%-AddInRoot:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-PipelineRoot:%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%-AddInRoot:.%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-AddInRoot:"."%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-PipelineRoot:.%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-PipelineRoot:"."%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CurrentDirectory LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CurrentDirectory LIKE '%\\Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CurrentDirectory LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CurrentDirectory LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CurrentDirectory LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')))

rules.title: Uncommon Child Process Of AddinUtil.EXE
rules.author: Michael McKinley (@McKinleyMike), Tony Latteri (@TheLatteri)
rules.description: Detects uncommon child processes of the Add-In deployment cache updating utility (AddInutil.exe) which could be a sign of potential abuse of the binary to proxy execution via a custom Addins.Store payload.
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\addinutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\werfault.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\werfault.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Uncommon AddinUtil.EXE CommandLine Execution
rules.author: Michael McKinley (@McKinleyMike), Tony Latteri (@TheLatteri)
rules.description: Detects execution of the Add-In deployment cache updating utility (AddInutil.exe) with uncommon Addinroot or Pipelineroot paths. An adversary may execute AddinUtil.exe with uncommon Addinroot/Pipelineroot paths that point to the adversaries Addins.Store payload.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\addinutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='AddInUtil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-AddInRoot:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-PipelineRoot:%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%-AddInRoot:"C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Common Files\\Microsoft Shared\\VSTA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-AddInRoot:C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Common Files\\Microsoft Shared\\VSTA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-PipelineRoot:"C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Common Files\\Microsoft Shared\\VSTA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-PipelineRoot:C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Common Files\\Microsoft Shared\\VSTA%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: AddinUtil.EXE Execution From Uncommon Directory
rules.author: Michael McKinley (@McKinleyMike), Tony Latteri (@TheLatteri)
rules.description: Detects execution of the Add-In deployment cache updating utility (AddInutil.exe) from a non-standard directory.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\addinutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='AddInUtil.exe') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework64\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\FrameworkArm\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\FrameworkArm64\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Potential Adplus.EXE Abuse
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "AdPlus.exe", a binary that is part of the Windows SDK that can be used as a LOLBIN in order to dump process memory and execute arbitrary commands.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of Adplus for debugging purposes
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\adplus.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Adplus.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -hang %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -pn %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -pmn %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -p %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -po %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -sc %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: AgentExecutor PowerShell Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), memory-shards
rules.description: Detects execution of the AgentExecutor.exe binary. Which can be abused as a LOLBIN to execute powershell scripts with the ExecutionPolicy "Bypass" or any binary named "powershell.exe" located in the path provided by 6th positional argument
falsepositives: Legitimate use via Intune management. You exclude script paths and names to reduce FP rate
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '\\AgentExecutor.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='AgentExecutor.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -remediationScript%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%\\Microsoft.Management.Services.IntuneWindowsAgent.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious AgentExecutor PowerShell Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), memory-shards
rules.description: Detects execution of the AgentExecutor.exe binary. Which can be abused as a LOLBIN to execute powershell scripts with the ExecutionPolicy "Bypass" or any binary named "powershell.exe" located in the path provided by 6th positional argument
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\AgentExecutor.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='AgentExecutor.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -remediationScript%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\Microsoft.Management.Services.IntuneWindowsAgent.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Uncommon Child Process Of Appvlp.EXE
rules.author: Sreeman
rules.description:
Detects uncommon child processes of Appvlp.EXE
Appvlp or the Application Virtualization Utility is included with Microsoft Office. Attackers are able to abuse "AppVLP" to execute shell commands.
Normally, this binary is used for Application Virtualization, but it can also be abused to circumvent the ASR file path rule folder
or to mark a file as a system file.
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\appvlp.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE(((Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Office%' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\msoasb.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR ((Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Office%' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\SkypeSrv\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%\\SKYPESERVER.EXE' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Office%' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\MSOUC.EXE' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: AspNetCompiler Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects execution of "aspnet_compiler.exe" which can be abused to compile and execute C# code.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework64\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\FrameworkArm\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\FrameworkArm64\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%\\aspnet\_compiler.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Child Process of AspNetCompiler
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects potentially suspicious child processes of "aspnet_compiler.exe".
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\aspnet\_compiler.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ((Image LIKE '%\\calc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\notepad.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Roaming\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious ASP.NET Compilation Via AspNetCompiler
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "aspnet_compiler.exe" with potentially suspicious paths for compilation.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework64\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\FrameworkArm\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\FrameworkArm64\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%\\aspnet\_compiler.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Roaming\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Interactive AT Job
rules.author: E.M. Anhaus (originally from Atomic Blue Detections, Endgame), oscd.community
rules.description: Detects an interactive AT job, which may be used as a form of privilege escalation.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\at.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%interactive%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Uncommon  Assistive Technology Applications Execution Via AtBroker.EXE
rules.author: Mateusz Wydra, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects the start of a non built-in assistive technology applications via "Atbroker.EXE".
falsepositives: Legitimate, non-default assistive technology applications execution
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\AtBroker.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='AtBroker.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%start%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%animations%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%audiodescription%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%caretbrowsing%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%caretwidth%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%colorfiltering%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cursorindicator%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cursorscheme%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%filterkeys%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%focusborderheight%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%focusborderwidth%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%highcontrast%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%keyboardcues%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%keyboardpref%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%livecaptions%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%magnifierpane%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%messageduration%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%minimumhitradius%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mousekeys%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Narrator%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%osk%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%overlappedcontent%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%showsounds%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%soundsentry%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%speechreco%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%stickykeys%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%togglekeys%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%voiceaccess%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%windowarranging%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%windowtracking%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%windowtrackingtimeout%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%windowtrackingzorder%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%Oracle\_JavaAccessBridge%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Hiding Files with Attrib.exe
rules.author: Sami Ruohonen
rules.description: Detects usage of attrib.exe to hide files from users.
falsepositives: IgfxCUIService.exe hiding *.cui files via .bat script (attrib.exe a child of cmd.exe and igfxCUIService.exe is the parent of the cmd.exe)
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\attrib.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='ATTRIB.EXE') AND CommandLine LIKE '% +h %' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%\\desktop.ini %' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '+R +H +S +A \\*.cui' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE 'C:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\*.bat' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Set Suspicious Files as System Files Using Attrib.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the usage of attrib with the "+s" option to set scripts or executables located in suspicious locations as system files to hide them from users and make them unable to be deleted with simple rights. The rule limits the search to specific extensions and directories to avoid FPs
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\attrib.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='ATTRIB.EXE') AND CommandLine LIKE '% +s%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% \%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.hta%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\TEMP\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Audit Policy Tampering Via NT Resource Kit Auditpol
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Threat actors can use an older version of the auditpol binary available inside the NT resource kit to change audit policy configuration to impair detection capability.
This can be carried out by selectively disabling/removing certain audit policies as well as restoring a custom policy owned by the threat actor.
falsepositives: The old auditpol utility isn't available by default on recent versions of Windows as it was replaced by a newer version. The FP rate should be very low except for tools that use a similar flag structure
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%/logon:none%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/system:none%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/sam:none%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/privilege:none%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/object:none%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/process:none%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/policy:none%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Audit Policy Tampering Via Auditpol
rules.author: Janantha Marasinghe (https://github.com/blueteam0ps)
rules.description:
Threat actors can use auditpol binary to change audit policy configuration to impair detection capability.
This can be carried out by selectively disabling/removing certain audit policies as well as restoring a custom policy owned by the threat actor.
falsepositives: Administrator or administrator scripts might leverage the flags mentioned in the detection section. Either way, it should always be monitored
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\auditpol.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='AUDITPOL.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%disable%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%clear%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%remove%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%restore%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Indirect Inline Command Execution Via Bash.EXE
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Detects execution of Microsoft bash launcher with the "-c" flag.
This can be used to potentially bypass defenses and execute Linux or Windows-based binaries directly via bash.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='Bash.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Indirect Command Execution From Script File Via Bash.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects execution of Microsoft bash launcher without any flags to execute the content of a bash script directly.
This can be used to potentially bypass defenses and execute Linux or Windows-based binaries directly via bash.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='Bash.exe') AND (NOT COALESCE(((CommandLine LIKE '%bash.exe -%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%bash -%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine IS NULL OR CommandLine='' OR (CommandLine='bash.exe' OR CommandLine='bash')), 0))

rules.title: Boot Configuration Tampering Via Bcdedit.EXE
rules.author: E.M. Anhaus (originally from Atomic Blue Detections, Endgame), oscd.community
rules.description: Detects the use of the bcdedit command to tamper with the boot configuration data. This technique is often times used by malware or attackers as a destructive way before launching ransomware.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\bcdedit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='bcdedit.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%set%' ESCAPE '\' AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%bootstatuspolicy%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ignoreallfailures%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%recoveryenabled%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%no%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Potential Ransomware or Unauthorized MBR Tampering Via Bcdedit.EXE
rules.author: @neu5ron
rules.description: Detects potential malicious and unauthorized usage of bcdedit.exe
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\bcdedit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='bcdedit.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%delete%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%deletevalue%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%import%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%safeboot%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%network%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Data Export From MSSQL Table Via BCP.EXE
rules.author: Omar Khaled (@beacon_exe), MahirAli Khan (in/mahiralikhan), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects the execution of the BCP utility in order to export data from the database.
Attackers were seen saving their malware to a database column or table and then later extracting it via "bcp.exe" into a file.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\bcp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='BCP.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% out %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% queryout %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Child Process Of BgInfo.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious child processes of "BgInfo.exe" which could be a sign of potential abuse of the binary to proxy execution via external VBScript
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\bginfo.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\bginfo64.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((Image LIKE '%\\calc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\notepad.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\PerfLogs\\%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: File Download Via Bitsadmin
rules.author: Michael Haag, FPT.EagleEye
rules.description: Detects usage of bitsadmin downloading a file
falsepositives: Some legitimate apps use this, but limited.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='bitsadmin.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /transfer %' ESCAPE '\' OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% /create %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /addfile %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Suspicious Download From Direct IP Via Bitsadmin
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of bitsadmin downloading a file using an URL that contains an IP
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='bitsadmin.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /transfer %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /create %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /addfile %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%://1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://2%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://3%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://4%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://5%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://6%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://7%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://8%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://9%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%://7-%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Download From File-Sharing Website Via Bitsadmin
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of bitsadmin downloading a file from a suspicious domain
falsepositives: Some legitimate apps use this, but limited.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='bitsadmin.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /transfer %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /create %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /addfile %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.githubusercontent.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%0x0.st%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%anonfiles.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%bashupload.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cdn.discordapp.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%chunk.io%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ddns.net%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dl.dropboxusercontent.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ghostbin.co%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%github.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%glitch.me%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%gofile.io%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%hastebin.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mediafire.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mega.nz%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%onrender.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%pages.dev%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%paste.ee%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%pastebin.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%pastebin.pl%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%pastetext.net%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%privatlab.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%privatlab.net%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%send.exploit.in%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%sendspace.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%storage.googleapis.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%storjshare.io%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%supabase.co%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%temp.sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%transfer.sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%trycloudflare.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ufile.io%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%w3spaces.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%workers.dev%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%x0.at%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: File With Suspicious Extension Downloaded Via Bitsadmin
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of bitsadmin downloading a file with a suspicious extension
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='bitsadmin.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /transfer %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /create %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /addfile %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.7z%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.asax%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ashx%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.asmx%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.asp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.aspx%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.cfm%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.cgi%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.chm%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.cmd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.gif%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpeg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jsp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jspx%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.log%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.png%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.psm1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.rar%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.scf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.sct%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.txt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.war%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.wsf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.wsh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.xll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.zip%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: File Download Via Bitsadmin To A Suspicious Target Folder
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of bitsadmin downloading a file to a suspicious target folder
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='bitsadmin.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /transfer %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /create %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /addfile %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Perflogs%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\$Recycle.Bin\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Contacts\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Favorites\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Favourites\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\inetpub\\wwwroot\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Music\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Pictures\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Start Menu\\Programs\\Startup\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Default\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Videos\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%ProgramData\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%public\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%temp\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%tmp\%%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Monitoring For Persistence Via BITS
rules.author: Sreeman
rules.description:
BITS will allow you to schedule a command to execute after a successful download to notify you that the job is finished.
When the job runs on the system the command specified in the BITS job will be executed.
This can be abused by actors to create a backdoor within the system and for persistence.
It will be chained in a BITS job to schedule the download of malware/additional binaries and execute the program after being downloaded.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='bitsadmin.exe') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%/SetNotifyCmdLine%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\%COMSPEC\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%regsvr32.exe%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/Addfile%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ftp:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ftps:%' ESCAPE '\')))

rules.title: Potential Data Stealing Via Chromium Headless Debugging
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects chromium based browsers starting in headless and debugging mode and pointing to a user profile. This could be a sign of data stealing or remote control
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%--remote-debugging-%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--user-data-dir%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--headless%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: File Download with Headless Browser
rules.author: Sreeman, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of chromium based browser in headless mode using the "dump-dom" command line to download files
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\brave.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\chrome.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\msedge.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\opera.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\vivaldi.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--headless%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%dump-dom%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((((Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft\\EdgeCore\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft\\EdgeWebView\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft\\EdgeCore\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft\\EdgeWebView\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\WindowsApps\\Microsoft.MicrosoftEdge%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Image LIKE '%\\msedge.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\msedgewebview2.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\MicrosoftEdge.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%--headless --disable-gpu --disable-extensions --disable-plugins --mute-audio --no-first-run --incognito --aggressive-cache-discard --dump-dom%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((Image LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\WindowsApps\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Windows\\SystemApps\\Microsoft.MicrosoftEdge%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Image LIKE '%\\msedge.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\MicrosoftEdge.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%--headless --disable-gpu --disable-extensions --disable-plugins --mute-audio --no-first-run --incognito --aggressive-cache-discard --dump-dom%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Chromium Browser Instance Executed With Custom Extension
rules.author: Aedan Russell, frack113, X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a Chromium based browser process with the 'load-extension' flag to start a instance with a custom extension
falsepositives: Usage of Chrome Extensions in testing tools such as BurpSuite will trigger this alert
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\brave.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\chrome.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\msedge.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\opera.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\vivaldi.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%--load-extension=%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Chromium Browser Headless Execution To Mockbin Like Site
rules.author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of a Chromium based browser process with the "headless" flag and a URL pointing to the mockbin.org service (which can be used to exfiltrate data).
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\brave.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\chrome.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\msedge.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\opera.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\vivaldi.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%--headless%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%://run.mocky%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://mockbin%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Chromium Browser Instance Executed With Custom Extension
rules.author: Aedan Russell, frack113, X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a suspicious process spawning a Chromium based browser process with the 'load-extension' flag to start an instance with a custom extension
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (Image LIKE '%\\brave.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\chrome.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\msedge.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\opera.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\vivaldi.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%--load-extension=%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: File Download From Browser Process Via Inline URL
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of a browser process with a URL argument pointing to a file with a potentially interesting extension. This can be abused to download arbitrary files or to hide from the user for example by launching the browser in a minimized state.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\brave.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\chrome.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\msedge.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\opera.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\vivaldi.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\' AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%.7z' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dat' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.hta' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ps1' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.psm1' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.txt' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbe' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.zip' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.7z"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dat"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.hta"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ps1"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.psm1"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.txt"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbe"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.zip"%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Browser Started with Remote Debugging
rules.author: pH-T (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects browsers starting with the remote debugging flags. Which is a technique often used to perform browser injection attacks
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '% --remote-debugging-%' ESCAPE '\' OR (Image LIKE '%\\firefox.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -start-debugger-server%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Tor Client/Browser Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects the use of Tor or Tor-Browser to connect to onion routing networks
rules.sql: Description='Tor Browser' OR Product='Tor Browser' OR (Image LIKE '%\\tor.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Tor Browser\\Browser\\firefox.exe' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Calculator Usage
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious use of 'calc.exe' with command line parameters or in a suspicious directory, which is likely caused by some PoC or detection evasion.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%\\calc.exe %' ESCAPE '\' OR (Image LIKE '%\\calc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))

rules.title: Potential Binary Proxy Execution Via Cdb.EXE
rules.author: Beyu Denis, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of "cdb.exe" to launch arbitrary processes or commands from a debugger script file
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\cdb.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CDB.Exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -cf %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: New Root Certificate Installed Via CertMgr.EXE
rules.author: oscd.community, @redcanary, Zach Stanford @svch0st
rules.description:
Detects execution of "certmgr" with the "add" flag in order to install a new certificate on the system.
Adversaries may install a root certificate on a compromised system to avoid warnings when connecting to adversary controlled web servers.
falsepositives: Help Desk or IT may need to manually add a corporate Root CA on occasion. Need to test if GPO push doesn't trigger FP
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\CertMgr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CERTMGT.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/add%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%root%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: File Download via CertOC.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects when a user downloads a file by using CertOC.exe
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\certoc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertOC.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-GetCACAPS%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: File Download From IP Based URL Via CertOC.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects when a user downloads a file from an IP based URL using CertOC.exe
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\certoc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertOC.exe') AND CommandLine REGEXP '://[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-GetCACAPS%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: DLL Loaded via CertOC.EXE
rules.author: Austin Songer @austinsonger
rules.description: Detects when a user installs certificates by using CertOC.exe to loads the target DLL file.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\certoc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertOC.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -LoadDLL %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /LoadDLL %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –LoadDLL %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —LoadDLL %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―LoadDLL %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious DLL Loaded via CertOC.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects when a user installs certificates by using CertOC.exe to load the target DLL file.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\certoc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertOC.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -LoadDLL %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /LoadDLL %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –LoadDLL %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —LoadDLL %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―LoadDLL %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Appdata\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: New Root Certificate Installed Via Certutil.EXE
rules.author: oscd.community, @redcanary, Zach Stanford @svch0st
rules.description:
Detects execution of "certutil" with the "addstore" flag in order to install a new certificate on the system.
Adversaries may install a root certificate on a compromised system to avoid warnings when connecting to adversary controlled web servers.
falsepositives: Help Desk or IT may need to manually add a corporate Root CA on occasion. Need to test if GPO push doesn't trigger FP
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertUtil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-addstore%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/addstore%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–addstore%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—addstore%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―addstore%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%root%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: File Decoded From Base64/Hex Via Certutil.EXE
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects the execution of certutil with either the "decode" or "decodehex" flags to decode base64 or hex encoded files. This can be abused by attackers to decode an encoded payload before execution
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertUtil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-decode %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/decode %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–decode %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—decode %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―decode %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-decodehex %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/decodehex %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–decodehex %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—decodehex %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―decodehex %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Download Via Certutil.EXE
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of certutil with certain flags that allow the utility to download files.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertUtil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%urlcache %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%verifyctl %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%URL %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious File Downloaded From Direct IP Via Certutil.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of certutil with certain flags that allow the utility to download files from direct IPs.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertUtil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%urlcache %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%verifyctl %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%URL %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%://1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://2%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://3%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://4%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://5%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://6%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://7%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://8%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://9%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%://7-%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious File Downloaded From File-Sharing Website Via Certutil.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of certutil with certain flags that allow the utility to download files from file-sharing websites.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertUtil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%urlcache %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%verifyctl %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%URL %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.githubusercontent.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%0x0.st%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%anonfiles.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%bashupload.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cdn.discordapp.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%chunk.io%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ddns.net%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dl.dropboxusercontent.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ghostbin.co%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%github.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%glitch.me%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%gofile.io%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%hastebin.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mediafire.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mega.nz%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%onrender.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%pages.dev%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%paste.ee%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%pastebin.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%pastebin.pl%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%pastetext.net%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%privatlab.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%privatlab.net%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%send.exploit.in%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%sendspace.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%storage.googleapis.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%storjshare.io%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%supabase.co%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%temp.sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%transfer.sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%trycloudflare.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ufile.io%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%w3spaces.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%workers.dev%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%x0.at%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: File Encoded To Base64 Via Certutil.EXE
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of certutil with the "encode" flag to encode a file to base64. This can be abused by threat actors and attackers for data exfiltration
falsepositives: As this is a general purpose rule, legitimate usage of the encode functionality will trigger some false positives. Apply additional filters accordingly
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertUtil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―encode%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious File Encoded To Base64 Via Certutil.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of certutil with the "encode" flag to encode a file to base64 where the extensions of the file is suspicious
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertUtil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―encode%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.acl%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.doc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.gif%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpeg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.mp3%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.pdf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.png%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ppt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.tmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.xls%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.xml%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: File In Suspicious Location Encoded To Base64 Via Certutil.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of certutil with the "encode" flag to encode a file to base64 where the files are located in potentially suspicious locations
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertUtil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―encode%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\PerfLogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%$Recycle.Bin%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Certificate Exported Via Certutil.EXE
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of the certutil with the "exportPFX" flag which allows the utility to export certificates.
falsepositives: There legitimate reasons to export certificates. Investigate the activity to determine if it's benign
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertUtil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-exportPFX %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/exportPFX %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–exportPFX %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—exportPFX %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―exportPFX %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential NTLM Coercion Via Certutil.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects possible NTLM coercion via certutil using the 'syncwithWU' flag
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertUtil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -syncwithWU %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% \\\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Console CodePage Lookup Via CHCP
rules.author: _pete_0, TheDFIRReport
rules.description: Detects use of chcp to look up the system locale value as part of host discovery
falsepositives: During Anaconda update the 'conda.exe' process will eventually execution the 'chcp' command.
Discord was seen using chcp to look up code pages
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentCommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% –c %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% —c %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% ―c %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% -r %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% /r %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% –r %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% —r %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% ―r %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% -k %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% /k %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% –k %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% —k %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% ―k %' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%\\chcp.com' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%chcp' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%chcp ' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%chcp  ' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious CodePage Switch Via CHCP
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects a code page switch in command line or batch scripts to a rare language
falsepositives: Administrative activity (adjust code pages according to your organization's region)
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\chcp.com' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% 936' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% 1258' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Deleted Data Overwritten Via Cipher.EXE
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Detects usage of the "cipher" built-in utility in order to overwrite deleted data from disk.
Adversaries may destroy data and files on specific systems or in large numbers on a network to interrupt availability to systems, services, and network resources.
Data destruction is likely to render stored data irrecoverable by forensic techniques through overwriting files or data on local and remote drives
rules.sql: (OriginalFileName='CIPHER.EXE' OR Image LIKE '%\\cipher.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '% /w:%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Process Access via TrolleyExpress Exclusion
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a possible process memory dump that uses the white-listed Citrix TrolleyExpress.exe filename as a way to dump the lsass process memory
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%\\TrolleyExpress 7%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\TrolleyExpress 8%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\TrolleyExpress 9%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\TrolleyExpress.exe 7%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\TrolleyExpress.exe 8%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\TrolleyExpress.exe 9%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\TrolleyExpress.exe -ma %' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\TrolleyExpress.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((OriginalFileName LIKE '%CtxInstall%' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName IS NULL), 0)))

rules.title: Cloudflared Portable Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of the "cloudflared" binary from a non standard location.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of Cloudflared portable versions
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\cloudflared.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\cloudflared\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\cloudflared\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Cloudflared Quick Tunnel Execution
rules.author: Sajid Nawaz Khan
rules.description:
Detects creation of an ad-hoc Cloudflare Quick Tunnel, which can be used to tunnel local services such as HTTP, RDP, SSH and SMB.
The free TryCloudflare Quick Tunnel will generate a random subdomain on trycloudflare[.]com, following a call to api[.]trycloudflare[.]com.
The tool has been observed in use by threat groups including Akira ransomware.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of Cloudflare Quick Tunnel
rules.sql: (((Image LIKE '%\\cloudflared.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cloudflared-windows-386.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cloudflared-windows-amd64.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=2fb6c04c4f95fb8d158af94c137f90ac820716deaf88d8ebec956254e046cb29%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=b3d21940a10fdef5e415ad70331ce257c24fe3bcf7722262302e0421791f87e8%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes
