rules.title: Cloudflared Tunnel Connections Cleanup
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of the "cloudflared" tool with the tunnel "cleanup" flag in order to cleanup tunnel connections.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '% tunnel %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%cleanup %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-config %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-connector-id %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Cloudflared Tunnel Execution
rules.author: Janantha Marasinghe, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of the "cloudflared" tool to connect back to a tunnel. This was seen used by threat actors to maintain persistence and remote access to compromised networks.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '% tunnel %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% run %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-config %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-credentials-contents %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-credentials-file %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-token %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Change Default File Association To Executable Via Assoc
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects when a program changes the default file association of any extension to an executable.
When a file is opened, the default program used to open the file (also called the file association or handler) is checked. File association selections are stored in the Windows Registry and can be edited by users, administrators, or programs that have Registry access or by administrators using the built-in assoc utility. Applications can modify the file association for a given file extension to call an arbitrary program when a file with the given extension is opened.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%assoc %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%exefile%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%.exe=exefile%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Copy .DMP/.DUMP Files From Remote Share Via Cmd.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the copy builtin cmd command to copy files with the ".dmp"/".dump" extension from a remote share
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%copy %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% \\\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.dmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dump%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.hdmp%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Curl Download And Execute Combination
rules.author: Sreeman, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Adversaries can use curl to download payloads remotely and execute them. Curl is included by default in Windows 10 build 17063 and later.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―c %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%curl %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-o%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%&%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Greedy File Deletion Using Del
rules.author: frack113 , X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of the "del" builtin command to remove files using greedy/wildcard expression. This is often used by malware to delete content of folders that perhaps contains the initial malware infection or to delete evidence.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%del %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%erase %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\*.au3%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\*.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\*.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\*.js%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Dosfuscation Activity
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects possible payload obfuscation via the commandline
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%^^%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%^|^%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%,;,%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%;;;;%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%;; ;;%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%(,(,%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%COMSPEC:~%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% c^m^d%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%^c^m^d%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% c^md%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% cm^d%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%^cm^d%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% s^et %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% s^e^t %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% se^t %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Command Line Execution with Suspicious URL and AppData Strings
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects a suspicious command line execution that includes an URL and AppData string in the command line parameters as used by several droppers (js/vbs > powershell)
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%://%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\%AppData\%%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Privilege Escalation Using Symlink Between Osk and Cmd
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects the creation of a symbolic link between "cmd.exe" and the accessibility on-screen keyboard binary (osk.exe) using "mklink". This technique provides an elevated command prompt to the user from the login screen without the need to log in.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%mklink%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\osk.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\cmd.exe%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: VolumeShadowCopy Symlink Creation Via Mklink
rules.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov, oscd.community
rules.description: Shadow Copies storage symbolic link creation using operating systems utilities
falsepositives: Legitimate administrator working with shadow copies, access for backup purposes
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%mklink%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious File Execution From Internet Hosted WebDav Share
rules.author: pH-T (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of the "net use" command to mount a WebDAV server and then immediately execute some content in it. As seen being used in malicious LNK files
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% net use http%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%& start /b %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\DavWWWRoot\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.exe %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bat %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ps1 %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Cmd.EXE Missing Space Characters Execution Anomaly
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects Windows command lines that miss a space before or after the /c flag when running a command using the cmd.exe.
This could be a sign of obfuscation of a fat finger problem (typo by the developer).
falsepositives: Legitimate use of cmd.exe with no arguments e.g. via system("") in C to enable ANSI escape codes
rules.sql: ((CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe/c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\cmd/c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%"cmd/c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe/k%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\cmd/k%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%"cmd/k%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe/r%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\cmd/r%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%"cmd/r%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/cwhoami%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/cpowershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/cschtasks%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/cbitsadmin%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/ccertutil%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/kwhoami%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/kpowershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/kschtasks%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/kbitsadmin%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/kcertutil%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /k%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /k%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /r%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /r%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /k %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /k %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /r %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /r %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%AppData\\Local\\Programs\\Microsoft VS Code\\resources\\app\\node\_modules%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe/c .' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine='cmd.exe /c' OR CommandLine='cmd /c')), 0))

rules.title: NtdllPipe Like Activity Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects command that type the content of ntdll.dll to a different file or a pipe in order to evade AV / EDR detection. As seen being used in the POC NtdllPipe
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%type \%windir\%\\system32\\ntdll.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%type \%systemroot\%\\system32\\ntdll.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%type c:\\windows\\system32\\ntdll.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\ntdll.dll > \\\\.\\pipe\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential CommandLine Path Traversal Via Cmd.EXE
rules.author: xknow @xknow_infosec, Tim Shelton
rules.description: Detects potential path traversal attempt via cmd.exe. Could indicate possible command/argument confusion/hijacking
falsepositives: Java tools are known to produce false-positive when loading libraries
rules.sql: ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='cmd.exe') AND ((ParentCommandLine LIKE '%/c%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%/k%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%/r%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/k%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/r%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (ParentCommandLine='/../../' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/../../%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%\\Tasktop\\keycloak\\bin\\/../../jre\\bin\\java%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Ping/Copy Command Combination
rules.author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects uncommon and potentially suspicious one-liner command containing both "ping" and "copy" at the same time, which is usually used by malware.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ping%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%copy %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―n %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -y %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /y %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –y %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —y %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―y %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Ping/Del Command Combination
rules.author: Ilya Krestinichev
rules.description: Detects a method often used by ransomware. Which combines the "ping" to wait a couple of seconds and then "del" to delete the file in question. Its used to hide the file responsible for the initial infection for example
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '% -n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―n %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%Nul%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -f %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /f %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –f %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —f %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―f %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -q %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /q %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –q %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —q %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―q %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ping%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%del %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious CMD Shell Output Redirect
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects inline Windows shell commands redirecting output via the ">" symbol to a suspicious location.
This technique is sometimes used by malicious actors in order to redirect the output of reconnaissance commands such as "hostname" and "dir" to files for future exfiltration.
falsepositives: Legitimate admin or third party scripts used for diagnostic collection might generate some false positives
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%>_\%APPDATA\%\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%>_\%TEMP\%\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%>_\%TMP\%\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%>_\%USERPROFILE\%\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%>_C:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%>_C:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%>_C:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%>_C:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% >%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%">%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%''>%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\%' ESCAPE '\')))

rules.title: Copy From VolumeShadowCopy Via Cmd.EXE
rules.author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems), Tobias Michalski (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of the builtin "copy" command that targets a shadow copy (sometimes used to copy registry hives that are in use)
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%copy %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\?\\GLOBALROOT\\Device\\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Read Contents From Stdin Via Cmd.EXE
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detect the use of "<" to read and potentially execute a file via cmd.exe
rules.sql: (OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%<%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Sticky Key Like Backdoor Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), @twjackomo, Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects the usage and installation of a backdoor that uses an option to register a malicious debugger for built-in tools that are accessible in the login screen
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\winlogon.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wt.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%sethc.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%utilman.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%osk.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Magnify.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Narrator.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisplaySwitch.exe%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Persistence Via Sticky Key Backdoor
rules.author: Sreeman
rules.description:
By replacing the sticky keys executable with the local admins CMD executable, an attacker is able to access a privileged windows console session without authenticating to the system.
When the sticky keys are "activated" the privilleged shell is launched.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%copy %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/y %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\windows\\system32\\cmd.exe C:\\windows\\system32\\sethc.exe%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Download/Upload Activity Using Type Command
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the "type" command to download/upload data from WebDAV server
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%type %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% > \\\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%type \\\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% > %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Unusual Parent Process For Cmd.EXE
rules.author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)
rules.description: Detects suspicious parent process for cmd.exe
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentImage LIKE '%\\csrss.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\ctfmon.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\dllhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\epad.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\FlashPlayerUpdateService.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\GoogleUpdate.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\jucheck.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\jusched.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\LogonUI.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\lsass.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\SearchIndexer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\SearchProtocolHost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\SIHClient.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\sihost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\slui.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\spoolsv.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\sppsvc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\taskhostw.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\unsecapp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\WerFault.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\wermgr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\wlanext.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\WUDFHost.exe' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: New Generic Credentials Added Via Cmdkey.EXE
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects usage of "cmdkey.exe" to add generic credentials.
As an example, this can be used before connecting to an RDP session via command line interface.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\cmdkey.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='cmdkey.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -g%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /g%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –g%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —g%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―g%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -u%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /u%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –u%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —u%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―u%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -p%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /p%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –p%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —p%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―p%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Reconnaissance For Cached Credentials Via Cmdkey.EXE
rules.author: jmallette, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of cmdkey to look for cached credentials on the system
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\cmdkey.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='cmdkey.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -l%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /l%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –l%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —l%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―l%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Arbitrary File Download Via Cmdl32.EXE
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Detects execution of Cmdl32 with the "/vpn" and "/lan" flags.
Attackers can abuse this utility in order to download arbitrary files via a configuration file.
Inspect the location and the content of the file passed as an argument in order to determine if it is suspicious.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\cmdl32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CMDL32.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/vpn%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/lan%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Arbitrary File Download Via ConfigSecurityPolicy.EXE
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Detects the execution of "ConfigSecurityPolicy.EXE", a binary part of Windows Defender used to manage settings in Windows Defender.
Users can configure different pilot collections for each of the co-management workloads.
It can be abused by attackers in order to upload or download files.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%ConfigSecurityPolicy.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\ConfigSecurityPolicy.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='ConfigSecurityPolicy.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Powershell Executed From Headless ConHost Process
rules.author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)
rules.description:
Detects the use of powershell commands from headless ConHost window.
The "--headless" flag hides the windows from the user upon execution.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CONHOST.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--headless%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Conhost.exe CommandLine Path Traversal
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: detects the usage of path traversal in conhost.exe indicating possible command/argument confusion/hijacking
rules.sql: ParentCommandLine LIKE '%conhost%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/../../%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Uncommon Child Process Of Conhost.EXE
rules.author: omkar72
rules.description: Detects uncommon "conhost" child processes. This could be a sign of "conhost" usage as a LOLBIN or potential process injection activity.
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image IS NULL OR Image=''), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((Provider_Name='SystemTraceProvider-Process'), 0))

rules.title: Conhost Spawned By Uncommon Parent Process
rules.author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)
rules.description: Detects when the Console Window Host (conhost.exe) process is spawned by an uncommon parent process, which could be indicative of potential code injection activity.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentImage LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\lsass.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\services.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\smss.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\spoolsv.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\userinit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\wininit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\winlogon.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentCommandLine LIKE '%-k apphost -s AppHostSvc%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%-k imgsvc%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%-k localService -p -s RemoteRegistry%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%-k LocalSystemNetworkRestricted -p -s NgcSvc%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%-k NetSvcs -p -s NcaSvc%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%-k netsvcs -p -s NetSetupSvc%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%-k netsvcs -p -s wlidsvc%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%-k NetworkService -p -s DoSvc%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%-k wsappx -p -s AppXSvc%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%-k wsappx -p -s ClipSVC%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%-k wusvcs -p -s WaaSMedicSvc%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentCommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Dropbox\\Client\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Program Files\\Dropbox\\Client\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Control Panel Items
rules.author: Kyaw Min Thein, Furkan Caliskan (@caliskanfurkan_)
rules.description: Detects the malicious use of a control panel item
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%CurrentVersion\\Control Panel\\CPLs%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.cpl' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE(((CommandLine LIKE '%\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%System\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%|C:\\Windows\\system32|%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%regsvr32 %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /s %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%igfxCPL.cpl%' ESCAPE '\')), 0)))

rules.title: CreateDump Process Dump
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects uses of the createdump.exe LOLOBIN utility to dump process memory
falsepositives: Command lines that use the same flags
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\createdump.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE 'FX\_VER\_INTERNALNAME\_STR' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -u %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --full %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -f %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --name %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dmp %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Insecure Proxy/DOH Transfer Via Curl.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "curl.exe" with the "insecure" flag over proxy or DOH.

rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: NTLM Hash Leak Via Curl NTLM Authentication
rules.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects the use of curl with NTLM authentication and empty credentials (-u :), which can be abused to leak the currently logged-in user's NTLMv2 challenge-response to an
attacker-controlled server, enabling offline cracking or relay attacks.
When no credentials are provided, the Microsoft-shipped curl passes a NULL identity to Windows SSPI, which automatically falls back to the current user's logon session credentials
stored in LSASS — without requiring a plaintext password.
This behavior is exclusive to the curl binary shipped by Microsoft (available since Windows 10 / Windows Server 2019), which is built with SSPI support.
falsepositives: Should be very rare as it's not widely known or used, but could occur in legitimate use cases where curl is used with NTLM authentication and empty credentials, such as in certain scripts or automation tasks.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\curl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='curl.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%--ntlm%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine REGEXP '(?i)\s(-u|--user)\s*:'

rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a suspicious curl process start on Windows and outputs the requested document to a local file
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\curl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Product='The curl executable') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%\%AppData\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%Public\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%Temp\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%tmp\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\PerfLogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.dll' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.gif' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpeg' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpg' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.png' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.temp' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.tmp' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.txt' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbe' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Git\\usr\\bin\\sh.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Git\\mingw64\\bin\\curl.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--silent --show-error --output %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%gfw-httpget-%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%AppData%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious CustomShellHost Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of CustomShellHost.exe where the child isn't located in 'C:\Windows\explorer.exe'. CustomShellHost is a known LOLBin that can be abused by attackers for defense evasion techniques.
falsepositives: False positives are unlikely, investigate matches carefully.
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\CustomShellHost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: ManageEngine Endpoint Central Dctask64.EXE Potential Abuse
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects the execution of "dctask64.exe", a signed binary by ZOHO Corporation part of ManageEngine Endpoint Central.
This binary can be abused for DLL injection, arbitrary command and process execution.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\dctask64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=6834B1B94E49701D77CCB3C0895E1AFD%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=1BB6F93B129F398C7C4A76BB97450BBA%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=FAA2AC19875FADE461C8D89DCF2710A3%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=F1039CED4B91572AB7847D26032E6BBF%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '% executecmd64 %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% invokeexe %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% injectDll %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Remote File Download Via Desktopimgdownldr Utility
rules.author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)
rules.description: Detects the desktopimgdownldr utility being used to download a remote file. An adversary may use desktopimgdownldr to download arbitrary files as an alternative to certutil.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\desktopimgdownldr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentImage LIKE '%\\desktopimgdownldr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/lockscreenurl:http%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Desktopimgdownldr Command
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a suspicious Microsoft desktopimgdownldr execution with parameters used to download files from the Internet
falsepositives: False positives depend on scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '% /lockscreenurl:%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%.jpg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpeg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.png%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%reg delete%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\PersonalizationCSP%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: DeviceCredentialDeployment Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of DeviceCredentialDeployment to hide a process from view.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\DeviceCredentialDeployment.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential DLL Sideloading Via DeviceEnroller.EXE
rules.author: @gott_cyber
rules.description:
Detects the use of the PhoneDeepLink parameter to potentially sideload a DLL file that does not exist. This non-existent DLL file is named "ShellChromeAPI.dll".
Adversaries can drop their own renamed DLL and execute it via DeviceEnroller.exe using this parameter
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\deviceenroller.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='deviceenroller.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%/PhoneDeepLink%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Arbitrary MSI Download Via Devinit.EXE
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a certain command line flag combination used by "devinit.exe", which can be abused as a LOLBIN to download arbitrary MSI packages on a Windows system
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '% -t msi-install %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -i http%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Child Process Of ClickOnce Application
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects potentially suspicious child processes of a ClickOnce deployment application
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Apps\\2.0\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%\\calc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\nltest.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\notepad.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\werfault.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Child Process Of DiskShadow.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects potentially suspicious child processes of "Diskshadow.exe". This could be an attempt to bypass parent/child relationship detection or application whitelisting rules.
falsepositives: False postitve can occur in cases where admin scripts levreage the "exec" flag to execute applications
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\diskshadow.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Diskshadow Script Mode - Uncommon Script Extension Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects execution of "Diskshadow.exe" in script mode to execute an script with a potentially uncommon extension.
Initial baselining of the allowed extension list is required.
falsepositives: False postitve might occur with legitimate or uncommon extensions used internally. Initial baseline is required.
rules.sql: ((OriginalFileName='diskshadow.exe' OR Image LIKE '%\\diskshadow.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-s %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/s %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–s %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—s %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―s %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%.txt%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Diskshadow Script Mode - Execution From Potential Suspicious Location
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "Diskshadow.exe" in script mode using the "/s" flag where the script is located in a potentially suspicious location.
falsepositives: False positives may occur if you execute the script from one of the paths mentioned in the rule. Apply additional filters that fits your org needs.
rules.sql: (OriginalFileName='diskshadow.exe' OR Image LIKE '%\\diskshadow.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-s %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/s %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–s %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—s %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―s %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PowerShell Web Access Feature Enabled Via DISM
rules.author: Michael Haag
rules.description: Detects the use of DISM to enable the PowerShell Web Access feature, which could be used for remote access and potential abuse
falsepositives: Legitimate PowerShell Web Access installations by administrators
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\dism.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='DISM.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%WindowsPowerShellWebAccess%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/online%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/enable-feature%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Dism Remove Online Package
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Deployment Image Servicing and Management tool. DISM is used to enumerate, install, uninstall, configure, and update features and packages in Windows images
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\DismHost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%/Online%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%/Disable-Feature%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%\\Dism.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/Online%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Disable-Feature%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: DLL Sideloading by VMware Xfer Utility
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of VMware Xfer utility (VMwareXferlogs.exe) from the non-default directory which may be an attempt to sideload arbitrary DLL
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\VMwareXferlogs.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\VMware\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Dllhost.EXE Execution Anomaly
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a "dllhost" process spawning with no commandline arguments which is very rare to happen and could indicate process injection activity or malware mimicking similar system processes.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\dllhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine='dllhost.exe' OR CommandLine='dllhost')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine IS NULL), 0))

rules.title: DNS Exfiltration and Tunneling Tools Execution
rules.author: Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community
rules.description: Well-known DNS Exfiltration tools execution
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\iodine.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\dnscat2%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Unusual Child Process of dns.exe
rules.author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)
rules.description: Detects an unexpected process spawning from dns.exe which may indicate activity related to remote code execution or other forms of exploitation as seen in CVE-2020-1350 (SigRed)
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\dns.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Potential Discovery Activity Via Dnscmd.EXE
rules.author: @gott_cyber
rules.description: Detects an attempt to leverage dnscmd.exe to enumerate the DNS zones of a domain. DNS zones used to host the DNS records for a particular domain.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\dnscmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/enumrecords%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/enumzones%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/ZonePrint%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/info%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: New DNS ServerLevelPluginDll Installed Via Dnscmd.EXE
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the installation of a DNS plugin DLL via ServerLevelPluginDll parameter in registry, which can be used to execute code in context of the DNS server (restart required)
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\dnscmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/config%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/serverlevelplugindll%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Application Whitelisting Bypass via Dnx.EXE
rules.author: Beyu Denis, oscd.community
rules.description:
Detects the execution of Dnx.EXE. The Dnx utility allows for the execution of C# code.
Attackers might abuse this in order to bypass application whitelisting.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of dnx.exe by legitimate user
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\dnx.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Arbitrary DLL or Csproj Code Execution Via Dotnet.EXE
rules.author: Beyu Denis, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects execution of arbitrary DLLs or unsigned code via a ".csproj" files via Dotnet.EXE.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\dotnet.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='.NET Host') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.csproj' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.csproj"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.csproj''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll''' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Notepad++\\notepad++.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Notepad++\\notepad++.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\ProgramData\\CSScriptNpp\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-cscs\_path:%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\cs-script\\cscs.dll%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Binary Proxy Execution Via Dotnet-Trace.EXE
rules.author: Jimmy Bayne (@bohops)
rules.description: Detects commandline arguments for executing a child process via dotnet-trace.exe
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of the utility in order to debug and trace a program.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\dotnet-trace.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='dotnet-trace.dll') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-- %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%collect%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Process Memory Dump Via Dotnet-Dump
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of "dotnet-dump" with the "collect" flag. The execution could indicate potential process dumping of critical processes such as LSASS.
falsepositives: Process dumping is the expected behavior of the tool. So false positives are expected in legitimate usage. The PID/Process Name of the process being dumped needs to be investigated
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\dotnet-dump.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='dotnet-dump.dll') AND CommandLine LIKE '%collect%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Recon Activity Using DriverQuery.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detect usage of the "driverquery" utility to perform reconnaissance on installed drivers
falsepositives: Legitimate usage by some scripts might trigger this as well
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%driverquery.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='drvqry.exe') AND ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentImage LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: DriverQuery.EXE Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detect usage of the "driverquery" utility. Which can be used to perform reconnaissance on installed drivers
falsepositives: Legitimate use by third party tools in order to investigate installed drivers
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%driverquery.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='drvqry.exe') AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentImage LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentImage LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Potentially Over Permissive Permissions Granted Using Dsacls.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of Dsacls to grant over permissive permissions
falsepositives: Legitimate administrators granting over permissive permissions to users
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\dsacls.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='DSACLS.EXE') AND CommandLine LIKE '% /G %' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%GR%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%GE%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%GW%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%GA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%WP%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%WD%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Password Spraying Attempt Using Dsacls.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects possible password spraying attempts using Dsacls
falsepositives: Legitimate use of dsacls to bind to an LDAP session
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\dsacls.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='DSACLS.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/user:%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/passwd:%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Domain Trust Discovery Via Dsquery
rules.author: E.M. Anhaus, Tony Lambert, oscd.community, omkar72
rules.description: Detects execution of "dsquery.exe" for domain trust discovery
falsepositives: Legitimate use of the utilities by legitimate user for legitimate reason
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\dsquery.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='dsquery.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%trustedDomain%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Kernel Dump Using Dtrace
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious way to dump the kernel on Windows systems using dtrace.exe, which is available on Windows systems since Windows 10 19H1
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\dtrace.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%lkd(0)%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%syscall:::return%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%lkd(%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Windows Defender AV Bypass Via Dump64.EXE Rename
rules.author: Austin Songer @austinsonger, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects when a user is potentially trying to bypass the Windows Defender AV by renaming a tool to dump64.exe and placing it in the Visual Studio folder.
Currently the rule is covering only usage of procdump but other utilities can be added in order to increase coverage.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE ':\\Program Files%' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\Microsoft Visual Studio\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\dump64.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (OriginalFileName='procdump' OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -ma %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -mp %' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: DumpMinitool Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of "DumpMinitool.exe" a tool that allows the dump of process memory via the use of the "MiniDumpWriteDump"
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\DumpMinitool.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\DumpMinitool.x86.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\DumpMinitool.arm64.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='DumpMinitool.exe' OR OriginalFileName='DumpMinitool.x86.exe' OR OriginalFileName='DumpMinitool.arm64.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '% Full%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% Mini%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% WithHeap%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious DumpMinitool Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious ways to use the "DumpMinitool.exe" binary
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\DumpMinitool.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\DumpMinitool.x86.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\DumpMinitool.arm64.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='DumpMinitool.exe' OR OriginalFileName='DumpMinitool.x86.exe' OR OriginalFileName='DumpMinitool.arm64.exe')) AND ((NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\Microsoft Visual Studio\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Extensions\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) OR CommandLine LIKE '%.txt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% Full%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% Mini%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% WithHeap%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%--dumpType%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))

rules.title: New Capture Session Launched Via DXCap.EXE
rules.author: Beyu Denis, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of "DXCap.EXE" with the "-c" flag, which allows a user to launch any arbitrary binary or windows package through DXCap itself. This can be abused to potentially bypass application whitelisting.
falsepositives: Legitimate execution of dxcap.exe by legitimate user
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\DXCap.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='DXCap.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Esentutl Gather Credentials
rules.author: sam0x90
rules.description: Conti recommendation to its affiliates to use esentutl to access NTDS dumped file. Trickbot also uses this utilities to get MSEdge info via its module pwgrab.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%esentutl%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /p%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Copying Sensitive Files with Credential Data
rules.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community
rules.description: Files with well-known filenames (sensitive files with credential data) copying
falsepositives: Copying sensitive files for legitimate use (eg. backup) or forensic investigation by legitimate incident responder or forensic investigator.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\esentutl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '\\esentutl.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%vss%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -m %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /m %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –m %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —m %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―m %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -y %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /y %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –y %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —y %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―y %' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\RegBack\\sam%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\RegBack\\security%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\RegBack\\system%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\sam%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\security%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\system %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\repair\\sam%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\repair\\security%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\repair\\system%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\windows\\ntds\\ntds.dit%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Esentutl Steals Browser Information
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: One way Qbot steals sensitive information is by extracting browser data from Internet Explorer and Microsoft Edge by using the built-in utility esentutl.exe
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\esentutl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='esentutl.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-r%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/r%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–r%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—r%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―r%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\WebCache%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Event Viewer Child Process
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects uncommon or suspicious child processes of "eventvwr.exe" which might indicate a UAC bypass attempt
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\eventvwr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\mmc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\WerFault.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\WerFault.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Cabinet File Expansion
rules.author: Bhabesh Raj, X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the expansion or decompression of cabinet files from potentially suspicious or uncommon locations, e.g. seen in Iranian MeteorExpress related attacks
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\expand.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-F:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/F:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–F:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—F:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―F:%' ESCAPE '\')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Perflogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\ProgramData%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Admin$\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\C$\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temporary Internet%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Favorites\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Favourites\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Contacts\\%' ESCAPE '\'))) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Dell\\UpdateService\\ServiceShell.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\ProgramData\\Dell\\UpdateService\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Explorer Process Tree Break
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), @gott_cyber
rules.description:
Detects a command line process that uses explorer.exe to launch arbitrary commands or binaries,
which is similar to cmd.exe /c, only it breaks the process tree and makes its parent a new instance of explorer spawning from "svchost"
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%/factory,{75dff2b7-6936-4c06-a8bb-676a7b00b24b}%' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%explorer.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -root,%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /root,%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –root,%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —root,%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―root,%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: File Explorer Folder Opened Using Explorer Folder Shortcut Via Shell
rules.author: @Kostastsale
rules.description: Detects the initial execution of "cmd.exe" which spawns "explorer.exe" with the appropriate command line arguments for opening the "My Computer" folder.
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%shell:mycomputerfolder%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Explorer NOUACCHECK Flag
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious starts of explorer.exe that use the /NOUACCHECK flag that allows to run all sub processes of that newly started explorer.exe without any UAC checks
falsepositives: Unknown how many legitimate software products use that method
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/NOUACCHECK%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentCommandLine LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\system32\\svchost.exe -k netsvcs -p -s Schedule' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Remote File Download Via Findstr.EXE
rules.author: Furkan CALISKAN, @caliskanfurkan_, @oscd_initiative, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "findstr" with specific flags and a remote share path. This specific set of CLI flags would allow "findstr" to download the content of the file located on the remote share as described in the LOLBAS entry.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%findstr%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%findstr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='FINDSTR.EXE') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% -v %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /v %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –v %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —v %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―v %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -l %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /l %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –l %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —l %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―l %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Findstr GPP Passwords
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Look for the encrypted cpassword value within Group Policy Preference files on the Domain Controller. This value can be decrypted with gpp-decrypt.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\find.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\findstr.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='FIND.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='FINDSTR.EXE')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cpassword%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\sysvol\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.xml%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Findstr Launching .lnk File
rules.author: Trent Liffick
rules.description: Detects usage of findstr to identify and execute a lnk file as seen within the HHS redirect attack
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\find.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\findstr.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='FIND.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='FINDSTR.EXE')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.lnk' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.lnk"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.lnk''' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: LSASS Process Reconnaissance Via Findstr.EXE
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects findstring commands that include the keyword lsass, which indicates recon actviity for the LSASS process PID
rules.sql: (((Image LIKE '%\\find.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\findstr.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='FIND.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='FINDSTR.EXE')) AND CommandLine LIKE '%lsass%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -i "lsass%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i "lsass%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –i "lsass%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —i "lsass%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―i "lsass%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i lsass.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i lsass.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –i lsass.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —i lsass.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―i lsass.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%findstr "lsass%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%findstr lsass%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%findstr.exe "lsass%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%findstr.exe lsass%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Permission Misconfiguration Reconnaissance Via Findstr.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects usage of findstr with the "EVERYONE" or "BUILTIN" keywords.
This was seen being used in combination with "icacls" and other utilities to spot misconfigured files or folders permissions.
rules.sql: (((Image LIKE '%\\find.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\findstr.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='FIND.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='FINDSTR.EXE')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%"Everyone"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%''Everyone''%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%"BUILTIN\\"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%''BUILTIN\\''%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%icacls %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%findstr %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Everyone%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Recon Command Output Piped To Findstr.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113
rules.description:
Detects the execution of a potential recon command where the results are piped to "findstr". This is meant to trigger on inline calls of "cmd.exe" via the "/c" or "/k" for example.
Attackers often time use this technique to extract specific information they require in their reconnaissance phase.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%ipconfig%|%find%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%net%|%find%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%netstat%|%find%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ping%|%find%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%systeminfo%|%find%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%tasklist%|%find%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%whoami%|%find%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /c TASKLIST /V |%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%FIND /I%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\xampp\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\catalina\_start.bat%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Security Tools Keyword Lookup Via Findstr.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113
rules.description:
Detects execution of "findstr" to search for common names of security tools. Attackers often pipe the results of recon commands such as "tasklist" or "whoami" to "findstr" in order to filter out the results.
This detection focuses on the keywords that the attacker might use as a filter.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\find.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\findstr.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='FIND.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='FINDSTR.EXE')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '% avira' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% avira"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% cb' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% cb"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% cylance' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% cylance"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% defender' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% defender"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% kaspersky' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% kaspersky"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% kes' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% kes"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% mc' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% mc"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% sec' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% sec"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% sentinel' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% sentinel"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% symantec' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% symantec"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% virus' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% virus"' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Sysmon Discovery Via Default Driver Altitude Using Findstr.EXE
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects usage of "findstr" with the argument "385201". Which could indicate potential discovery of an installed Sysinternals Sysmon service using the default driver altitude (even if the name is changed).
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\find.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\findstr.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='FIND.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='FINDSTR.EXE')) AND CommandLine LIKE '% 385201%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Finger.EXE Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), omkar72, oscd.community
rules.description:
Detects execution of the "finger.exe" utility.
Finger.EXE or "TCPIP Finger Command" is an old utility that is still present on modern Windows installation. It Displays information about users on a specified remote computer (typically a UNIX computer) that is running the finger service or daemon.
Due to the old nature of this utility and the rareness of machines having the finger service. Any execution of "finger.exe" can be considered "suspicious" and worth investigating.
falsepositives: Admin activity (unclear what they do nowadays with finger.exe)
rules.sql: OriginalFileName='finger.exe' OR Image LIKE '%\\finger.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Filter Driver Unloaded Via Fltmc.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detect filter driver unloading activity via fltmc.exe
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\fltMC.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='fltMC.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%unload%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((((ParentImage LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND ParentImage LIKE '%\\endpoint-protection-installer-x64.tmp' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%unload rtp\_filesystem\_filter' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%unload rtp\_filter' ESCAPE '\')) OR (ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\ManageEngine\\uems\_agent\\bin\\dcfaservice64.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%unload DFMFilter' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Sysmon Driver Unloaded Via Fltmc.EXE
rules.author: Kirill Kiryanov, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects possible Sysmon filter driver unloaded via fltmc.exe
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\fltMC.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='fltMC.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%unload%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%sysmon%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Forfiles.EXE Child Process Masquerading
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Anish Bogati
rules.description: Detects the execution of "forfiles" from a non-default location, in order to potentially spawn a custom "cmd.exe" from the current working directory.
rules.sql: ((ParentCommandLine LIKE '%.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%.exe"' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '/c echo "%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentImage LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND ParentImage LIKE '%\\forfiles.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Forfiles Command Execution
rules.author: Tim Rauch, Elastic, E.M. Anhaus (originally from Atomic Blue Detections, Endgame), oscd.community
rules.description:
Detects the execution of "forfiles" with the "/c" flag.
While this is an expected behavior of the tool, it can be abused in order to proxy execution through it with any binary.
Can be used to bypass application whitelisting.
falsepositives: Legitimate use via a batch script or by an administrator.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\forfiles.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='forfiles.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―c %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Uncommon FileSystem Load Attempt By Format.com
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of format.com with an uncommon filesystem selection that could indicate a defense evasion activity in which "format.com" is used to load malicious DLL files or other programs.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\format.com' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/fs:%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%/fs:exFAT%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/fs:FAT%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/fs:NTFS%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/fs:ReFS%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/fs:UDF%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Use of FSharp Interpreters
rules.author: Christopher Peacock @SecurePeacock, SCYTHE @scythe_io
rules.description:
Detects the execution of FSharp Interpreters "FsiAnyCpu.exe" and "FSi.exe"
Both can be used for AWL bypass and to execute F# code via scripts or inline.
falsepositives: Legitimate use by a software developer.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\fsi.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\fsianycpu.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='fsi.exe' OR OriginalFileName='fsianycpu.exe')

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious NTFS Symlink Behavior Modification
rules.author: frack113, The DFIR Report
rules.description: Detects the modification of NTFS symbolic link behavior using fsutil, which could be used to enable remote to local or remote to remote symlinks for potential attacks.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage, investigate the parent process and context to determine if benign.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%fsutil%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%behavior%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%set%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%SymlinkEvaluation%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%R2L:1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%R2R:1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%L2L:1%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Fsutil Suspicious Invocation
rules.author: Ecco, E.M. Anhaus, oscd.community
rules.description:
Detects suspicious parameters of fsutil (deleting USN journal, configuring it with small size, etc).
Might be used by ransomwares during the attack (seen by NotPetya and others).
falsepositives: Scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\fsutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='fsutil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%deletejournal%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%createjournal%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%setZeroData%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Arbitrary Command Execution Via FTP.EXE
rules.author: Victor Sergeev, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects execution of "ftp.exe" script with the "-s" or "/s" flag and any child processes ran by "ftp.exe".
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\ftp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ((Image LIKE '%\\ftp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='ftp.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-s:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/s:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–s:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—s:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―s:%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Arbitrary File Download Via GfxDownloadWrapper.EXE
rules.author: Victor Sergeev, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects execution of GfxDownloadWrapper.exe with a URL as an argument to download file.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\GfxDownloadWrapper.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%https://gameplayapi.intel.com/%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Git Clone
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "git" in order to clone a remote repository that contain suspicious keywords which might be suspicious
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\git.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\git-remote-https.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='git.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% clone %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%git-remote-https %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%exploit%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Vulns%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%vulnerability%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%RemoteCodeExecution%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%CVE-%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%poc-%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ProofOfConcept%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%proxyshell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%log4shell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%eternalblue%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%eternal-blue%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%MS17-%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Github Self-Hosted Runner Execution
rules.author: Daniel Koifman (KoifSec)
rules.description:
Detects GitHub self-hosted runners executing workflows on local infrastructure that could be abused for persistence and code execution.
Shai-Hulud is an npm supply chain worm targeting CI/CD environments.
It installs runners on compromised systems to maintain access after credential theft, leveraging their access to secrets and internal networks.
falsepositives: Legitimate GitHub self-hosted runner installations on designated CI/CD infrastructure
Authorized runner deployments by DevOps/Platform teams following change management
Scheduled runner updates or reconfigurations on existing build agents
Self-hosted runners that follow expected/known naming patterns
Installation via expected/known configuration management tools (reflected mostly as parent process name)
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\Runner.Worker.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Runner.Worker.dll') AND CommandLine LIKE '%spawnclient%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((Image LIKE '%\\Runner.Listener.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Runner.Listener.dll') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%run%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%configure%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious GoogleUpdate Child Process
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects potentially suspicious child processes of "GoogleUpdate.exe"
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\GoogleUpdate.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE(((Image LIKE '%\\Google%' ESCAPE '\' OR (Image LIKE '%\\setup.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%chrome\_updater.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%chrome\_installer.exe' ESCAPE '\')) OR Image IS NULL), 0))

rules.title: File Decryption Using Gpg4win
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of Gpg4win to decrypt files
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\gpg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\gpg2.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR Description='GnuPG’s OpenPGP tool') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -d %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%passphrase%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: File Encryption Using Gpg4win
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of Gpg4win to encrypt files
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\gpg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\gpg2.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR Description='GnuPG’s OpenPGP tool') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%passphrase%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Portable Gpg.EXE Execution
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of "gpg.exe" from uncommon location. Often used by ransomware and loaders to decrypt/encrypt data.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\gpg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\gpg2.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='gpg.exe' OR Description='GnuPG’s OpenPGP tool') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\GNU\\GnuPG\\bin\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\GnuPG VS-Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\GnuPG\\bin\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\Gpg4win\\bin\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: File Encryption/Decryption Via Gpg4win From Suspicious Locations
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of Gpg4win to encrypt/decrypt files located in potentially suspicious locations.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\gpg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\gpg2.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR Product='GNU Privacy Guard (GnuPG)' OR Description='GnuPG’s OpenPGP tool') AND CommandLine LIKE '%-passphrase%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\PerfLogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Gpresult Display Group Policy Information
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects cases in which a user uses the built-in Windows utility gpresult to display the Resultant Set of Policy (RSoP) information
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\gpresult.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/z%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/v%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Arbitrary Binary Execution Using GUP Utility
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of the Notepad++ updater (gup) to launch other commands or executables
falsepositives: Other parent binaries using GUP not currently identified
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\gup.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((Image LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Notepad++\\notepad++.exe%' ESCAPE '\') OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\Notepad++\\updater\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine IS NULL), 0))

rules.title: File Download Using Notepad++ GUP Utility
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of the Notepad++ updater (gup) from a process other than Notepad++ to download files.
falsepositives: Other parent processes other than notepad++ using GUP that are not currently identified
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\GUP.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='gup.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -unzipTo %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%\\notepad++.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious GUP Usage
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of the Notepad++ updater in a suspicious directory, which is often used in DLL side-loading attacks
falsepositives: Execution of tools named GUP.exe and located in folders different than Notepad++\updater
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\GUP.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE(((Image LIKE '%\\Program Files\\Notepad++\\updater\\GUP.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Program Files (x86)\\Notepad++\\updater\\GUP.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Notepad++\\updater\\GUP.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\Notepad++\\updater\\GUP.exe' ESCAPE '\'))), 0))

rules.title: Remote CHM File Download/Execution Via HH.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the usage of "hh.exe" to execute/download remotely hosted ".chm" files.
rules.sql: (OriginalFileName='HH.exe' OR Image LIKE '%\\hh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HTML Help HH.EXE Suspicious Child Process
rules.author: Maxim Pavlunin, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a suspicious child process of a Microsoft HTML Help (HH.exe)
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\hh.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%\\CertReq.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\CertUtil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\installutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\MSbuild.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\MSHTA.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious HH.EXE Execution
rules.author: Maxim Pavlunin
rules.description: Detects a suspicious execution of a Microsoft HTML Help (HH.exe)
rules.sql: (OriginalFileName='HH.exe' OR Image LIKE '%\\hh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.application%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Content.Outlook\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - ADCSPwn Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects command line parameters used by ADCSPwn, a tool to escalate privileges in an active directory network by coercing authenticate from machine accounts and relaying to the certificate service
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '% --adcs %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% --port %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: HackTool - Bloodhound/Sharphound Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects command line parameters used by Bloodhound and Sharphound hack tools
falsepositives: Other programs that use these command line option and accepts an 'All' parameter
rules.sql: (Product LIKE '%SharpHound%' ESCAPE '\' OR Description LIKE '%SharpHound%' ESCAPE '\' OR (Company LIKE '%SpecterOps%' ESCAPE '\' OR Company LIKE '%evil corp%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\Bloodhound.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\SharpHound.exe%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -CollectionMethod All %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --CollectionMethods Session %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --Loop --Loopduration %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --PortScanTimeout %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe -c All -d %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-Bloodhound%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Get-BloodHoundData%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -JsonFolder %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -ZipFileName %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% DCOnly %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% --NoSaveCache %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - F-Secure C3 Load by Rundll32
rules.author: Alfie Champion (ajpc500)
rules.description: F-Secure C3 produces DLLs with a default exported StartNodeRelay function.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%StartNodeRelay%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: HackTool - Certify Execution
rules.author: pH-T (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects Certify a tool for Active Directory certificate abuse based on PE metadata characteristics and common command line arguments.
