rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\Certify.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Certify.exe' OR Description LIKE '%Certify%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%.exe cas %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe find %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe pkiobjects %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe request %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe download %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /vulnerable%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /template:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /altname:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /domain:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /path:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /ca:%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: HackTool - Certipy Execution
rules.author: pH-T (Nextron Systems), Sittikorn Sangrattanapitak
rules.description: Detects Certipy execution, a tool for Active Directory Certificate Services enumeration and abuse based on PE metadata characteristics and common command line arguments.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\Certipy.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Certipy.exe' OR Description LIKE '%Certipy%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% account %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% auth %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% cert %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% find %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% forge %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ptt %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% relay %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% req %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% shadow %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% template %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -bloodhound%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ca-pfx %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -dc-ip %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -kirbi%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -old-bloodhound%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -pfx %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -target%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -template%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -username %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -vulnerable%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%auth -pfx%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%shadow auto%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%shadow list%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Operator Bloopers Cobalt Strike Commands
rules.author: _pete_0, TheDFIRReport
rules.description: Detects use of Cobalt Strike commands accidentally entered in the CMD shell
rules.sql: (OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE 'cmd %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE 'cmd.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE 'c:\\windows\\system32\\cmd.exe%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%psinject%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%spawnas%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%make\_token%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%remote-exec%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rev2self%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dcsync%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%logonpasswords%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%execute-assembly%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%getsystem%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Operator Bloopers Cobalt Strike Modules
rules.author: _pete_0, TheDFIRReport
rules.description: Detects Cobalt Strike module/commands accidentally entered in CMD shell
rules.sql: (OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-UserHunter%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-ShareFinder%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-Kerberoast%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-SMBAutoBrute%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-Nightmare%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%zerologon%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%av\_query%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: CobaltStrike Load by Rundll32
rules.author: Wojciech Lesicki
rules.description: Rundll32 can be use by Cobalt Strike with StartW function to load DLLs from the command line.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32 %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% StartW' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%,StartW' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Potential CobaltStrike Process Patterns
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects potential process patterns related to Cobalt Strike beacon activity
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /C whoami' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\runonce.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\dllhost.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /c echo%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%> \\\\.\\pipe%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((ParentCommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /C echo%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '% > \\\\.\\pipe%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%conhost.exe 0xffffffff -ForceV1' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%/C whoami' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%conhost.exe 0xffffffff -ForceV1' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - CoercedPotato Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of CoercedPotato, a tool for privilege escalation
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\CoercedPotato.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --exploitId %' ESCAPE '\' OR (Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=A75D7669DB6B2E107A44C4057FF7F7D6%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=F91624350E2C678C5DCBE5E1F24E22C9%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=14C81850A079A87E83D50CA41C709A15%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - Covenant PowerShell Launcher
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects suspicious command lines used in Covenant luanchers
rules.sql: ((CommandLine LIKE '%-Sta%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-Nop%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-Window%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Hidden%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-Command%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-EncodedCommand%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%sv o (New-Object IO.MemorySteam);sv d %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mshta file.hta%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%GruntHTTP%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-EncodedCommand cwB2ACAAbwAgA%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - CrackMapExec Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: This rule detect common flag combinations used by CrackMapExec in order to detect its use even if the binary has been replaced.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\crackmapexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -M pe\_inject %' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '% --local-auth%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -u %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -x %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% --local-auth%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -u %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -p %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -H ''NTHASH''%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% mssql %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -u %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -p %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -M %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -d %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% smb %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -u %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -H %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -M %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -o %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% smb %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -u %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -p %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% --local-auth%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% --local-auth%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -u %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -p %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% 10.%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% 192.168.%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/24 %' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: HackTool - CrackMapExec Execution Patterns
rules.author: Thomas Patzke
rules.description: Detects various execution patterns of the CrackMapExec pentesting framework
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /Q /c % 1> \\\\%\\%\\% 2>&1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /C % > \\\\%\\%\\% 2>&1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /C % > %\\Temp\\% 2>&1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%powershell.exe -exec bypass -noni -nop -w 1 -C "%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%powershell.exe -noni -nop -w 1 -enc %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: HackTool - CrackMapExec Process Patterns
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious process patterns found in logs when CrackMapExec is used
rules.sql: ((CommandLine LIKE '%tasklist /fi %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Imagename eq lsass.exe%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /r %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /k %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /r %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /k %' ESCAPE '\') AND (User LIKE '%AUTHORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%AUTORI%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%do rundll32.exe C:\\windows\\System32\\comsvcs.dll, MiniDump%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% full%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\%\%B%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%tasklist /v /fo csv%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%findstr /i "lsass"%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - CrackMapExec PowerShell Obfuscation
rules.author: Thomas Patzke
rules.description: The CrachMapExec pentesting framework implements a PowerShell obfuscation with some static strings detected by this rule.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%join%split%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%( $ShellId[1]+$ShellId[13]+''x'')%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%( $PSHome[%]+$PSHOME[%]+%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%( $env:Public[13]+$env:Public[5]+''x'')%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%( $env:ComSpec[4,%,25]-Join'''')%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%[1,3]+''x''-Join'''')%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - CreateMiniDump Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of CreateMiniDump hack tool used to dump the LSASS process memory for credential extraction on the attacker's machine
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\CreateMiniDump.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=4a07f944a83e8a7c2525efa35dd30e2f%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: HackTool - DInjector PowerShell Cradle Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of the Dinject PowerShell cradle based on the specific flags
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '% /am51%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /password%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: HackTool - Dumpert Process Dumper Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of Dumpert process dumper, which dumps the lsass.exe process memory
rules.sql: Hashes LIKE '%MD5=09D278F9DE118EF09163C6140255C690%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Dumpert.dll%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: HackTool - EDRSilencer Execution
rules.author: @gott_cyber
rules.description: Detects the execution of EDRSilencer, a tool that leverages Windows Filtering Platform (WFP) to block Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents from reporting security events to the server based on PE metadata information.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\EDRSilencer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='EDRSilencer.exe' OR Description LIKE '%EDRSilencer%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: HackTool - Empire PowerShell Launch Parameters
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious powershell command line parameters used in Empire
falsepositives: Other tools that incidentally use the same command line parameters
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '% -NoP -sta -NonI -W Hidden -Enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -noP -sta -w 1 -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -NoP -NonI -W Hidden -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -noP -sta -w 1 -enc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enc  SQB%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -nop -exec bypass -EncodedCommand %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: HackTool - Empire PowerShell UAC Bypass
rules.author: Ecco
rules.description: Detects some Empire PowerShell UAC bypass methods
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '% -NoP -NonI -w Hidden -c $x=$((gp HKCU:Software\\Microsoft\\Windows Update).Update)%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -NoP -NonI -c $x=$((gp HKCU:Software\\Microsoft\\Windows Update).Update);%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: HackTool - WinRM Access Via Evil-WinRM
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Adversaries may use Valid Accounts to log into a computer using the Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP). The adversary may then perform actions as the logged-on user.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\ruby.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-i %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-u %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-p %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - GMER Rootkit Detector and Remover Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution GMER tool based on image and hash fields.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\gmer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (Hashes LIKE '%MD5=E9DC058440D321AA17D0600B3CA0AB04%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA1=539C228B6B332F5AA523E5CE358C16647D8BBE57%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=E8A3E804A96C716A3E9B69195DB6FFB0D33E2433AF871E4D4E1EAB3097237173%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - HandleKatz LSASS Dumper Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of HandleKatz, a tool that demonstrates the usage of cloned handles to Lsass in order to create an obfuscated memory dump of the same
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\loader.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--pid:%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=38D9E015591BBFD4929E0D0F47FA0055%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=0E2216679CA6E1094D63322E3412D650%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%--pid:%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--outfile:%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.dmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%lsass%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.obf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dump%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: HackTool - Hashcat Password Cracker Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Execute Hashcat.exe with provided SAM file from registry of Windows and Password list to crack against
falsepositives: Tools that use similar command line flags and values
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\hashcat.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%-a %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-m 1000 %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-r %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - Htran/NATBypass Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects executable names or flags used by Htran or Htran-like tools (e.g. NATBypass)
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\htran.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\lcx.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.exe -tran %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe -slave %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - Hydra Password Bruteforce Execution
rules.author: Vasiliy Burov
rules.description: Detects command line parameters used by Hydra password guessing hack tool
falsepositives: Software that uses the caret encased keywords PASS and USER in its command line
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%-u %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-p %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%^USER^%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%^PASS^%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - Potential Impacket Lateral Movement Activity
rules.author: Ecco, oscd.community, Jonhnathan Ribeiro, Tim Rauch
rules.description: Detects wmiexec/dcomexec/atexec/smbexec from Impacket framework
rules.sql: ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\wmiprvse.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\mmc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\services.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Q%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/c%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\127.0.0.1\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%&1%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((ParentCommandLine LIKE '%svchost.exe -k netsvcs%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%taskeng.exe%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/C%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%&1%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: HackTool - Impacket Tools Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of different compiled Windows binaries of the impacket toolset (based on names or part of their names - could lead to false positives)
falsepositives: Legitimate use of the impacket tools
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\goldenPac%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\karmaSMB%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\kintercept%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\ntlmrelayx%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rpcdump%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\samrdump%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\secretsdump%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\smbexec%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\smbrelayx%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wmiexec%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wmipersist%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\atexec\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\dcomexec\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\dpapi\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\findDelegation\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\GetADUsers\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\GetNPUsers\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\getPac\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\getST\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\getTGT\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\GetUserSPNs\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\ifmap\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mimikatz\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\netview\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\nmapAnswerMachine\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\opdump\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\psexec\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rdp\_check\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\sambaPipe\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\smbclient\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\smbserver\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\sniff\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\sniffer\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\split\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\ticketer\_windows.exe' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - Impersonate Execution
rules.author: Sai Prashanth Pulisetti @pulisettis
rules.description: Detects execution of the Impersonate tool. Which can be used to manipulate tokens on a Windows computers remotely (PsExec/WmiExec) or interactively
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%impersonate.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% list %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% exec %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% adduser %' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Hashes LIKE '%MD5=9520714AB576B0ED01D1513691377D01%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=E81CC96E2118DC4FBFE5BAD1604E0AC7681960143E2101E1A024D52264BB0A8A%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=0A358FFC1697B7A07D0E817AC740DF62%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - Inveigh Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of Inveigh a cross-platform .NET IPv4/IPv6 machine-in-the-middle tool
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\Inveigh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (OriginalFileName LIKE '\\Inveigh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '\\Inveigh.dll' ESCAPE '\') OR Description='Inveigh' OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -SpooferIP%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ReplyToIPs %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ReplyToDomains %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ReplyToMACs %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -SnifferIP%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation CLIP+ Launcher
rules.author: Jonathan Cheong, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Obfuscated use of Clip.exe to execute PowerShell
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%cmd%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%&&%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%clipboard]::%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-f%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/r%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation Obfuscated IEX Invocation
rules.author: Daniel Bohannon (@Mandiant/@FireEye), oscd.community
rules.description: Detects all variations of obfuscated powershell IEX invocation code generated by Invoke-Obfuscation framework from the following code block
rules.sql: CommandLine REGEXP '\$PSHome\[\s*\d{1,3}\s*\]\s*\+\s*\$PSHome\[' OR CommandLine REGEXP '\$ShellId\[\s*\d{1,3}\s*\]\s*\+\s*\$ShellId\[' OR CommandLine REGEXP '\$env:Public\[\s*\d{1,3}\s*\]\s*\+\s*\$env:Public\[' OR CommandLine REGEXP '\$env:ComSpec\[(?:\s*\d{1,3}\s*,){2}' OR CommandLine REGEXP '\*mdr\*\W\s*\)\.Name' OR CommandLine REGEXP '\$VerbosePreference\.ToString\(' OR CommandLine REGEXP '\[String\]\s*\$VerbosePreference'

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation STDIN+ Launcher
rules.author: Jonathan Cheong, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Obfuscated use of stdin to execute PowerShell
rules.sql: CommandLine REGEXP 'cmd.{0,5}(?:/c|/r).+powershell.+(?:\$\{?input\}?|noexit).+\"'

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation VAR+ Launcher
rules.author: Jonathan Cheong, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Obfuscated use of Environment Variables to execute PowerShell

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation COMPRESS OBFUSCATION
rules.author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via COMPRESS OBFUSCATION
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%new-object%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%text.encoding]::ascii%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%system.io.compression.deflatestream%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%system.io.streamreader%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%readtoend(%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Stdin
rules.author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via Stdin in Scripts
rules.sql: CommandLine REGEXP '(?i)(?:set).*&&\s?set.*(?:environment|invoke|\$\{?input).*&&.*"'

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use Clip
rules.author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use Clip.exe in Scripts
rules.sql: CommandLine REGEXP '(?i)echo.*clip.*&&.*(?:Clipboard|i`?n`?v`?o`?k`?e`?)'

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use MSHTA
rules.author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use MSHTA in Scripts
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%set%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%&&%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%mshta%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%vbscript:createobject%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.run%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%(window.close)%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Invoke-Obfuscation VAR++ LAUNCHER OBFUSCATION
rules.author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via VAR++ LAUNCHER
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%&&set%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%cmd%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/c%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-f%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%{0}%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%{1}%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%{2}%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%{3}%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%{4}%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%{5}%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - Jlaive In-Memory Assembly Execution
rules.author: Jose Luis Sanchez Martinez (@Joseliyo_Jstnk)
rules.description: Detects the use of Jlaive to execute assemblies in a copied PowerShell
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%.bat' ESCAPE '\') AND ((Image LIKE '%\\xcopy.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%powershell.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.bat.exe%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%\\xcopy.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%pwsh.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.bat.exe%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%\\attrib.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%+s%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%+h%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.bat.exe%' ESCAPE '\')))

rules.title: HackTool - Koadic Execution
rules.author: wagga, Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects command line parameters used by Koadic hack tool
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/q%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/c%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%chcp%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - KrbRelay Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of KrbRelay, a Kerberos relaying tool
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\KrbRelay.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='KrbRelay.exe') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -spn %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -clsid %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -rbcd %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%shadowcred%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%clsid%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%spn%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%spn %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%session %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%clsid %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - RemoteKrbRelay Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of RemoteKrbRelay, a Kerberos relaying tool via CommandLine flags and PE metadata.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\RemoteKrbRelay.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RemoteKrbRelay.exe') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -clsid %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -target %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -victim %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%-rbcd %' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-cn %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--computername %' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%-chp %' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-chpPass %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-chpUser %' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%-addgroupmember %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-group %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-groupuser %' ESCAPE '\') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%-smb %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--smbkeyword %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%interactive%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%secrets%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%service-add%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: HackTool - KrbRelayUp Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects KrbRelayUp used to perform a universal no-fix local privilege escalation in Windows domain environments where LDAP signing is not enforced
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\KrbRelayUp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='KrbRelayUp.exe') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% relay %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -Domain %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -ComputerName %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% krbscm %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -sc %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% spawn %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -d %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -cn %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -cp %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - LocalPotato Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of the LocalPotato POC based on basic PE metadata information and default CLI examples
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\LocalPotato.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.exe -i C:\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-o Windows\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=E1742EE971D6549E8D4D81115F88F1FC%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=DD82066EFBA94D7556EF582F247C8BB5%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Meterpreter/CobaltStrike Activity
rules.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov, Ecco, Florian Roth
rules.description: Detects the use of getsystem Meterpreter/Cobalt Strike command by detecting a specific service starting
falsepositives: Commandlines containing components like cmd accidentally
Jobs and services started with cmd
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\services.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (((CommandLine LIKE '%/c%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%echo%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\pipe\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cmd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%COMSPEC\%%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dll,a%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/p:%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%MpCmdRun%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: HackTool - Mimikatz Execution
rules.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov, oscd.community, David ANDRE (additional keywords), Tim Shelton
rules.description: Detection well-known mimikatz command line arguments
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%DumpCreds%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mimikatz%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%::aadcookie%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::detours%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::memssp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::mflt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::ncroutemon%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::ngcsign%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::printnightmare%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::skeleton%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::preshutdown%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::mstsc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::multirdp%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%rpc::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%token::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%crypto::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dpapi::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%sekurlsa::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%kerberos::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%lsadump::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%privilege::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%process::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%vault::%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - PCHunter Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali
rules.description: Detects suspicious use of PCHunter, a tool like Process Hacker to view and manipulate processes, kernel options and other low level stuff
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\PCHunter64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\PCHunter32.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PCHunter.exe' OR Description='Epoolsoft Windows Information View Tools') OR (Hashes LIKE '%SHA1=5F1CBC3D99558307BC1250D084FA968521482025%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%MD5=987B65CD9B9F4E9A1AFD8F8B48CF64A7%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=2B214BDDAAB130C274DE6204AF6DBA5AEEC7433DA99AA950022FA306421A6D32%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=444D210CEA1FF8112F256A4997EED7FF%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA1=3FB89787CB97D902780DA080545584D97FB1C2EB%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%MD5=228DD0C2E6287547E26FFBD973A40F14%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=55F041BF4E78E9BFA6D4EE68BE40E496CE3A1353E1CA4306598589E19802522C%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=0479F44DF47CFA2EF1CCC4416A538663%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - Default PowerSploit/Empire Scheduled Task Creation
rules.author: Markus Neis, @Karneades
rules.description: Detects the creation of a schtask via PowerSploit or Empire Default Configuration.
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/Create%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%powershell.exe -NonI%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/TN Updater /TR%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/SC ONLOGON%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/SC DAILY /ST%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/SC ONIDLE%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/SC HOURLY%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - PowerTool Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of the tool PowerTool which has the ability to kill a process, delete its process file, unload drivers, and delete the driver files
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\PowerTool.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\PowerTool64.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='PowerTool.exe'

rules.title: HackTool - PurpleSharp Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of the PurpleSharp adversary simulation tool
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\purplesharp%' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='PurpleSharp.exe') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%xyz123456.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%PurpleSharp%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - Pypykatz Credentials Dumping Activity
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects the usage of "pypykatz" to obtain stored credentials. Adversaries may attempt to extract credential material from the Security Account Manager (SAM) database through Windows registry where the SAM database is stored
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\pypykatz.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\python.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%live%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%registry%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - Quarks PwDump Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the Quarks PwDump tool via commandline arguments
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\QuarksPwDump.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine=' -dhl' OR CommandLine=' --dump-hash-local' OR CommandLine=' -dhdc' OR CommandLine=' --dump-hash-domain-cached' OR CommandLine=' --dump-bitlocker' OR CommandLine=' -dhd ' OR CommandLine=' --dump-hash-domain ' OR CommandLine='--ntds-file')

rules.title: HackTool - RedMimicry Winnti Playbook Execution
rules.author: Alexander Rausch
rules.description: Detects actions caused by the RedMimicry Winnti playbook a automated breach emulations utility
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%gthread-3.6.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\tmp.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%sigcmm-2.4.dll%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential SMB Relay Attack Tool Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects different hacktools used for relay attacks on Windows for privilege escalation
falsepositives: Legitimate files with these rare hacktool names
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%PetitPotam%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%RottenPotato%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%HotPotato%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%JuicyPotato%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\just\_dce\_%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%Juicy Potato%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\temp\\rot.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Potato.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\SpoolSample.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Responder.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\smbrelayx%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\ntlmrelayx%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\LocalPotato%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-Tater%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% smbrelay%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ntlmrelay%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cme smb %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /ntlm:NTLMhash %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-PetitPotam%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe -t % -p %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.exe -c "{%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%}" -z' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%HotPotatoes6%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%HotPotatoes7%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%HotPotatoes %' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: HackTool - Rubeus Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of the hacktool Rubeus via PE information of command line parameters
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\Rubeus.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Rubeus.exe' OR Description='Rubeus' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%asreproast %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dump /service:krbtgt %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dump /luid:0x%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%kerberoast %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%createnetonly /program:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ptt /ticket:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/impersonateuser:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%renew /ticket:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%asktgt /user:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%harvest /interval:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%s4u /user:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%s4u /ticket:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%hash /password:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%golden /aes256:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%silver /user:%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - SafetyKatz Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of the hacktool SafetyKatz via PE information and default Image name
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\SafetyKatz.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='SafetyKatz.exe' OR Description='SafetyKatz'

rules.title: HackTool - SecurityXploded Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of SecurityXploded Tools
rules.sql: Company='SecurityXploded' OR Image LIKE '%PasswordDump.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '%PasswordDump.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: HackTool - PPID Spoofing SelectMyParent Tool Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of parent process ID spoofing tools like Didier Stevens tool SelectMyParent
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\SelectMyParent.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%PPID-spoof%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ppid\_spoof%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%spoof-ppid%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%spoof\_ppid%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ppidspoof%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%spoofppid%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%spoofedppid%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -spawnto %' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName LIKE '%PPID-spoof%' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '%ppid\_spoof%' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '%spoof-ppid%' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '%spoof\_ppid%' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '%ppidspoof%' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '%spoofppid%' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '%spoofedppid%' ESCAPE '\') OR Description='SelectMyParent' OR (Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=04D974875BD225F00902B4CAD9AF3FBC%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=A782AF154C9E743DDF3F3EB2B8F3D16E%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=89059503D7FBF470E68F7E63313DA3AD%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=CA28337632625C8281AB8A130B3D6BAD%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - SharpChisel Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the Sharp Chisel via the commandline arguments
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\SharpChisel.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Product='SharpChisel'

rules.title: HackTool - SharpDPAPI Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects the execution of the SharpDPAPI tool based on CommandLine flags and PE metadata.
SharpDPAPI is a C# port of some DPAPI functionality from the Mimikatz project.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\SharpDPAPI.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='SharpDPAPI.exe') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% backupkey %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% blob %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% certificates %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% credentials %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% keepass %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% masterkeys %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% rdg %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% vaults %' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% {%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%}:%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% /file:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /machine%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /mkfile:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /password:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /pvk:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /server:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /target:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /unprotect%' ESCAPE '\')))

rules.title: HackTool - SharpImpersonation Execution
rules.author: Sai Prashanth Pulisetti @pulisettis, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of the SharpImpersonation tool. Which can be used to manipulate tokens on a Windows computers remotely (PsExec/WmiExec) or interactively
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\SharpImpersonation.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='SharpImpersonation.exe') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% user:%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% binary:%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% user:%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% shellcode:%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% technique:CreateProcessAsUserW%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% technique:ImpersonateLoggedOnuser%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: HackTool - SharpLDAPmonitor Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of the SharpLDAPmonitor. Which can monitor the creation, deletion and changes to LDAP objects.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\SharpLDAPmonitor.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='SharpLDAPmonitor.exe') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/user:%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/pass:%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/dcip:%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - SharPersist Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of the hacktool SharPersist - used to deploy various different kinds of persistence mechanisms
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\SharPersist.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Product='SharPersist') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -t schtask -c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -t startupfolder -c %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -t reg -c %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -m add%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -t service -c %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -m add%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -t schtask -c %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -m add%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - SharpEvtMute Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of SharpEvtHook, a tool that tampers with the Windows event logs
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\SharpEvtMute.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Description='SharpEvtMute' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%--Filter "rule %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--Encoded --Filter \\"%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - SharpLdapWhoami Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects SharpLdapWhoami, a whoami alternative that queries the LDAP service on a domain controller
falsepositives: Programs that use the same command line flags
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\SharpLdapWhoami.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (OriginalFileName LIKE '%SharpLdapWhoami%' ESCAPE '\' OR Product='SharpLdapWhoami') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% /method:ntlm' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /method:kerb' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /method:nego' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /m:nego' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /m:ntlm' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /m:kerb' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - SharpMove Tool Execution
rules.author: Luca Di Bartolomeo (CrimpSec)
rules.description: Detects the execution of SharpMove, a .NET utility performing multiple tasks such as "Task Creation", "SCM" query, VBScript execution using WMI via its PE metadata and command line options.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\SharpMove.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='SharpMove.exe') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%computername=%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%action=create%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%action=dcom%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%action=executevbs%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%action=hijackdcom%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%action=modschtask%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%action=modsvc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%action=query%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%action=scm%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%action=startservice%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%action=taskscheduler%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: HackTool - SharpUp PrivEsc Tool Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of SharpUp, a tool for local privilege escalation
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\SharpUp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Description='SharpUp' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%HijackablePaths%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%UnquotedServicePath%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ProcessDLLHijack%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ModifiableServiceBinaries%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ModifiableScheduledTask%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DomainGPPPassword%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%CachedGPPPassword%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - SharpWSUS/WSUSpendu Execution
rules.author: @Kostastsale, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects the execution of SharpWSUS or WSUSpendu, utilities that allow for lateral movement through WSUS.
Windows Server Update Services (WSUS) is a critical component of Windows systems and is frequently configured in a way that allows an attacker to circumvent internal networking limitations.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '% -Inject %' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -PayloadArgs %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -PayloadFile %' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% approve %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% create %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% check %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% delete %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /payload:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /payload=%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /updateid:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /updateid=%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: HackTool - Sliver C2 Implant Activity Pattern
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects process activity patterns as seen being used by Sliver C2 framework implants
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%-NoExit -Command [Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::UTF8%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: HackTool - SOAPHound Execution
rules.author: @kostastsale
rules.description: Detects the execution of SOAPHound, a .NET tool for collecting Active Directory data, using specific command-line arguments that may indicate an attempt to extract sensitive AD information.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '% --buildcache %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --bhdump %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --certdump %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --dnsdump %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --cachefilename %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -o %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --outputdirectory%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - Stracciatella Execution
rules.author: pH-T (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects Stracciatella which executes a Powershell runspace from within C# (aka SharpPick technique) with AMSI, ETW and Script Block Logging disabled based on PE metadata characteristics.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\Stracciatella.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Stracciatella.exe' OR Description='Stracciatella' OR (Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=9d25e61ec1527e2a69d7c2a4e3fe2fe15890710c198a66a9f25d99fdf6c7b956%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=fd16609bd9830c63b9413671678bb159b89c357d21942ddbb6b93add808d121a%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - SysmonEOP Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of the PoC that can be used to exploit Sysmon CVE-2022-41120
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\SysmonEOP.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=22F4089EB8ABA31E1BB162C6D9BF72E5%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=5123FA4C4384D431CD0D893EEB49BBEC%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - TruffleSnout Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects the use of TruffleSnout.exe an iterative AD discovery toolkit for offensive operators, situational awareness and targeted low noise enumeration.
rules.sql: OriginalFileName='TruffleSnout.exe' OR Image LIKE '%\\TruffleSnout.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: HackTool - UACMe Akagi Execution
rules.author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of UACMe, a tool used for UAC bypasses, via default PE metadata
rules.sql: (Product='UACMe' OR (Company='REvol Corp' OR Company='APT 92' OR Company='UG North' OR Company='Hazardous Environments' OR Company='CD Project Rekt') OR (Description='UACMe main module' OR Description='Pentesting utility') OR (OriginalFileName='Akagi.exe' OR OriginalFileName='Akagi64.exe')) OR (Image LIKE '%\\Akagi64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Akagi.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=767637C23BB42CD5D7397CF58B0BE688%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=14C4E4C72BA075E9069EE67F39188AD8%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=3C782813D4AFCE07BBFC5A9772ACDBDC%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=7D010C6BB6A3726F327F7E239166D127%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=89159BA4DD04E4CE5559F132A9964EB3%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=6F33F4A5FC42B8CEC7314947BD13F30F%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=5834ED4291BDEB928270428EBBAF7604%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=5A8A8A43F25485E7EE1B201EDCBC7A38%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=DC7D30B90B2D8ABF664FBED2B1B59894%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=41923EA1F824FE63EA5BEB84DB7A3E74%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=3DE09703C8E79ED2CA3F01074719906B%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - Windows Credential Editor (WCE) Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects the use of Windows Credential Editor (WCE), a popular post-exploitation tool used to extract plaintext passwords, hash, PIN code and Kerberos tickets from memory.
It is often used by threat actors for credential dumping and lateral movement within compromised networks.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\WCE.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\WCE64.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=136F0A8572C058A96436C82E541E4C41%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=589657C64DDE88533186C39F82FA1F50%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=6BFE09EFCB4FFDE061EBDBAFC4DB84CF%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=7D490037BF450877E6D0287BDCFF8D2E%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=8AB93B061287C79F3088C5BC7E7D97ED%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=A53A02B997935FD8EEDCB5F7ABAB9B9F%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=BA434A7A729EEC20E136CA4C32D6C740%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=BD1D1547DA13C0FCB6C15E86217D5EB8%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=E96A73C7BF33A464C510EDE582318BF2%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - winPEAS Execution
rules.author: Georg Lauenstein (sure[secure])
rules.description: WinPEAS is a script that search for possible paths to escalate privileges on Windows hosts. The checks are explained on book.hacktricks.xyz
rules.sql: (OriginalFileName='winPEAS.exe' OR (Image LIKE '%\\winPEASany\_ofs.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\winPEASany.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\winPEASx64\_ofs.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\winPEASx64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\winPEASx86\_ofs.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\winPEASx86.exe' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '% applicationsinfo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% browserinfo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% eventsinfo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% fileanalysis%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% filesinfo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% processinfo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% servicesinfo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% windowscreds%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://github.com/carlospolop/PEASS-ng/releases/latest/download/%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ParentCommandLine LIKE '% -linpeas' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -linpeas' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: HackTool - WinPwn Execution
rules.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
rules.description: Detects commandline keywords indicative of potential usge of the tool WinPwn. A tool for Windows and Active Directory reconnaissance and exploitation.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%Offline\_Winpwn%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%WinPwn %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%WinPwn.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%WinPwn.ps1%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: HackTool - Wmiexec Default Powershell Command
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of PowerShell with a specific flag sequence that is used by the Wmiexec script
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%-NoP -NoL -sta -NonI -W Hidden -Exec Bypass -Enc%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: HackTool - XORDump Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious use of XORDump process memory dumping utility
falsepositives: Another tool that uses the command line switches of XORdump
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\xordump.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -process lsass.exe %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -m comsvcs %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -m dbghelp %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -m dbgcore %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious ZipExec Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: ZipExec is a Proof-of-Concept (POC) tool to wrap binary-based tools into a password-protected zip file.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%/generic:Microsoft\_Windows\_Shell\_ZipFolder:filename=%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.zip%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/pass:%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/user:%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/delete%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Microsoft\_Windows\_Shell\_ZipFolder:filename=%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.zip%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious HWP Sub Processes
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious Hangul Word Processor (Hanword) sub processes that could indicate an exploitation
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\Hwp.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\gbb.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Fake Instance Of Hxtsr.EXE Executed
rules.author: Sreeman
rules.description:
HxTsr.exe is a Microsoft compressed executable file called Microsoft Outlook Communications.
HxTsr.exe is part of Outlook apps, because it resides in a hidden "WindowsApps" subfolder of "C:\Program Files".
Any instances of hxtsr.exe not in this folder may be malware camouflaging itself as HxTsr.exe
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\hxtsr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%:\\program files\\windowsapps\\microsoft.windowscommunicationsapps\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\hxtsr.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Use Icacls to Hide File to Everyone
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detect use of icacls to deny access for everyone in Users folder sometimes used to hide malicious files
rules.sql: (OriginalFileName='iCACLS.EXE' OR Image LIKE '%\\icacls.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/deny%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%S-1-1-0:%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: File Download And Execution Via IEExec.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of the IEExec utility to download and execute files
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\IEExec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='IEExec.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Self Extracting Package Creation Via Iexpress.EXE From Potentially Suspicious Location
rules.author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects the use of iexpress.exe to create binaries via Self Extraction Directive (SED) files located in potentially suspicious locations.
This behavior has been observed in-the-wild by different threat actors.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\iexpress.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='IEXPRESS.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―n %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Disable Windows IIS HTTP Logging
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Disables HTTP logging on a Windows IIS web server as seen by Threat Group 3390 (Bronze Union)
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\appcmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='appcmd.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%set%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%config%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%section:httplogging%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%dontLog:true%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Microsoft IIS Service Account Password Dumped
rules.author: Tim Rauch, Janantha Marasinghe, Elastic (original idea)
rules.description: Detects the Internet Information Services (IIS) command-line tool, AppCmd, being used to list passwords
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\appcmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='appcmd.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%list %' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% /config%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /xml%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -config%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -xml%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% /@t%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /text%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /show%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -@t%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -text%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -show%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:*%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%password%' ESCAPE '\')))

rules.title: IIS Native-Code Module Command Line Installation
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious IIS native-code module installations via command line
falsepositives: Unknown as it may vary from organisation to organisation how admins use to install IIS modules
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\appcmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='appcmd.exe') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%install%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%module%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-name:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/name:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–name:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—name:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―name:%' ESCAPE '\'))) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\inetsrv\\iissetup.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious IIS URL GlobalRules Rewrite Via AppCmd
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of "appcmd" to create new global URL rewrite rules. This behaviour has been observed being used by threat actors to add new rules so they can access their webshells.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of appcmd to add new URL rewrite rules
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\appcmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='appcmd.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%set%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%config%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%section:system.webServer/rewrite/globalRules%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%commit:%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Microsoft IIS Connection Strings Decryption
rules.author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)
rules.description: Detects use of aspnet_regiis to decrypt Microsoft IIS connection strings. An attacker with Microsoft IIS web server access via a webshell or alike can decrypt and dump any hardcoded connection strings, such as the MSSQL service account password using aspnet_regiis command.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\aspnet\_regiis.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE 'aspnet\_regiis.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%connectionStrings%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -pdf%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious IIS Module Registration
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Microsoft (idea)
rules.description: Detects a suspicious IIS module registration as described in Microsoft threat report on IIS backdoors
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\w3wp.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%appcmd.exe add module%' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '% system.enterpriseservices.internal.publish%' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%gacutil%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /I%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: C# IL Code Compilation Via Ilasm.EXE
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of "Ilasm.EXE" in order to compile C# intermediate (IL) code to EXE or DLL.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\ilasm.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='ilasm.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /exe%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: ImagingDevices Unusual Parent/Child Processes
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects unusual parent or children of the ImagingDevices.exe (Windows Contacts) process as seen being used with Bumblebee activity
rules.sql: ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\WmiPrvSE.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\dllhost.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%\\ImagingDevices.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\ImagingDevices.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Arbitrary File Download Via IMEWDBLD.EXE
rules.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
rules.description: Detects usage of "IMEWDBLD.exe" to download arbitrary files
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\IMEWDBLD.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='imewdbld.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: InfDefaultInstall.exe .inf Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Executes SCT script using scrobj.dll from a command in entered into a specially prepared INF file.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%InfDefaultInstall.exe %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.inf%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: File Download Via InstallUtil.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects use of .NET InstallUtil.exe in order to download arbitrary files. The files will be written to "%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\INetCache\IE\"
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\InstallUtil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='InstallUtil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Execution of InstallUtil Without Log
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Uses the .NET InstallUtil.exe application in order to execute image without log
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\InstallUtil.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%Microsoft.NET\\Framework%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/logfile= %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/LogToConsole=false%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Shells Spawn by Java Utility Keytool
rules.author: Andreas Hunkeler (@Karneades)
rules.description: Detects suspicious shell spawn from Java utility keytool process (e.g. adselfservice plus exploitation)
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\keytool.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\sh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\whoami.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\scrcons.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\hh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\forfiles.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\scriptrunner.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mftrace.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AppVLP.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\systeminfo.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\query.exe' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Child Process Of Manage Engine ServiceDesk
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious child processes of the "Manage Engine ServiceDesk Plus" Java web service
falsepositives: Legitimate sub processes started by Manage Engine ServiceDesk Pro
rules.sql: ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\ManageEngine\\ServiceDesk\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentImage LIKE '%\\java.exe%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Image LIKE '%\\AppVLP.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\calc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\curl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\forfiles.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mftrace.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\notepad.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\query.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\scrcons.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\sh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\systeminfo.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\whoami.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((Image LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '% stop%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Java Running with Remote Debugging
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a JAVA process running with remote debugging allowing more than just localhost to connect
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%transport=dt\_socket,address=%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%jre1.%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%jdk1.%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%address=127.0.0.1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%address=localhost%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Processes Spawned by Java.EXE
rules.author: Andreas Hunkeler (@Karneades), Florian Roth
rules.description: Detects suspicious processes spawned from a Java host process which could indicate a sign of exploitation (e.g. log4j)
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\java.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%\\AppVLP.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\curl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\forfiles.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\hh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mftrace.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\query.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\scrcons.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\scriptrunner.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\sh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\systeminfo.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\whoami.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Shell Process Spawned by Java.EXE
rules.author: Andreas Hunkeler (@Karneades), Nasreddine Bencherchali
rules.description: Detects shell spawned from Java host process, which could be a sign of exploitation (e.g. log4j exploitation)
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\java.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%build%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%build%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Kavremover Dropped Binary LOLBIN Usage
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of a signed binary dropped by Kaspersky Lab Products Remover (kavremover) which can be abused as a LOLBIN to execute arbitrary commands and binaries.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '% run run-cmd %' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%\\cleanapi.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\kavremover.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Windows Kernel Debugger Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of the Windows Kernel Debugger "kd.exe".
falsepositives: Rare occasions of legitimate cases where kernel debugging is necessary in production. Investigation is required
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\kd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='kd.exe'

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Child Process of KeyScrambler.exe
rules.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
rules.description: Detects potentially suspicious child processes of KeyScrambler.exe
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\KeyScrambler.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ((Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe' OR OriginalFileName='cscript.exe' OR OriginalFileName='mshta.exe' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll' OR OriginalFileName='regsvr32.exe' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='wscript.exe'))

rules.title: Computer Password Change Via Ksetup.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects password change for the computer's domain account or host principal via "ksetup.exe"
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\ksetup.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='ksetup.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '% /setcomputerpassword %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Logged-On User Password Change Via Ksetup.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects password change for the logged-on user's via "ksetup.exe"
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\ksetup.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='ksetup.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '% /ChangePassword %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Active Directory Structure Export Via Ldifde.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of "ldifde.exe" in order to export organizational Active Directory structure.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\ldifde.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='ldifde.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%-f%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% -i%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Import LDAP Data Interchange Format File Via Ldifde.EXE
rules.author: @gott_cyber
rules.description: Detects the execution of "Ldifde.exe" with the import flag "-i". The can be abused to include HTTP-based arguments which will allow the arbitrary download of files from a remote server.
falsepositives: Since the content of the files are unknown, false positives are expected
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\ldifde.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='ldifde.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-i%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-f%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Uncommon Link.EXE Parent Process
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects an uncommon parent process of "LINK.EXE".
Link.EXE in Microsoft incremental linker. Its a utility usually bundled with Visual Studio installation.
Multiple utilities often found in the same folder (editbin.exe, dumpbin.exe, lib.exe, etc) have a hardcode call to the "LINK.EXE" binary without checking its validity.
This would allow an attacker to sideload any binary with the name "link.exe" if one of the aforementioned tools get executed from a different location.
By filtering the known locations of such utilities we can spot uncommon parent process of LINK.EXE that might be suspicious or malicious.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\link.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%LINK /%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Visual Studio\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft Visual Studio\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ParentImage LIKE '%\\VC\\bin\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\VC\\Tools\\%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Rebuild Performance Counter Values Via Lodctr.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of "lodctr.exe" to rebuild the performance counter registry values. This can be abused by attackers by providing a malicious config file to overwrite performance counter configuration to confuse and evade monitoring and security solutions.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\lodctr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND OriginalFileName='LODCTR.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -r%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /r%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –r%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —r%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―r%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Windows Trace ETW Session Tamper Via Logman.EXE
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of "logman" utility in order to disable or delete Windows trace sessions
falsepositives: Installer tools that disable services, e.g. before log collection agent installation
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\logman.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Logman.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%stop %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%delete %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Circular Kernel Context Logger%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%EventLog-%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SYSMON TRACE%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SysmonDnsEtwSession%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: LOLBAS Data Exfiltration by DataSvcUtil.exe
rules.author: Ialle Teixeira @teixeira0xfffff, Austin Songer @austinsonger
rules.description: Detects when a user performs data exfiltration by using DataSvcUtil.exe
falsepositives: DataSvcUtil.exe being used may be performed by a system administrator.
Verify whether the user identity, user agent, and/or hostname should be making changes in your environment.
DataSvcUtil.exe being executed from unfamiliar users should be investigated. If known behavior is causing false positives, it can be exempted from the rule.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%/in:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/out:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/uri:%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Image LIKE '%\\DataSvcUtil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='DataSvcUtil.exe')

rules.title: Devtoolslauncher.exe Executes Specified Binary
rules.author: Beyu Denis, oscd.community (rule), @_felamos (idea)
rules.description: The Devtoolslauncher.exe executes other binary
falsepositives: Legitimate use of devtoolslauncher.exe by legitimate user
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\devtoolslauncher.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%LaunchForDeploy%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Diantz Alternate Data Stream Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Compress target file into a cab file stored in the Alternate Data Stream (ADS) of the target file.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%diantz.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.cab%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine REGEXP ':[^\\]'

rules.title: Suspicious Diantz Download and Compress Into a CAB File
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Download and compress a remote file and store it in a cab file on local machine.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%diantz.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% \\\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.cab%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Extrac32 Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Download or Copy file with Extrac32
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%extrac32.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\extrac32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='extrac32.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%.cab%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/C%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/Y%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% \\\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Extrac32 Alternate Data Stream Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Extract data from cab file and hide it in an alternate data stream
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%extrac32.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.cab%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine REGEXP ':[^\\]'

rules.title: Potential Reconnaissance Activity Via GatherNetworkInfo.VBS
rules.author: blueteamer8699
rules.description: Detects execution of the built-in script located in "C:\Windows\System32\gatherNetworkInfo.vbs". Which can be used to gather information about the target machine
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='cscript.exe' OR OriginalFileName='wscript.exe')) AND CommandLine LIKE '%gatherNetworkInfo.vbs%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Gpscript Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects the execution of the LOLBIN gpscript, which executes logon or startup scripts configured in Group Policy
falsepositives: Legitimate uses of logon scripts distributed via group policy
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\gpscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='GPSCRIPT.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /logon%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /startup%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentCommandLine LIKE 'C:\\windows\\system32\\svchost.exe -k netsvcs -p -s gpsvc' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Ie4uinit Lolbin Use From Invalid Path
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detect use of ie4uinit.exe to execute commands from a specially prepared ie4uinit.inf file from a directory other than the usual directories
falsepositives: ViberPC updater calls this binary with the following commandline "ie4uinit.exe -ClearIconCache"
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\ie4uinit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='IE4UINIT.EXE') AND (NOT COALESCE(((CurrentDirectory LIKE 'c:\\windows\\system32\\' ESCAPE '\' OR CurrentDirectory LIKE 'c:\\windows\\sysWOW64\\' ESCAPE '\') OR CurrentDirectory IS NULL), 0))

rules.title: Launch-VsDevShell.PS1 Proxy Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of the 'Launch-VsDevShell.ps1' Microsoft signed script to execute commands.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of the script by a developer
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%Launch-VsDevShell.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%VsWherePath %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%VsInstallationPath %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Manage-bde.wsf Abuse To Proxy Execution
rules.author: oscd.community, Natalia Shornikova, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects potential abuse of the "manage-bde.wsf" script as a LOLBIN to proxy execution
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wscript.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%manage-bde.wsf%' ESCAPE '\') OR (((ParentImage LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%manage-bde.wsf%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))

rules.title: Mavinject Inject DLL Into Running Process
rules.author: frack113, Florian Roth
rules.description: Detects process injection using the signed Windows tool "Mavinject" via the "INJECTRUNNING" flag
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '% /INJECTRUNNING %' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\AppVClient.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: MpiExec Lolbin
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a certain command line flag combination used by mpiexec.exe LOLBIN from HPC pack that can be used to execute any other binary
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\mpiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=d8b52ef6aaa3a81501bdfff9dbb96217%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /n 1 %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -n 1 %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Execute Files with Msdeploy.exe
rules.author: Beyu Denis, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects file execution using the msdeploy.exe lolbin
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%verb:sync%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-source:RunCommand%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-dest:runCommand%' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%\\msdeploy.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Use of OpenConsole
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
