rules.description: Detects usage of OpenConsole binary as a LOLBIN to launch other binaries to bypass application Whitelisting
rules.sql: (OriginalFileName='OpenConsole.exe' OR Image LIKE '%\\OpenConsole.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\WindowsApps\\Microsoft.WindowsTerminal%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: OpenWith.exe Executes Specified Binary
rules.author: Beyu Denis, oscd.community (rule), @harr0ey (idea)
rules.description: The OpenWith.exe executes other binary
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\OpenWith.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/c%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Use of Pcalua For Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), E.M. Anhaus (originally from Atomic Blue Detections, Endgame), oscd.community
rules.description: Detects execition of commands and binaries from the context of The program compatibility assistant (Pcalua.exe). This can be used as a LOLBIN in order to bypass application whitelisting.
falsepositives: Legitimate use by a via a batch script or by an administrator.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\pcalua.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -a%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Execute Pcwrun.EXE To Leverage Follina
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects indirect command execution via Program Compatibility Assistant "pcwrun.exe" leveraging the follina (CVE-2022-30190) vulnerability
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\pcwrun.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%../%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Code Execution via Pcwutl.dll
rules.author: Julia Fomina, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects launch of executable by calling the LaunchApplication function from pcwutl.dll library.
falsepositives: Use of Program Compatibility Troubleshooter Helper
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%pcwutl%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%LaunchApplication%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Execute Code with Pester.bat
rules.author: Julia Fomina, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects code execution via Pester.bat (Pester - Powershell Modulte for testing)
falsepositives: Legitimate use of Pester for writing tests for Powershell scripts and modules
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Pester%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Get-Help%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%pester%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%;%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%help%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%?%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: PrintBrm ZIP Creation of Extraction
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects the execution of the LOLBIN PrintBrm.exe, which can be used to create or extract ZIP files. PrintBrm.exe should not be run on a normal workstation.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\PrintBrm.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -f%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.zip%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Pubprn.vbs Proxy Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects the use of the 'Pubprn.vbs' Microsoft signed script to execute commands.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%\\pubprn.vbs%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%script:%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: DLL Execution via Rasautou.exe
rules.author: Julia Fomina, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects using Rasautou.exe for loading arbitrary .DLL specified in -d option and executes the export specified in -p.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\rasautou.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='rasdlui.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -d %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -p %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: REGISTER_APP.VBS Proxy Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of a Microsoft signed script 'REGISTER_APP.VBS' to register a VSS/VDS Provider as a COM+ application.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of the script. Always investigate what's being registered to confirm if it's benign
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%\\register\_app.vbs%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-register%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Use of Remote.exe
rules.author: Christopher Peacock @SecurePeacock, SCYTHE @scythe_io
rules.description: Remote.exe is part of WinDbg in the Windows SDK and can be used for AWL bypass and running remote files.
falsepositives: Approved installs of Windows SDK with Debugging Tools for Windows (WinDbg).
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\remote.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='remote.exe'

rules.title: Replace.exe Usage
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects the use of Replace.exe which can be used to replace file with another file
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\replace.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―a%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Runscripthelper.exe
rules.author: Victor Sergeev, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects execution of powershell scripts via Runscripthelper.exe
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\Runscripthelper.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%surfacecheck%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Use of Scriptrunner.exe
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: The "ScriptRunner.exe" binary can be abused to proxy execution through it and bypass possible whitelisting
falsepositives: Legitimate use when App-v is deployed
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\ScriptRunner.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='ScriptRunner.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '% -appvscript %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Using SettingSyncHost.exe as LOLBin
rules.author: Anton Kutepov, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects using SettingSyncHost.exe to run hijacked binary
rules.sql: (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /c%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%RoamDiag.cmd%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%-outputpath%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Use Of The SFTP.EXE Binary As A LOLBIN
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the usage of the "sftp.exe" binary as a LOLBIN by abusing the "-D" flag
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\sftp.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -D ..%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -D C:\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Driver Install by pnputil.exe
rules.author: Hai Vaknin @LuxNoBulIshit, Avihay eldad  @aloneliassaf, Austin Songer @austinsonger
rules.description: Detects when a possible suspicious driver is being installed via pnputil.exe lolbin
falsepositives: Pnputil.exe being used may be performed by a system administrator.
Verify whether the user identity, user agent, and/or hostname should be making changes in your environment.
Pnputil.exe being executed from unfamiliar users should be investigated. If known behavior is causing false positives, it can be exempted from the rule.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%-i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/install%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/add-driver%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.inf%' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%\\pnputil.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious GrpConv Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the suspicious execution of a utility to convert Windows 3.x .grp files or for persistence purposes by malicious software or actors
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%grpconv.exe -o%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%grpconv -o%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Dumping Process via Sqldumper.exe
rules.author: Kirill Kiryanov, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects process dump via legitimate sqldumper.exe binary
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\sqldumper.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%0x0110%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%0x01100:40%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: SyncAppvPublishingServer Execute Arbitrary PowerShell Code
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Executes arbitrary PowerShell code using SyncAppvPublishingServer.exe.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\SyncAppvPublishingServer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='syncappvpublishingserver.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%"n; %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: SyncAppvPublishingServer VBS Execute Arbitrary PowerShell Code
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Executes arbitrary PowerShell code using SyncAppvPublishingServer.vbs
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%\\SyncAppvPublishingServer.vbs%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%;%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential DLL Injection Or Execution Using Tracker.exe
rules.author: Avneet Singh @v3t0_, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects potential DLL injection and execution using "Tracker.exe"
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\tracker.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Description='Tracker') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /d %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /c %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% /ERRORREPORT:PROMPT %' ESCAPE '\' OR (ParentImage LIKE '%\\Msbuild\\Current\\Bin\\MSBuild.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\Msbuild\\Current\\Bin\\amd64\\MSBuild.exe' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Use of TTDInject.exe
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects the executiob of TTDInject.exe, which is used by Windows 10 v1809 and newer to debug time travel (underlying call of tttracer.exe)
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%ttdinject.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='TTDInject.EXE'

rules.title: Lolbin Unregmp2.exe Use As Proxy
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detect usage of the "unregmp2.exe" binary as a proxy to launch a custom version of "wmpnscfg.exe"
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\unregmp2.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='unregmp2.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -HideWMP%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /HideWMP%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –HideWMP%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —HideWMP%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―HideWMP%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: UtilityFunctions.ps1 Proxy Dll
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects the use of a Microsoft signed script executing a managed DLL with PowerShell.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%UtilityFunctions.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%RegSnapin %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Visual Basic Command Line Compiler Usage
rules.author: Ensar Şamil, @sblmsrsn, @oscd_initiative
rules.description: Detects successful code compilation via Visual Basic Command Line Compiler that utilizes Windows Resource to Object Converter.
falsepositives: Utilization of this tool should not be seen in enterprise environment
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\vbc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\cvtres.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Use of VisualUiaVerifyNative.exe
rules.author: Christopher Peacock @SecurePeacock, SCYTHE @scythe_io
rules.description: VisualUiaVerifyNative.exe is a Windows SDK that can be used for AWL bypass and is listed in Microsoft's recommended block rules.
falsepositives: Legitimate testing of Microsoft UI parts.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\VisualUiaVerifyNative.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='VisualUiaVerifyNative.exe'

rules.title: Use of VSIISExeLauncher.exe
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: The "VSIISExeLauncher.exe" binary part of the Visual Studio/VS Code can be used to execute arbitrary binaries
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\VSIISExeLauncher.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='VSIISExeLauncher.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -p %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -a %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Use of Wfc.exe
rules.author: Christopher Peacock @SecurePeacock, SCYTHE @scythe_io
rules.description: The Workflow Command-line Compiler can be used for AWL bypass and is listed in Microsoft's recommended block rules.
falsepositives: Legitimate use by a software developer
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\wfc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wfc.exe'

rules.title: Potential Register_App.Vbs LOLScript Abuse
rules.author: Austin Songer @austinsonger
rules.description: Detects potential abuse of the "register_app.vbs" script that is part of the Windows SDK. The script offers the capability to register new VSS/VDS Provider as a COM+ application. Attackers can use this to install malicious DLLs for persistence and execution.
falsepositives: Other VB scripts that leverage the same starting command line flags
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='cscript.exe' OR OriginalFileName='wscript.exe')) AND CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs -register %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: LSA PPL Protection Setting Modification via CommandLine
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects modification of LSA PPL protection settings via CommandLine.
It may indicate an attempt to disable protection and enable credential dumping tools to access LSASS process memory.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='reg.exe' OR OriginalFileName='powershell.exe' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%ControlSet%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Control\\Lsa%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Set-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%New-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% add %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%IsPplAutoEnabled%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%RunAsPPL%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%RunAsPPLBoot%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Credential Dumping Via LSASS Process Clone
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Samir Bousseaden
rules.description: Detects a suspicious LSASS process process clone that could be a sign of credential dumping activity
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\lsass.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\lsass.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: MMC20 Lateral Movement
rules.author: @2xxeformyshirt (Security Risk Advisors) - rule; Teymur Kheirkhabarov (idea)
rules.description: Detects MMC20.Application Lateral Movement; specifically looks for the spawning of the parent MMC.exe with a command line of "-Embedding" as a child of svchost.exe
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\mmc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-Embedding%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: MMC Spawning Windows Shell
rules.author: Karneades, Swisscom CSIRT
rules.description: Detects a Windows command line executable started from MMC
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\mmc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ((Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\sh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR Image LIKE '%\\BITSADMIN%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: CodePage Modification Via MODE.COM To Russian Language
rules.author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk
rules.description:
Detects a CodePage modification using the "mode.com" utility to Russian language.
This behavior has been used by threat actors behind Dharma ransomware.
falsepositives: Russian speaking people changing the CodePage
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\mode.com' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='MODE.COM') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% con %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% cp %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% select=%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%=1251' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%=866' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Potential Suspicious Mofcomp Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects execution of the "mofcomp" utility as a child of a suspicious shell or script running utility or by having a suspicious path in the commandline.
The "mofcomp" utility parses a file containing MOF statements and adds the classes and class instances defined in the file to the WMI repository.
Attackers abuse this utility to install malicious MOF scripts
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\mofcomp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='mofcomp.exe') AND ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\wsl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\WINDOWS\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%temp\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%tmp\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%appdata\%%' ESCAPE '\'))) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\wbem\\WmiPrvSE.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\TEMP\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.mof' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\TEMP\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.mof' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Potential Mpclient.DLL Sideloading Via Defender Binaries
rules.author: Bhabesh Raj
rules.description: Detects potential sideloading of "mpclient.dll" by Windows Defender processes ("MpCmdRun" and "NisSrv") from their non-default directory.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\MpCmdRun.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\NisSrv.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Windows Defender\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Security Client\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Windows Defender\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Platform\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: File Download Via Windows Defender MpCmpRun.EXE
rules.author: Matthew Matchen
rules.description: Detects the use of Windows Defender MpCmdRun.EXE to download files
rules.sql: (OriginalFileName='MpCmdRun.exe' OR Image LIKE '%\\MpCmdRun.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%MpCmdRun.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Description='Microsoft Malware Protection Command Line Utility') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%DownloadFile%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%url%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Windows Defender Definition Files Removed
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Adversaries may disable security tools to avoid possible detection of their tools and activities by removing Windows Defender Definition Files
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\MpCmdRun.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='MpCmdRun.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -RemoveDefinitions%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -All%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Msbuild Execution By Uncommon Parent Process
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects suspicious execution of 'Msbuild.exe' by a uncommon parent process
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\MSBuild.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='MSBuild.exe') AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%\\devenv.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\msbuild.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\python.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\nuget.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: MSDT Execution Via Answer File
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "msdt.exe" using an answer file which is simulating the legitimate way of calling msdt via "pcwrun.exe" (For example from the compatibility tab).
falsepositives: Possible undocumented parents of "msdt" other than "pcwrun".
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\msdt.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\WINDOWS\\diagnostics\\index\\PCWDiagnostic.xml%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -af %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /af %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –af %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —af %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―af %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%\\pcwrun.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Potential Arbitrary Command Execution Using Msdt.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects processes leveraging the "ms-msdt" handler or the "msdt.exe" binary to execute arbitrary commands as seen in the follina (CVE-2022-30190) vulnerability
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\msdt.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='msdt.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%IT\_BrowseForFile=%' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '% PCWDiagnostic%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -af %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /af %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –af %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —af %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―af %' ESCAPE '\')))

rules.title: Suspicious Cabinet File Execution Via Msdt.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), GossiTheDog, frack113
rules.description: Detects execution of msdt.exe using the "cab" flag which could indicates suspicious diagcab files with embedded answer files leveraging CVE-2022-30190
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\msdt.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='msdt.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -cab %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /cab %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –cab %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —cab %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―cab %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious MSDT Parent Process
rules.author: Nextron Systems
rules.description: Detects msdt.exe executed by a suspicious parent as seen in CVE-2022-30190 / Follina exploitation
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\wsl.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (Image LIKE '%\\msdt.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='msdt.exe')

rules.title: Arbitrary File Download Via MSEDGE_PROXY.EXE
rules.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
rules.description: Detects usage of "msedge_proxy.exe" to download arbitrary files
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\msedge\_proxy.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE 'msedge\_proxy.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Remotely Hosted HTA File Executed Via Mshta.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of the "mshta" utility with an argument containing the "http" keyword, which could indicate that an attacker is executing a remotely hosted malicious hta file
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='MSHTA.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Wscript Shell Run In CommandLine
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the presence of the keywords "Wscript", "Shell" and "Run" in the command, which could indicate a suspicious activity
falsepositives: Inline scripting can be used by some rare third party applications or administrators. Investigate and apply additional filters accordingly
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%Wscript.%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.Shell%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.Run%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious JavaScript Execution Via Mshta.EXE
rules.author: E.M. Anhaus (originally from Atomic Blue Detections, Endgame), oscd.community
rules.description: Detects execution of javascript code using "mshta.exe".
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='MSHTA.EXE') AND CommandLine LIKE '%javascript%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential LethalHTA Technique Execution
rules.author: Markus Neis
rules.description: Detects potential LethalHTA technique where the "mshta.exe" is spawned by an "svchost.exe" process
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious MSHTA Child Process
rules.author: Michael Haag
rules.description: Detects a suspicious process spawning from an "mshta.exe" process, which could be indicative of a malicious HTA script execution
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ((Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\sh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll' OR OriginalFileName='wscript.exe' OR OriginalFileName='cscript.exe' OR OriginalFileName='Bash.exe' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe' OR OriginalFileName='REGSVR32.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='bitsadmin.exe'))

rules.title: MSHTA Execution with Suspicious File Extensions
rules.author: Diego Perez (@darkquassar), Markus Neis, Swisscom (Improve Rule), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects execution of mshta.exe with file types that looks like they do not typically represent HTA (HTML Application) content,
such as .png, .jpg, .zip, .pdf, and others, which are often polyglots. MSHTA is a legitimate Windows utility for executing HTML Applications
containing VBScript or JScript. Threat actors often abuse this lolbin utility to download and
execute malicious scripts disguised as benign files or hosted under misleading extensions to evade detection.
falsepositives: False positives depend on scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='mshta.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.7z%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.avi%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.conf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.csv%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.doc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.gif%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.gz%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ini%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.json%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.lnk%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.log%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.mkv%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.mp3%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.mp4%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.pdf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.png%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ppt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.rar%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.rtf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.svg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.tar%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.tmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.txt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.xls%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.xml%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.yaml%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.yml%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.zip%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%vbscript%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Mshta.EXE Execution Patterns
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious mshta process execution patterns
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='MSHTA.EXE') AND ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\'))) OR ((Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='MSHTA.EXE') AND (NOT COALESCE(((Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.htm%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.hta%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mshta' ESCAPE '\')), 0)))

rules.title: DllUnregisterServer Function Call Via Msiexec.EXE
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects MsiExec loading a DLL and calling its DllUnregisterServer function
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -z %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /z %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –z %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —z %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―z %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious MsiExec Embedding Parent
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Adversaries may abuse msiexec.exe to proxy the execution of malicious payloads
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%MsiExec.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%-Embedding %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Program Files\\SplunkUniversalForwarder\\bin\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%\\DismFoDInstall.cmd%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%\\MsiExec.exe -Embedding %' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%Global\\MSI0000%' ESCAPE '\'))), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Msiexec Execute Arbitrary DLL
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may abuse msiexec.exe to proxy execution of malicious payloads.
Msiexec.exe is the command-line utility for the Windows Installer and is thus commonly associated with executing installation packages (.msi)
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -Y%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /Y%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –Y%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —Y%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―Y%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%\\MsiExec.exe" /Y "C:\\Program Files\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\MsiExec.exe" /Y "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\MsiExec.exe" /Y "C:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\MsiExec.exe" /Y "C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Msiexec Quiet Installation
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may abuse msiexec.exe to proxy execution of malicious payloads.
Msiexec.exe is the command-line utility for the Windows Installer and is thus commonly associated with executing installation packages (.msi)
falsepositives: WindowsApps installing updates via the quiet flag
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='msiexec.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-j%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/j%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–j%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—j%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―j%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-q%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/q%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–q%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—q%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―q%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentImage LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\CCM\\Ccm32BitLauncher.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384'))), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Msiexec Quiet Install From Remote Location
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of Msiexec.exe to install packages hosted remotely quietly
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='msiexec.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-j%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/j%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–j%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—j%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―j%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-q%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/q%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–q%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—q%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―q%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\OpenOffice%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Installation Files\\openoffice%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Potential MsiExec Masquerading
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of msiexec.exe from an uncommon directory
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: MsiExec Web Install
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious msiexec process starts with web addresses as parameter
falsepositives: False positives depend on scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '% msiexec%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%://%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Arbitrary File Download Via MSOHTMED.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of "MSOHTMED" to download arbitrary files
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\MSOHTMED.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='MsoHtmEd.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Arbitrary File Download Via MSPUB.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of "MSPUB" (Microsoft Publisher) to download arbitrary files
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\MSPUB.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='MSPUB.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Process Injection Via Msra.EXE
rules.author: Alexander McDonald
rules.description: Detects potential process injection via Microsoft Remote Asssistance (Msra.exe) by looking at suspicious child processes spawned from the aforementioned process. It has been a target used by many threat actors and used for discovery and persistence tactics
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\msra.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%msra.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%\\arp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\netstat.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\nslookup.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\route.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\whoami.exe' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Detection of PowerShell Execution via Sqlps.exe
rules.author: Agro (@agro_sev) oscd.community
rules.description:
This rule detects execution of a PowerShell code through the sqlps.exe utility, which is included in the standard set of utilities supplied with the MSSQL Server.
Script blocks are not logged in this case, so this utility helps to bypass protection mechanisms based on the analysis of these logs.
falsepositives: Direct PS command execution through SQLPS.exe is uncommon, childprocess sqlps.exe spawned by sqlagent.exe is a legitimate action.
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\sqlps.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ((Image LIKE '%\\sqlps.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='sqlps.exe') AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%\\sqlagent.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))

rules.title: SQL Client Tools PowerShell Session Detection
rules.author: Agro (@agro_sev) oscd.communitly
rules.description:
This rule detects execution of a PowerShell code through the sqltoolsps.exe utility, which is included in the standard set of utilities supplied with the Microsoft SQL Server Management studio.
Script blocks are not logged in this case, so this utility helps to bypass protection mechanisms based on the analysis of these logs.
falsepositives: Direct PS command execution through SQLToolsPS.exe is uncommon, childprocess sqltoolsps.exe spawned by smss.exe is a legitimate action.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\sqltoolsps.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\sqltoolsps.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '\\sqltoolsps.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%\\smss.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Child Process Of SQL Server
rules.author: FPT.EagleEye Team, wagga
rules.description: Detects suspicious child processes of the SQLServer process. This could indicate potential RCE or SQL Injection.
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\sqlservr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\netstat.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\nltest.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\ping.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\sh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\systeminfo.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\tasklist.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wsl.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft SQL Server\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentImage LIKE '%DATEV\_DBENGINE\\MSSQL\\Binn\\sqlservr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '"C:\\Windows\\system32\\cmd.exe" %' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Child Process Of Veeam Dabatase
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious child processes of the Veeam service process. This could indicate potential RCE or SQL Injection.
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\sqlservr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%VEEAMSQL%' ESCAPE '\') AND (((Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wsl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wt.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-ex %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%bypass%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DownloadString%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mshta%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%regsvr32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%copy %' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\netstat.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\nltest.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\ping.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\tasklist.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\whoami.exe' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Potential MSTSC Shadowing Activity
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects RDP session hijacking by using MSTSC shadowing
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%noconsentprompt%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%shadow:%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: New Remote Desktop Connection Initiated Via Mstsc.EXE
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Detects the usage of "mstsc.exe" with the "/v" flag to initiate a connection to a remote server.
Adversaries may use valid accounts to log into a computer using the Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP). The adversary may then perform actions as the logged-on user.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\mstsc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='mstsc.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -v:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /v:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –v:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —v:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―v:%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\lxss\\wslhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\WSL\\wslg.rdp%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Mstsc.EXE Execution With Local RDP File
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects potential RDP connection via Mstsc using a local ".rdp" file located in suspicious locations.
falsepositives: Likelihood is related to how often the paths are used in the environment
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\mstsc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='mstsc.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.rdp' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.rdp"' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\spool\\drivers\\color%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\_Migrated %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Tracing\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Mstsc.EXE Execution From Uncommon Parent
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects potential RDP connection via Mstsc using a local ".rdp" file located in suspicious locations.
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\brave.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\CCleanerBrowser.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\chrome.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\chromium.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\firefox.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\iexplore.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\microsoftedge.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\msedge.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\opera.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\vivaldi.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\whale.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\outlook.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (Image LIKE '%\\mstsc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='mstsc.exe')

rules.title: Msxsl.EXE Execution
rules.author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
rules.description:
Detects the execution of the MSXSL utility. This can be used to execute Extensible Stylesheet Language (XSL) files. These files are commonly used to describe the processing and rendering of data within XML files.
Adversaries can abuse this functionality to execute arbitrary files while potentially bypassing application whitelisting defenses.
falsepositives: Msxsl is not installed by default and is deprecated, so unlikely on most systems.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\msxsl.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Remote XSL Execution Via Msxsl.EXE
rules.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
rules.description: Detects the execution of the "msxsl" binary with an "http" keyword in the command line. This might indicate a potential remote execution of XSL files.
falsepositives: Msxsl is not installed by default and is deprecated, so unlikely on most systems.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\msxsl.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Group And Account Reconnaissance Activity Using Net.EXE
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), omkar72, @svch0st, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects suspicious reconnaissance command line activity on Windows systems using Net.EXE
Check if the user that executed the commands is suspicious (e.g. service accounts, LOCAL_SYSTEM)
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='net.exe' OR OriginalFileName='net1.exe')) AND ((((CommandLine LIKE '% group %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% localgroup %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%domain admins%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% administrator%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% administrateur%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%enterprise admins%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Exchange Trusted Subsystem%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Remote Desktop Users%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Utilisateurs du Bureau à distance%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Usuarios de escritorio remoto%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /do%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% /add%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))) OR (CommandLine LIKE '% accounts %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /do%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Windows Admin Share Mount Via Net.EXE
rules.author: oscd.community, Teymur Kheirkhabarov @HeirhabarovT, Zach Stanford @svch0st, wagga
rules.description: Detects when an admin share is mounted using net.exe
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='net.exe' OR OriginalFileName='net1.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '% use %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% \\\\%\\%$%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Windows Internet Hosted WebDav Share Mount Via Net.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects when an internet hosted webdav share is mounted using the "net.exe" utility
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='net.exe' OR OriginalFileName='net1.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '% use %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% http%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Password Provided In Command Line Of Net.EXE
rules.author: Tim Shelton (HAWK.IO)
rules.description: Detects a when net.exe is called with a password in the command line
rules.sql: (((Image LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='net.exe' OR OriginalFileName='net1.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '% use %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%:%\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/USER:% %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% ' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: New User Created Via Net.EXE
rules.author: Endgame, JHasenbusch (adapted to Sigma for oscd.community)
rules.description: Identifies the creation of local users via the net.exe command.
falsepositives: Better use event IDs for user creation rather than command line rules.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='net.exe' OR OriginalFileName='net1.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%user%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: New User Created Via Net.EXE With Never Expire Option
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects creation of local users via the net.exe command with the option "never expire"
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='net.exe' OR OriginalFileName='net1.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%user%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%expires:never%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Manipulation Of Default Accounts Via Net.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious manipulations of default accounts such as 'administrator' and 'guest'. For example 'enable' or 'disable' accounts or change the password...etc
falsepositives: Some false positives could occur with the admin or guest account. It depends on the scripts being used by the admins in your env. If you experience a lot of FP you could reduce the level to medium
rules.sql: (((Image LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='net.exe' OR OriginalFileName='net1.exe')) AND CommandLine LIKE '% user %' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% Järjestelmänvalvoja %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% Rendszergazda %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% Администратор %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% Administrateur %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% Administrador %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% Administratör %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% Administrator %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% guest %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% DefaultAccount %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% "Järjestelmänvalvoja" %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% "Rendszergazda" %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% "Администратор" %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% "Administrateur" %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% "Administrador" %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% "Administratör" %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% "Administrator" %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% "guest" %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% "DefaultAccount" %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ''Järjestelmänvalvoja'' %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ''Rendszergazda'' %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ''Администратор'' %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ''Administrateur'' %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ''Administrador'' %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ''Administratör'' %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ''Administrator'' %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ''guest'' %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ''DefaultAccount'' %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%guest%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/active no%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: New Firewall Rule Added Via Netsh.EXE
rules.author: Markus Neis, Sander Wiebing
rules.description: Detects the addition of a new rule to the Windows firewall via netsh
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='netsh.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% firewall %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% add %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%advfirewall firewall add rule name=Dropbox dir=in action=allow "program=_:\\Program Files (x86)\\Dropbox\\Client\\Dropbox.exe" enable=yes profile=Any%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%advfirewall firewall add rule name=Dropbox dir=in action=allow "program=_:\\Program Files\\Dropbox\\Client\\Dropbox.exe" enable=yes profile=Any%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Program Location Whitelisted In Firewall Via Netsh.EXE
rules.author: Sander Wiebing, Jonhnathan Ribeiro, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Netsh command execution that whitelists a program located in a suspicious location in the Windows Firewall
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='netsh.exe') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%firewall%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%allowedprogram%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%advfirewall%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%firewall%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%rule%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%action=allow%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%program=%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\$Recycle.bin\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\RECYCLER.BIN\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\RECYCLERS.BIN\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\SystemVolumeInformation\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Default\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\addins\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\cursors\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\debug\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\drivers\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\fonts\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\help\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\system32\\tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Local Settings\\Temporary Internet Files\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temporary Internet Files\\Content.Outlook\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%Public\%\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%TEMP\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%TMP\%%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: RDP Connection Allowed Via Netsh.EXE
rules.author: Sander Wiebing
rules.description: Detects usage of the netsh command to open and allow connections to port 3389 (RDP). As seen used by Sarwent Malware
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='netsh.exe') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%firewall %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%add %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%tcp %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%3389%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%portopening%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%allow%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Firewall Rule Deleted Via Netsh.EXE
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects the removal of a port or application rule in the Windows Firewall configuration using netsh
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='netsh.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%firewall%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%delete %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentImage LIKE '%\\Dropbox.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%name=Dropbox%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentImage LIKE '%\\instup.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%advfirewall firewall delete rule name="Avast Antivirus Admin Client"%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Firewall Disabled via Netsh.EXE
rules.author: Fatih Sirin
rules.description: Detects netsh commands that turns off the Windows firewall
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='netsh.exe') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%firewall%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%set%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%opmode%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%disable%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%advfirewall%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%set%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%state%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%off%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Netsh Allow Group Policy on Microsoft Defender Firewall
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Adversaries may modify system firewalls in order to bypass controls limiting network usage
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='netsh.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%advfirewall%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%firewall%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%set%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%rule%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%group=%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%new%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%enable=Yes%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Firewall Rule Update Via Netsh.EXE
rules.author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of netsh with the "advfirewall" and the "set" option in order to set new values for properties of a existing rule
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='netsh.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% firewall %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% set %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Persistence Via Netsh Helper DLL
rules.author: Victor Sergeev, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects the execution of netsh with "add helper" flag in order to add a custom helper DLL. This technique can be abused to add a malicious helper DLL that can be used as a persistence proxy that gets called when netsh.exe is executed.
rules.sql: (OriginalFileName='netsh.exe' OR Image LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%helper%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: New Network Trace Capture Started Via Netsh.EXE
rules.author: Kutepov Anton, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects the execution of netsh with the "trace" flag in order to start a network capture
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='netsh.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%trace%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%start%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: New Port Forwarding Rule Added Via Netsh.EXE
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), omkar72, oscd.community, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
rules.description: Detects the execution of netsh commands that configure a new port forwarding (PortProxy) rule
falsepositives: WSL2 network bridge PowerShell script used for WSL/Kubernetes/Docker (e.g. https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/issues/4150#issuecomment-504209723)
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='netsh.exe') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%interface%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%portproxy%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%v4tov4%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%i %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%p %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%a %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%v %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%connectp%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%listena%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%c=%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: RDP Port Forwarding Rule Added Via Netsh.EXE
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), oscd.community
rules.description: Detects the execution of netsh to configure a port forwarding of port 3389 (RDP) rule
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='netsh.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% i%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% p%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%=3389%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% c%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Harvesting Of Wifi Credentials Via Netsh.EXE
rules.author: Andreas Hunkeler (@Karneades), oscd.community
rules.description: Detect the harvesting of wifi credentials using netsh.exe
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='netsh.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%wlan%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% s%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% p%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% k%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%=clear%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Recon Activity Via Nltest.EXE
rules.author: Craig Young, oscd.community, Georg Lauenstein
rules.description: Detects nltest commands that can be used for information discovery
falsepositives: Legitimate administration use but user and host must be investigated
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\nltest.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='nltestrk.exe') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%server%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%query%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/user%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%all\_trusts%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dclist:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dnsgetdc:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%domain\_trusts%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dsgetdc:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%parentdomain%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%trusted\_domains%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Potential Arbitrary Code Execution Via Node.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution node.exe which is shipped with multiple software such as VMware, Adobe...etc. In order to execute arbitrary code. For example to establish reverse shell as seen in Log4j attacks...etc
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\node.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --eval %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.exec(%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%net.socket%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.connect%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%child\_process%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Node Process Executions
rules.author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of other scripts using the Node executable packaged with Adobe Creative Cloud
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\Adobe Creative Cloud Experience\\libs\\node.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%Adobe Creative Cloud Experience\\js%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Network Reconnaissance Activity
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a set of suspicious network related commands often used in recon stages
falsepositives: False positives depend on scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%nslookup%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\_ldap.\_tcp.dc.\_msdcs.%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Nslookup PowerShell Download Cradle - ProcessCreation
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious powershell download cradle using nslookup. This cradle uses nslookup to extract payloads from DNS records
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\nslookup.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '\\nslookup.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -q=txt %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -querytype=txt %' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Suspicious Usage Of Active Directory Diagnostic Tool (ntdsutil.exe)
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of ntdsutil.exe to perform different actions such as restoring snapshots...etc.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\ntdsutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='ntdsutil.exe') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%snapshot%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%mount %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%ac%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% i%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% ntds%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Invocation of Active Directory Diagnostic Tool (ntdsutil.exe)
rules.author: Thomas Patzke
rules.description: Detects execution of ntdsutil.exe, which can be used for various attacks against the NTDS database (NTDS.DIT)
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\ntdsutil.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Driver/DLL Installation Via Odbcconf.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with "INSTALLDRIVER" which installs a new ODBC driver. Attackers abuse this to install and run malicious DLLs.
falsepositives: Legitimate driver DLLs being registered via "odbcconf" will generate false positives. Investigate the path of the DLL and its contents to determine if the action is authorized.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\odbcconf.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='odbcconf.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%INSTALLDRIVER %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Driver/DLL Installation Via Odbcconf.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with the "INSTALLDRIVER" action where the driver doesn't contain a ".dll" extension. This is often used as a defense evasion method.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\odbcconf.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='odbcconf.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%INSTALLDRIVER %' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Odbcconf.EXE Suspicious DLL Location
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" where the path of the DLL being registered is located in a potentially suspicious location.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\odbcconf.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='odbcconf.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\PerfLogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Registration\\CRMLog%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\com\\dmp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\FxsTmp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\Microsoft\\Crypto\\RSA\\MachineKeys\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\spool\\drivers\\color\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\spool\\PRINTERS\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\spool\\SERVERS\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\_Migrated\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\\Microsoft\\Windows\\SyncCenter\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\com\\dmp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\FxsTmp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\Tasks\\Microsoft\\Windows\\PLA\\System\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\Tasks\\Microsoft\\Windows\\SyncCenter\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Tracing\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: New DLL Registered Via Odbcconf.EXE
rules.author: Kirill Kiryanov, Beyu Denis, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with "REGSVR" in order to register a new DLL (equivalent to running regsvr32). Attackers abuse this to install and run malicious DLLs.
falsepositives: Legitimate DLLs being registered via "odbcconf" will generate false positives. Investigate the path of the DLL and its content to determine if the action is authorized.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\odbcconf.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='odbcconf.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%REGSVR %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious DLL Registered Via Odbcconf.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with the "REGSVR" action where the DLL in question doesn't contain a ".dll" extension. Which is often used as a method to evade defenses.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\odbcconf.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='odbcconf.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%REGSVR %' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Response File Execution Via Odbcconf.EXE
rules.author: Kirill Kiryanov, Beyu Denis, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with the "-f" flag in order to load a response file which might contain a malicious action.
falsepositives: The rule is looking for any usage of response file, which might generate false positive when this function is used legitimately. Investigate the contents of the ".rsp" file to determine if it is malicious and apply additional filters if necessary.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\odbcconf.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='odbcconf.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -f %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /f %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –f %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —f %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―f %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%.rsp%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Response File Execution Via Odbcconf.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with the "-f" flag in order to load a response file with a non-".rsp" extension.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\odbcconf.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='odbcconf.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -f %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /f %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –f %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —f %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―f %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%.rsp%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\runonce.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\odbcconf.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.exe /E /F "C:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\odbcconf.tmp"%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Potential Arbitrary File Download Using Office Application
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Beyu Denis, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects potential arbitrary file download using a Microsoft Office application
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\EXCEL.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\POWERPNT.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\WINWORD.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='Excel.exe' OR OriginalFileName='POWERPNT.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='WinWord.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Excel.EXE DCOM Lateral Movement Via ActivateMicrosoftApp
rules.author: Aaron Stratton
rules.description: Detects suspicious child processes of Excel which could be an indicator of lateral movement leveraging the "ActivateMicrosoftApp" Excel DCOM object.
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\excel.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ((OriginalFileName='foxprow.exe' OR OriginalFileName='schdplus.exe' OR OriginalFileName='winproj.exe') OR (Image LIKE '%\\foxprow.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\schdplus.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\winproj.exe' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Office Document Executed From Trusted Location
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of an Office application that points to a document that is located in a trusted location. Attackers often used this to avoid macro security and execute their malicious code.
rules.sql: ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\dopus.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((Image LIKE '%\\EXCEL.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\POWERPNT.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\WINWORD.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='Excel.exe' OR OriginalFileName='POWERPNT.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='WinWord.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\Templates%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\Word\\Startup\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Microsoft Office\\root\\Templates\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Microsoft Office\\Templates\\%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%.dotx' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.xltx' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.potx' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: OneNote.EXE Execution of Malicious Embedded Scripts
rules.author: @kostastsale
rules.description:
Detects the execution of malicious OneNote documents that contain embedded scripts.
When a user clicks on a OneNote attachment and then on the malicious link inside the ".one" file, it exports and executes the malicious embedded script from specific directories.
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\onenote.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\exported\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\onenoteofflinecache\_files\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Microsoft OneNote Child Process
rules.author: Tim Rauch (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Elastic (idea)
rules.description: Detects suspicious child processes of the Microsoft OneNote application. This may indicate an attempt to execute malicious embedded objects from a .one file.

rules.title: Outlook EnableUnsafeClientMailRules Setting Enabled
rules.author: Markus Neis, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects an attacker trying to enable the outlook security setting "EnableUnsafeClientMailRules" which allows outlook to run applications or execute macros
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%\\Outlook\\Security\\EnableUnsafeClientMailRules%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Execution From Outlook Temporary Folder
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a suspicious program execution in Outlook temp folder
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\Temporary Internet Files\\Content.Outlook\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Outlook Child Process
rules.author: Michael Haag, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Markus Neis, Elastic, FPT.EagleEye Team
rules.description: Detects a suspicious process spawning from an Outlook process.
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\OUTLOOK.EXE' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%\\AppVLP.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\forfiles.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\hh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mftrace.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\msbuild.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\msdt.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\scrcons.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\scriptrunner.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\sh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Remote Child Process From Outlook
rules.author: Markus Neis, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a suspicious child process spawning from Outlook where the image is located in a remote location (SMB/WebDav shares).
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\outlook.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '\\\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Binary In User Directory Spawned From Office Application
rules.author: Jason Lynch
rules.description: Detects an executable in the users directory started from one of the Microsoft Office suite applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Publisher, Visio)
rules.sql: ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\WINWORD.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\EXCEL.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\POWERPNT.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\MSPUB.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\VISIO.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\MSACCESS.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\EQNEDT32.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE 'C:\\users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\Teams.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))
