rules.title: Potential Arbitrary DLL Load Using Winword
rules.author: Victor Sergeev, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading using the Microsoft Office winword process via the '/l' flag.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\WINWORD.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='WinWord.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/l %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Mpclient.DLL Sideloading Via OfflineScannerShell.EXE Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Detects execution of Windows Defender "OfflineScannerShell.exe" from its non standard directory.
The "OfflineScannerShell.exe" binary is vulnerable to DLL side loading and will load any DLL named "mpclient.dll" from the current working directory.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\OfflineScannerShell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='OfflineScannerShell.exe') AND (NOT COALESCE((CurrentDirectory LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Windows Defender\\Offline\\' ESCAPE '\' OR CurrentDirectory='' OR CurrentDirectory IS NULL), 0))

rules.title: PDQ Deploy Remote Adminstartion Tool Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detect use of PDQ Deploy remote admin tool
rules.sql: Description='PDQ Deploy Console' OR Product='PDQ Deploy' OR Company='PDQ.com' OR OriginalFileName='PDQDeployConsole.exe'

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Execution Of PDQDeployRunner
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious execution of "PDQDeployRunner" which is part of the PDQDeploy service stack that is responsible for executing commands and packages on a remote machines
falsepositives: Legitimate use of the PDQDeploy tool to execute these commands
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\PDQDeployRunner-%' ESCAPE '\' AND ((Image LIKE '%\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\csc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\dllhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\scriptrunner.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wsl.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\TEMP\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -decode %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -encodedcommand %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -w hidden%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DownloadString%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%iex %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Perl Inline Command Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of perl using the "-e"/"-E" flags. This is could be used as a way to launch a reverse shell or execute live perl code.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\perl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='perl.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '% -e%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Php Inline Command Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of php using the "-r" flag. This is could be used as a way to launch a reverse shell or execute live php code.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\php.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='php.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '% -r%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Ping Hex IP
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a ping command that uses a hex encoded IP address
falsepositives: Unlikely, because no sane admin pings IP addresses in a hexadecimal form
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\ping.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine REGEXP '0x[a-fA-F0-9]{8}'

rules.title: PktMon.EXE Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects execution of PktMon, a tool that captures network packets.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\pktmon.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='PktMon.exe'

rules.title: Suspicious Plink Port Forwarding
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious Plink tunnel port forwarding to a local port
falsepositives: Administrative activity using a remote port forwarding to a local port
rules.sql: Description='Command-line SSH, Telnet, and Rlogin client' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -R %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential RDP Tunneling Via Plink
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Execution of plink to perform data exfiltration and tunneling
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\plink.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%:127.0.0.1:3389%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((Image LIKE '%\\plink.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%:3389%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -P 443%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -P 22%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Suspicious Powercfg Execution To Change Lock Screen Timeout
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects suspicious execution of 'Powercfg.exe' to change lock screen timeout
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\powercfg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='PowerCfg.exe') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%/setacvalueindex %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%SCHEME\_CURRENT%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%SUB\_VIDEO%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%VIDEOCONLOCK%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%-change %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-standby-timeout-%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: AADInternals PowerShell Cmdlets Execution - ProccessCreation
rules.author: Austin Songer (@austinsonger), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects ADDInternals Cmdlet execution. A tool for administering Azure AD and Office 365. Which can be abused by threat actors to attack Azure AD or Office 365.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of the library for administrative activity
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.Exe' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Add-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ConvertTo-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Disable-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Enable-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Export-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Find-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Get-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Grant-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Initialize-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Install-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Join-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%New-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Open-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Read-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Register-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Remove-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Reset-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Resolve-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Restore-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Save-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Search-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Send-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Set-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Start-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Unprotect-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Update-AADInt%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Active Directory Enumeration Using AD Module - ProcCreation
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects usage of the "Import-Module" cmdlet to load the "Microsoft.ActiveDirectory.Management.dl" DLL. Which is often used by attackers to perform AD enumeration.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of the library for administrative activity
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Import-Module %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ipmo %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%Microsoft.ActiveDirectory.Management.dll%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Add Windows Capability Via PowerShell Cmdlet
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the "Add-WindowsCapability" cmdlet to add Windows capabilities. Notable capabilities could be "OpenSSH" and others.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of the capabilities by administrators or users. Add additional filters accordingly.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND CommandLine LIKE '%Add-WindowsCapability%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%OpenSSH.%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential AMSI Bypass Via .NET Reflection
rules.author: Markus Neis, @Kostastsale
rules.description: Detects Request to "amsiInitFailed" that can be used to disable AMSI Scanning
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%System.Management.Automation.AmsiUtils%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%amsiInitFailed%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%[Ref].Assembly.GetType%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%SetValue($null,$true)%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%NonPublic,Static%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential AMSI Bypass Using NULL Bits
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of special strings/null bits in order to potentially bypass AMSI functionalities
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%if(0){{{0}}}'' -f $(0 -as [char]) +%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%#<NULL>%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Audio Capture via PowerShell
rules.author: E.M. Anhaus (originally from Atomic Blue Detections, Endgame), oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects audio capture via PowerShell Cmdlet.
falsepositives: Legitimate audio capture by legitimate user.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%WindowsAudioDevice-Powershell-Cmdlet%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Toggle-AudioDevice%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Get-AudioDevice %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Set-AudioDevice %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Write-AudioDevice %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Encoded PowerShell Command Line
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Markus Neis, Jonhnathan Ribeiro, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, Anton Kutepov, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects suspicious powershell process starts with base64 encoded commands (e.g. Emotet)
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% -e%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% JAB%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% SUVYI%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% SQBFAFgA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% aQBlAHgA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% aWV4I%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% IAA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% IAB%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% UwB%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% cwB%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.exe -ENCOD %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% BA^J e-%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% -ExecutionPolicy remotesigned %' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious PowerShell Encoded Command Patterns
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects PowerShell command line patterns in combincation with encoded commands that often appear in malware infection chains
falsepositives: Other tools that work with encoded scripts in the command line instead of script files
rules.sql: (((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.Exe' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -en %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enco%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% JAB%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% SUVYI%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% SQBFAFgA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% aWV4I%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% IAB%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% PAA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% aQBlAHgA%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%C:\\Packages\\Plugins\\Microsoft.GuestConfiguration.ConfigurationforWindows\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\gc\_worker.exe%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Obfuscated PowerShell Code
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious UTF16 and base64 encoded and often obfuscated PowerShell code often used in command lines
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%IAAtAGIAeABvAHIAIAAwAHgA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AALQBiAHgAbwByACAAMAB4A%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%gAC0AYgB4AG8AcgAgADAAeA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AC4ASQBuAHYAbwBrAGUAKAApACAAfAAg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AuAEkAbgB2AG8AawBlACgAKQAgAHwAI%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ALgBJAG4AdgBvAGsAZQAoACkAIAB8AC%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AHsAMQB9AHsAMAB9ACIAIAAtAGYAI%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%B7ADEAfQB7ADAAfQAiACAALQBmAC%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AewAxAH0AewAwAH0AIgAgAC0AZgAg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AHsAMAB9AHsAMwB9ACIAIAAtAGYAI%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%B7ADAAfQB7ADMAfQAiACAALQBmAC%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AewAwAH0AewAzAH0AIgAgAC0AZgAg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AHsAMgB9AHsAMAB9ACIAIAAtAGYAI%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%B7ADIAfQB7ADAAfQAiACAALQBmAC%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AewAyAH0AewAwAH0AIgAgAC0AZgAg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AHsAMQB9AHsAMAB9ACcAIAAtAGYAI%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%B7ADEAfQB7ADAAfQAnACAALQBmAC%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AewAxAH0AewAwAH0AJwAgAC0AZgAg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AHsAMAB9AHsAMwB9ACcAIAAtAGYAI%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%B7ADAAfQB7ADMAfQAnACAALQBmAC%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AewAwAH0AewAzAH0AJwAgAC0AZgAg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AHsAMgB9AHsAMAB9ACcAIAAtAGYAI%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%B7ADIAfQB7ADAAfQAnACAALQBmAC%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AewAyAH0AewAwAH0AJwAgAC0AZgAg%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PowerShell Base64 Encoded FromBase64String Cmdlet

rules.title: Potential Process Execution Proxy Via CL_Invocation.ps1
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), oscd.community, Natalia Shornikova
rules.description: Detects calls to "SyncInvoke" that is part of the "CL_Invocation.ps1" script to proxy execution using "System.Diagnostics.Process"
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%SyncInvoke %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Assembly Loading Via CL_LoadAssembly.ps1
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects calls to "LoadAssemblyFromPath" or "LoadAssemblyFromNS" that are part of the "CL_LoadAssembly.ps1" script. This can be abused to load different assemblies and bypass App locker controls.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%LoadAssemblyFromPath %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%LoadAssemblyFromNS %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Script Proxy Execution Via CL_Mutexverifiers.ps1
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), oscd.community, Natalia Shornikova, frack113
rules.description: Detects the use of the Microsoft signed script "CL_mutexverifiers" to proxy the execution of additional PowerShell script commands
rules.sql: ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -nologo -windowstyle minimized -file %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: ConvertTo-SecureString Cmdlet Usage Via CommandLine
rules.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov (idea), Vasiliy Burov (rule), oscd.community, Tim Shelton
rules.description: Detects usage of the "ConvertTo-SecureString" cmdlet via the commandline. Which is fairly uncommon and could indicate potential suspicious activity
falsepositives: Legitimate use to pass password to different powershell commands
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND CommandLine LIKE '%ConvertTo-SecureString%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential PowerShell Obfuscation Via Reversed Commands
rules.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov (idea), Vasiliy Burov (rule), oscd.community, Tim Shelton
rules.description: Detects the presence of reversed PowerShell commands in the CommandLine. This is often used as a method of obfuscation by attackers
rules.sql: (((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%hctac%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%kaerb%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dnammoc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ekovn%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%eliFd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rahc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%etirw%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%golon%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%tninon%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%eddih%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%tpircS%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ssecorp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%llehsrewop%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%esnopser%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%daolnwod%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%tneilCbeW%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%tneilc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ptth%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%elifotevas%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%46esab%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%htaPpmeTteG%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%tcejbO%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%maerts%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%hcaerof%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%retupmoc%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% -EncodedCommand %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enc %' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Potential PowerShell Command Line Obfuscation
rules.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov (idea), Vasiliy Burov (rule), oscd.community, Tim Shelton (fp)
rules.description: Detects the PowerShell command lines with special characters
rules.sql: (((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine REGEXP '\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+' OR CommandLine REGEXP '\{.*\{.*\{.*\{.*\{.*\{.*\{.*\{.*\{.*\{' OR CommandLine REGEXP '\^.*\^.*\^.*\^.*\^' OR CommandLine REGEXP '`.*`.*`.*`.*`')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Amazon\\SSM\\ssm-document-worker.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%new EventSource("Microsoft.Windows.Sense.Client.Management"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%public static extern bool InstallELAMCertificateInfo(SafeFileHandle handle);%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the Get-ADComputer cmdlet to collect computer information and output it to a file
falsepositives: Legitimate admin scripts may use the same technique, it's better to exclude specific computers or users who execute these commands or scripts often
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%Get-ADComputer %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -Filter *%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% > %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% | Select %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Out-File%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Set-Content%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Add-Content%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Gzip Archive Decode Via PowerShell
rules.author: Hieu Tran
rules.description: Detects attempts of decoding encoded Gzip archives via PowerShell.
falsepositives: Legitimate administrative scripts may use this functionality. Use "ParentImage" in combination with the script names and allowed users and applications to filter legitimate executions
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%GZipStream%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%::Decompress%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects PowerShell commands that decrypt an ".LNK" "file to drop the next stage of the malware.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Get-ChildItem %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dir %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%gci %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ls %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Get-Content %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%gc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cat %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%type %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ReadAllBytes%' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% ^| %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%*.lnk%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-Recurse%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-Skip %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -ExpandProperty %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%*.lnk%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%WriteAllBytes%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% .length %' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Powershell Defender Exclusion
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects requests to exclude files, folders or processes from Antivirus scanning using PowerShell cmdlets
falsepositives: Other Cmdlets that may use the same parameters
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%Add-MpPreference %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Set-MpPreference %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -ExclusionPath %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ExclusionExtension %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ExclusionProcess %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ExclusionIpAddress %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Disable Windows Defender AV Security Monitoring
rules.author: ok @securonix invrep-de, oscd.community, frack113
rules.description: Detects attackers attempting to disable Windows Defender using Powershell
falsepositives: Minimal, for some older versions of dev tools, such as pycharm, developers were known to sometimes disable Windows Defender to improve performance, but this generally is not considered a good security practice.
rules.sql: (((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-DisableBehaviorMonitoring $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-DisableRuntimeMonitoring $true%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((Image LIKE '%\\sc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='sc.exe') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%stop%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%WinDefend%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%delete%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%WinDefend%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%config%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%WinDefend%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%start=disabled%' ESCAPE '\')))

rules.title: Windows Firewall Disabled via PowerShell
rules.author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)
rules.description: Detects attempts to disable the Windows Firewall using PowerShell
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Set-NetFirewallProfile %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -Enabled %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% False%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -All %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Public%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Domain%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Private%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Disabled IE Security Features
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects command lines that indicate unwanted modifications to registry keys that disable important Internet Explorer security features
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '% -name IEHarden %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -value 0 %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -name DEPOff %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -value 1 %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -name DisableFirstRunCustomize %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -value 2 %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential PowerShell Downgrade Attack
rules.author: Harish Segar (rule)
rules.description: Detects PowerShell downgrade attack by comparing the host versions with the actually used engine version 2.0
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -version 2 %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -versio 2 %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -versi 2 %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -vers 2 %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ver 2 %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ve 2 %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -v 2 %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%[Type]::GetTypeFromCLSID(%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%0002DF01-0000-0000-C000-000000000046%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%F6D90F16-9C73-11D3-B32E-00C04F990BB4%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%F5078F35-C551-11D3-89B9-0000F81FE221%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%88d96a0a-f192-11d4-a65f-0040963251e5%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AFBA6B42-5692-48EA-8141-DC517DCF0EF1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AFB40FFD-B609-40A3-9828-F88BBE11E4E3%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%88d96a0b-f192-11d4-a65f-0040963251e5%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%2087c2f4-2cef-4953-a8ab-66779b670495%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%000209FF-0000-0000-C000-000000000046%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%00024500-0000-0000-C000-000000000046%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.author: @Kostastsale, TheDFIRReport

rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http://127.0.0.1%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\%{(IRM $\_)}%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Hieu Tran
rules.description: Detects potential DLL files being downloaded using the PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest or Invoke-RestMethod cmdlets.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-RestMethod %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-WebRequest %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%IRM %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%IWR %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%OutFile%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Email Exifiltration Via Powershell
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems),  Azure-Sentinel (idea)
rules.description: Detects email exfiltration via powershell cmdlets
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Add-PSSnapin%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Get-Recipient%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-ExpandProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%EmailAddresses%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%SmtpAddress%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-hidetableheaders%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Suspicious Windows Feature Enabled - ProcCreation
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects usage of the built-in PowerShell cmdlet "Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature" used as a Deployment Image Servicing and Management tool.
Similar to DISM.exe, this cmdlet is used to enumerate, install, uninstall, configure, and update features and packages in Windows images
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of the features listed in the rule.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-Online%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-FeatureName%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%TelnetServer%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Internet-Explorer-Optional-amd64%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%TFTP%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SMB1Protocol%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Client-ProjFS%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Microsoft-Windows-Subsystem-Linux%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Execution of Powershell with Base64
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Commandline to launch powershell with a base64 payload
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -en %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enco%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ec %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% -Encoding %' ESCAPE '\' OR (ParentImage LIKE '%C:\\Packages\\Plugins\\Microsoft.GuestConfiguration.ConfigurationforWindows\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\gc\_worker.exe%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Powershell Inline Execution From A File
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects inline execution of PowerShell code from a file
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%iex %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-Expression %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-Command %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%icm %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cat %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%get-content %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%type %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '% -raw%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Certificate Exported Via PowerShell
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects calls to cmdlets that are used to export certificates from the local certificate store. Threat actors were seen abusing this to steal private keys from compromised machines.
falsepositives: Legitimate certificate exports by administrators. Additional filters might be required.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%Export-PfxCertificate %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Export-Certificate %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Base64 Encoded PowerShell Command Detected
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the "FromBase64String" function in the commandline which is used to decode a base64 encoded string
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%::FromBase64String(%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious FromBase64String Usage On Gzip Archive - Process Creation
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects attempts of decoding a base64 Gzip archive via PowerShell. This technique is often used as a method to load malicious content into memory afterward.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%MemoryStream%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%H4sI%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PowerShell Get-Clipboard Cmdlet Via CLI
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the 'Get-Clipboard' cmdlet via CLI
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%Get-Clipboard%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Reconnaissance Activity Using Get-LocalGroupMember Cmdlet
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious reconnaissance command line activity on Windows systems using the PowerShell Get-LocalGroupMember Cmdlet
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%Get-LocalGroupMember %' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%domain admins%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% administrator%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% administrateur%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%enterprise admins%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Exchange Trusted Subsystem%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Remote Desktop Users%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Utilisateurs du Bureau à distance%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Usuarios de escritorio remoto%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PowerShell Get-Process LSASS
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a "Get-Process" cmdlet and it's aliases on lsass process, which is in almost all cases a sign of malicious activity
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%Get-Process lsas%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ps lsas%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%gps lsas%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Abuse of Service Permissions to Hide Services Via Set-Service
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the "Set-Service" powershell cmdlet to configure a new SecurityDescriptor that allows a service to be hidden from other utilities such as "sc.exe", "Get-Service"...etc. (Works only in powershell 7)
falsepositives: Rare intended use of hidden services
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Set-Service %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%DCLCWPDTSD%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-SecurityDescriptorSddl %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-sd %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious PowerShell IEX Execution Patterns
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious ways to run Invoke-Execution using IEX alias
rules.sql: (((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% | iex;%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% | iex %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% | iex}%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% | IEX ;%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% | IEX -Error%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% | IEX (new%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%);IEX %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%::FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.GetString([System.Convert]::%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%)|iex;$%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%);iex($%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%);iex $%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% | IEX | %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% | iex\\"%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Root Certificate Installed From Susp Locations
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Adversaries may install a root certificate on a compromised system to avoid warnings when connecting to adversary controlled web servers.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%Import-Certificate%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -FilePath %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Cert:\\LocalMachine\\Root%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\TEMP\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Perflogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Import PowerShell Modules From Suspicious Directories - ProcCreation
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects powershell scripts that import modules from suspicious directories
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%Import-Module "$Env:Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Import-Module ''$Env:Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Import-Module $Env:Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Import-Module "$Env:Appdata\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Import-Module ''$Env:Appdata\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Import-Module $Env:Appdata\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Import-Module C:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ipmo "$Env:Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ipmo ''$Env:Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ipmo $Env:Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ipmo "$Env:Appdata\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ipmo ''$Env:Appdata\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ipmo $Env:Appdata\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ipmo C:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Unsigned AppX Installation Attempt Using Add-AppxPackage
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the "Add-AppxPackage" or it's alias "Add-AppPackage" to install unsigned AppX packages
falsepositives: Installation of unsigned packages for testing purposes
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Add-AppPackage %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Add-AppxPackage %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '% -AllowUnsigned%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious PowerShell Invocations - Specific - ProcessCreation
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious PowerShell invocation command parameters
rules.sql: ((CommandLine LIKE '%-nop%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -w %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%hidden%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%[Convert]::FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -w %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%hidden%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-noni%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-nop%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%iex%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%New-Object%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -w %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%hidden%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-ep%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%bypass%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-Enc%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%reg%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\software\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%bypass%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-noprofile%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-windowstyle%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%hidden%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%new-object%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%system.net.webclient%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.download%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%iex%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%New-Object%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Net.WebClient%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.Download%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%(New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadString(''https://community.chocolatey.org/install.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Write-ChocolateyWarning%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Invoke-WebRequest Execution With DirectIP
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects calls to PowerShell with Invoke-WebRequest cmdlet using direct IP access
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName LIKE 'powershell\_ise.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%curl %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-RestMethod%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-WebRequest%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% irm %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%iwr %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wget %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%://1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://2%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://3%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://4%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://5%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://6%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://7%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://8%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://9%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%New-MailboxExportRequest%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -Mailbox %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -FilePath \\\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: MSExchange Transport Agent Installation
rules.author: Tobias Michalski (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the Installation of a Exchange Transport Agent

rules.title: Potential PowerShell Obfuscation Via WCHAR/CHAR
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious encoded character syntax often used for defense evasion
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%[char]0x%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%(WCHAR)0x%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Execution of Powershell Script in Public Folder
rules.author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: RemoteFXvGPUDisablement Abuse Via AtomicTestHarnesses
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects calls to the AtomicTestHarnesses "Invoke-ATHRemoteFXvGPUDisablementCommand" which is designed to abuse the "RemoteFXvGPUDisablement.exe" binary to run custom PowerShell code via module load-order hijacking.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-ATHRemoteFXvGPUDisablementCommand%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-ATHRemoteFXvGPUDisableme%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Tamper Windows Defender Remove-MpPreference
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects attempts to remove Windows Defender configurations using the 'MpPreference' cmdlet
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%Remove-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-ControlledFolderAccessProtectedFolders %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-AttackSurfaceReductionRules\_Ids %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-AttackSurfaceReductionRules\_Actions %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-CheckForSignaturesBeforeRunningScan %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Powershell ReverseShell Connection
rules.author: FPT.EagleEye, wagga, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the "TcpClient" class. Which can be abused to establish remote connections and reverse-shells. As seen used by the Nishang "Invoke-PowerShellTcpOneLine" reverse shell and other.
falsepositives: In rare administrative cases, this function might be used to check network connectivity
rules.sql: ((OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll') OR (Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '% Net.Sockets.TCPClient%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.GetStream(%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.Write(%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Run PowerShell Script from ADS
rules.author: Sergey Soldatov, Kaspersky Lab, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects PowerShell script execution from Alternate Data Stream (ADS)
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Get-Content%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-Stream%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Run PowerShell Script from Redirected Input Stream
rules.author: Moriarty Meng (idea), Anton Kutepov (rule), oscd.community
rules.description: Detects PowerShell script execution via input stream redirect
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine REGEXP '\s-\s*<'

rules.title: PowerShell SAM Copy
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious PowerShell scripts accessing SAM hives
falsepositives: PowerShell scripts fixing HiveNightmare / SeriousSAM ACLs
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%\\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%System32\\config\\sam%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Copy-Item%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cp $\_.%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cpi $\_.%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%copy $\_.%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.File]::Copy(%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious PowerShell Invocation From Script Engines
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious powershell invocations from interpreters or unusual programs
rules.sql: ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CurrentDirectory LIKE '%\\Health Service State\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Powershell Script Execution From Temp Folder
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems), Tim Shelton
rules.description: Detects a potentially suspicious powershell script executions from temporary folder
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temporary Internet%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%TEMP\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%TMP\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%LocalAppData\%\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%-WindowStyle hidden -Verb runAs%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\system32\\config\\systemprofile\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\Amazon\\EC2-Windows\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '% >%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Out-File%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ConvertTo-Json%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\Msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\Msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Install-Chocolatey.ps1%' ESCAPE '\'))), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Service DACL Modification Via Set-Service Cmdlet
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious DACL modifications via the "Set-Service" cmdlet using the "SecurityDescriptorSddl" flag (Only available with PowerShell 7) that can be used to hide services or make them unstopable
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-SecurityDescriptorSddl %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-sd %' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%Set-Service %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%D;;%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%;;;IU%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%;;;SU%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%;;;BA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%;;;SY%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%;;;WD%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: PowerShell Script Change Permission Via Set-Acl
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects PowerShell execution to set the ACL of a file or a folder
rules.sql: ((OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll') OR (Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Set-Acl %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-AclObject %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-Path %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PowerShell Set-Acl On Windows Folder
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects PowerShell scripts to set the ACL to a file in the Windows folder
rules.sql: ((OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll') OR (Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Set-Acl %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-AclObject %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-Path "C:\\Windows%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-Path ''C:\\Windows%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-Path \%windir\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-Path $env:windir%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%FullControl%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Allow%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Change PowerShell Policies to an Insecure Level
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects changing the PowerShell script execution policy to a potentially insecure level using the "-ExecutionPolicy" flag.
rules.sql: (((OriginalFileName LIKE 'powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll') OR (Image LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-executionpolicy %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ep %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -exec %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Bypass%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Unrestricted%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\PowerShell\\7\\%' ESCAPE '\')), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentImage LIKE '%C:\\Program Files\\Avast Software\\Avast\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Avast Software\\Avast\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\instup.exe%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-ExecutionPolicy ByPass -File "C:\\Program Files\\Avast Software\\Avast%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-ExecutionPolicy ByPass -File "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Avast Software\\Avast\\%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Service StartupType Change Via PowerShell Set-Service
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of the PowerShell "Set-Service" cmdlet to change the startup type of a service to "disabled" or "manual"
falsepositives: False positives may occur with troubleshooting scripts
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%Set-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-StartupType%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Disabled%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Manual%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Deletion of Volume Shadow Copies via WMI with PowerShell
rules.author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)
rules.description: Detects deletion of Windows Volume Shadow Copies with PowerShell code and Get-WMIObject. This technique is used by numerous ransomware families such as Sodinokibi/REvil
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%Get-WmiObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%gwmi%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Get-CimInstance%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%gcim%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%Win32\_ShadowCopy%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.Delete()%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Remove-WmiObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rwmi%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Remove-CimInstance%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rcim%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Exchange PowerShell Snap-Ins Usage
rules.author: FPT.EagleEye, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects adding and using Exchange PowerShell snap-ins to export mailbox data. As seen used by HAFNIUM and APT27
rules.sql: (((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND CommandLine LIKE '%Add-PSSnapin%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Microsoft.Exchange.Powershell.Snapin%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Microsoft.Exchange.Management.PowerShell.SnapIn%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%$exserver=Get-ExchangeServer ([Environment]::MachineName) -ErrorVariable exerr 2> $null%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious PowerShell Download and Execute Pattern
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious PowerShell download patterns that are often used in malicious scripts, stagers or downloaders (make sure that your backend applies the strings case-insensitive)
falsepositives: Software installers that pull packages from remote systems and execute them
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%IEX ((New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%IEX((New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%IEX(New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -command (New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadFile(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -c (New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadFile(%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious PowerShell Parent Process
rules.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov, Harish Segar
rules.description: Detects a suspicious or uncommon parent processes of PowerShell
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%tomcat%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ParentImage LIKE '%\\amigo.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\browser.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\chrome.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\firefox.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\httpd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\iexplore.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\jbosssvc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\microsoftedge.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\microsoftedgecp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\MicrosoftEdgeSH.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\nginx.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\outlook.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\php-cgi.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\safari.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\services.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\sqlagent.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\sqlserver.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\sqlservr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\vivaldi.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\w3wp.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/c powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/c pwsh%' ESCAPE '\') OR Description='Windows PowerShell' OR Product='PowerShell Core 6' OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll'))

rules.title: PowerShell Script Run in AppData
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects a suspicious command line execution that invokes PowerShell with reference to an AppData folder
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%powershell.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\pwsh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%pwsh.exe%' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%/c %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Local\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Roaming\\%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Powershell Token Obfuscation - Process Creation
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects TOKEN OBFUSCATION technique from Invoke-Obfuscation
rules.sql: (CommandLine REGEXP '\w+`(?:\w+|-|.)`[\w+|\s]' OR CommandLine REGEXP '"(?:\{\d\})+"\s*-f' OR CommandLine REGEXP '(?i)\$\{`?e`?n`?v`?:`?p`?a`?t`?h`?\}') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%${env:path}%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: User Discovery And Export Via Get-ADUser Cmdlet
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the Get-ADUser cmdlet to collect user information and output it to a file
falsepositives: Legitimate admin scripts may use the same technique, it's better to exclude specific computers or users who execute these commands or scripts often
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%Get-ADUser %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -Filter *%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% > %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% | Select %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Out-File%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Set-Content%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Add-Content%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Suspicious X509Enrollment - Process Creation
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detect use of X509Enrollment
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%X509Enrollment.CBinaryConverter%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%884e2002-217d-11da-b2a4-000e7bbb2b09%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious XOR Encoded PowerShell Command
rules.author: Sami Ruohonen, Harish Segar, Tim Shelton, Teymur Kheirkhabarov, Vasiliy Burov, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali
rules.description: Detects presence of a potentially xor encoded powershell command
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll') OR Description='Windows PowerShell' OR Product='PowerShell Core 6') AND CommandLine LIKE '%bxor%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ForEach%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%for(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%for %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-join %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-join''%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-join"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-join`%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::Join%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%[char]%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Folder Compress To Potentially Suspicious Output Via Compress-Archive Cmdlet
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113
rules.description:
Detects PowerShell scripts that make use of the "Compress-Archive" Cmdlet in order to compress folders and files where the output is stored in a potentially suspicious location that is used often by malware for exfiltration.
An adversary might compress data (e.g., sensitive documents) that is collected prior to exfiltration in order to make it portable and minimize the amount of data sent over the network.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%Compress-Archive -Path%-DestinationPath $env:TEMP%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Compress-Archive -Path%-DestinationPath%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Compress-Archive -Path%-DestinationPath%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Arbitrary File Download Via PresentationHost.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of "PresentationHost" which is a utility that runs ".xbap" (Browser Applications) files to download arbitrary files
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\presentationhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='PresentationHost.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: XBAP Execution From Uncommon Locations Via PresentationHost.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of ".xbap" (Browser Applications) files via PresentationHost.EXE from an uncommon location. These files can be abused to run malicious ".xbap" files any bypass AWL
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\presentationhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='PresentationHost.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%.xbap%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% C:\\Windows\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% C:\\Program Files%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Sensitive File Dump Via Print.EXE
rules.author: Ayush Anand (Securityinbits)
rules.description: Detects the abuse of the Print.exe utility for credential harvesting which involves using Print.Exe to copy sensitive files such as ntds.dit, SAM, SECURITY, or SYSTEM from the Windows directory in order to extract credentials, locally or remotely.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\print.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Print.EXE') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%-D%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/D%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–D%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—D%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―D%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\SAM%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\SECURITY%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\SYSTEM%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\windows\\ntds\\ntds.dit%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Abusing Print Executable
rules.author: Furkan CALISKAN, @caliskanfurkan_, @oscd_initiative
rules.description: Attackers can use print.exe for remote file copy
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\print.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE 'print%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/D%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%print.exe%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: File Download Using ProtocolHandler.exe
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects usage of "ProtocolHandler" to download files. Downloaded files will be located in the cache folder (for example - %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\INetCache\IE)
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\protocolhandler.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='ProtocolHandler.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Provlaunch.EXE Binary Proxy Execution Abuse
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
rules.description: Detects child processes of "provlaunch.exe" which might indicate potential abuse to proxy execution.
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\provlaunch.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE(((Image LIKE '%\\calc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\notepad.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%:\\PerfLogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AppData\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Windows\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Provlaunch.EXE Child Process
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious child processes of "provlaunch.exe" which might indicate potential abuse to proxy execution.
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\provlaunch.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ((Image LIKE '%\\calc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\notepad.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%:\\PerfLogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AppData\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Windows\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Screen Capture Activity Via Psr.EXE
rules.author: Beyu Denis, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects execution of Windows Problem Steps Recorder (psr.exe), a utility used to record the user screen and clicks.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\Psr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/start%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-start%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PUA - 3Proxy Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of 3proxy, a tiny free proxy server
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\3proxy.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Description='3proxy - tiny proxy server' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe -i127.0.0.1 -p%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PUA - Suspicious ActiveDirectory Enumeration Via AdFind.EXE
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects active directory enumeration activity using known AdFind CLI flags
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%lockoutduration%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%lockoutthreshold%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%lockoutobservationwindow%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%maxpwdage%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%minpwdage%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%minpwdlength%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%pwdhistorylength%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%pwdproperties%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%-sc admincountdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-sc exchaddresses%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PUA - AdFind Suspicious Execution
rules.author: Janantha Marasinghe (https://github.com/blueteam0ps), FPT.EagleEye Team, omkar72, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects AdFind execution with common flags seen used during attacks
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%domainlist%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%trustdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dcmodes%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%adinfo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-sc dclist%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%computer\_pwdnotreqd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%objectcategory=%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-subnets -f%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%name="Domain Admins"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-sc u:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%domainncs%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dompol%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% oudmp %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%subnetdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%gpodmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%fspdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%users\_noexpire%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%computers\_active%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%computers\_pwdnotreqd%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PUA - Advanced IP Scanner Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), @ROxPinTeddy
rules.description: Detects the use of Advanced IP Scanner. Seems to be a popular tool for ransomware groups.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\advanced\_ip\_scanner%' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '%advanced\_ip\_scanner%' ESCAPE '\' OR Description LIKE '%Advanced IP Scanner%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/portable%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/lng%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PUA - Advanced Port Scanner Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of Advanced Port Scanner.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\advanced\_port\_scanner%' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '%advanced\_port\_scanner%' ESCAPE '\' OR Description LIKE '%Advanced Port Scanner%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/portable%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/lng%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PUA - AdvancedRun Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of AdvancedRun utility
rules.sql: OriginalFileName='AdvancedRun.exe' OR (CommandLine LIKE '% /EXEFilename %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /Run%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% /WindowState 0%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /RunAs %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /CommandLine %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PUA - AdvancedRun Suspicious Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of AdvancedRun utility in the context of the TrustedInstaller, SYSTEM, Local Service or Network Service accounts
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%/EXEFilename%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/CommandLine%' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% /RunAs 8 %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /RunAs 4 %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /RunAs 10 %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /RunAs 11 %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/RunAs 8' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/RunAs 4' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/RunAs 10' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/RunAs 11' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: PUA - Chisel Tunneling Tool Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the Chisel tunneling tool via the commandline arguments
falsepositives: Some false positives may occur with other tools with similar commandlines
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\chisel.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%exe client %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%exe server %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-socks5%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-reverse%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% r:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:127.0.0.1:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-tls-skip-verify %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:socks%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: PUA - CleanWipe Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of CleanWipe a tool usually used to delete Symantec antivirus.
falsepositives: Legitimate administrative use (Should be investigated either way)
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\SepRemovalToolNative\_x64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (Image LIKE '%\\CATClean.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--uninstall%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\NetInstaller.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-r%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\WFPUnins.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/uninstall%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/enterprise%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: PUA - Crassus Execution
rules.author: pH-T (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects Crassus, a Windows privilege escalation discovery tool, based on PE metadata characteristics.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\Crassus.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Crassus.exe' OR Description LIKE '%Crassus%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PUA - CsExec Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of the lesser known remote execution tool named CsExec a PsExec alternative
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\csexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Description='csexec'

rules.title: PUA - DefenderCheck Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of DefenderCheck, a tool to evaluate the signatures used in Microsoft Defender. It can be used to figure out the strings / byte chains used in Microsoft Defender to detect a tool and thus used for AV evasion.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\DefenderCheck.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Description='DefenderCheck'

rules.title: PUA - DIT Snapshot Viewer
rules.author: Furkan Caliskan (@caliskanfurkan_)
rules.description: Detects the use of Ditsnap tool, an inspection tool for Active Directory database, ntds.dit.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\ditsnap.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ditsnap.exe%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PUA - Fast Reverse Proxy (FRP) Execution
rules.author: frack113, Florian Roth
rules.description: Detects the use of Fast Reverse Proxy. frp is a fast reverse proxy to help you expose a local server behind a NAT or firewall to the Internet.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\frpc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\frps.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\frpc.ini%' ESCAPE '\' OR (Hashes LIKE '%MD5=7D9C233B8C9E3F0EA290D2B84593C842%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA1=06DDC9280E1F1810677935A2477012960905942F%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=57B0936B8D336D8E981C169466A15A5FD21A7D5A2C7DAF62D5E142EE860E387C%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PUA- IOX Tunneling Tool Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of IOX - a tool for port forwarding and intranet proxy purposes
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\iox.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.exe fwd -l %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe fwd -r %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe proxy -l %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe proxy -r %' ESCAPE '\') OR (Hashes LIKE '%MD5=9DB2D314DD3F704A02051EF5EA210993%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA1=039130337E28A6623ECF9A0A3DA7D92C5964D8DD%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=C6CF82919B809967D9D90EA73772A8AA1C1EB3BC59252D977500F64F1A0D6731%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PUA - Mouse Lock Execution
rules.author: Cian Heasley
rules.description: In Kaspersky's 2020 Incident Response Analyst Report they listed legitimate tool "Mouse Lock" as being used for both credential access and collection in security incidents.
falsepositives: Legitimate uses of Mouse Lock software
rules.sql: Product LIKE '%Mouse Lock%' ESCAPE '\' OR Company LIKE '%Misc314%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Mouse Lock\_%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PUA - Netcat Suspicious Execution
rules.author: frack113, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of Netcat. Adversaries may use a non-application layer protocol for communication between host and C2 server or among infected hosts within a network
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\nc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\ncat.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\netcat.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -lvp %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -lvnp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -l -v -p %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -lv -p %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -l --proxy-type http %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -vnl --exec %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -vnl -e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --lua-exec %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --sh-exec %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PUA - SoftPerfect Netscan Execution
rules.author: @d4ns4n_ (Wuerth-Phoenix)
rules.description:
Detects usage of SoftPerfect's "netscan.exe". An application for scanning networks.
It is actively used in-the-wild by threat actors to inspect and understand the network architecture of a victim.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\netscan.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Product='Network Scanner' OR Description='Application for scanning networks'

rules.title: PUA - Ngrok Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects the use of Ngrok, a utility used for port forwarding and tunneling, often used by threat actors to make local protected services publicly available.
Involved domains are bin.equinox.io for download and *.ngrok.io for connections.
falsepositives: Another tool that uses the command line switches of Ngrok
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '% tcp 139%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% tcp 445%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% tcp 3389%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% tcp 5985%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% tcp 5986%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% start %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--all%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--config%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.yml%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%ngrok.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% tcp %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% http %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% authtoken %' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.exe authtoken %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe start --all%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PUA - Nimgrab Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects the usage of nimgrab, a tool bundled with the Nim programming framework and used for downloading files.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of Nim on a developer systems
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\nimgrab.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (Hashes LIKE '%MD5=2DD44C3C29D667F5C0EF5F9D7C7FFB8B%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=F266609E91985F0FE3E31C5E8FAEEEC4FFA5E0322D8B6F15FE69F4C5165B9559%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=C07FDDD21D123EA9B3A08EEF44AAAC45%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PUA - NimScan Execution
rules.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects usage of NimScan, a portscanner utility.
In early 2025, adversaries were observed using this utility to scan for open ports on remote hosts in a compromised environment.
This rule identifies the execution of NimScan based on the process image name and specific hash values associated with different versions of the tool.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\NimScan.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=41BB1C7571B3A724EB83A1D2B96DBB8C%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=B1B6ADACB172795480179EFD18A29549%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=0D1F896DC7642AD8384F9042F30279C2%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PUA - NirCmd Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of NirCmd tool for command execution, which could be the result of legitimate administrative activity
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\NirCmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='NirCmd.exe') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% execmd %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe script %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe shexec %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% runinteractive %' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% exec %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% exec2 %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% show %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% hide %' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.description: Detects the use of NirCmd tool for command execution as SYSTEM user
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '% runassystem %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PUA - Nmap/Zenmap Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects usage of namp/zenmap. Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of services running on remote hosts, including those that may be vulnerable to remote software exploitation
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\nmap.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\zennmap.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='nmap.exe' OR OriginalFileName='zennmap.exe')
