rules.title: PUA - Process Hacker Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects the execution of Process Hacker based on binary metadata information (Image, Hash, Imphash, etc).
Process Hacker is a tool to view and manipulate processes, kernel options and other low level options.
Threat actors abused older vulnerable versions to manipulate system processes.
falsepositives: While sometimes 'Process Hacker is used by legitimate administrators, the execution of Process Hacker must be investigated and allowed on a case by case basis
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\ProcessHacker\_%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\ProcessHacker.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (OriginalFileName='ProcessHacker.exe' OR OriginalFileName='Process Hacker') OR Description='Process Hacker' OR Product='Process Hacker' OR (Hashes LIKE '%MD5=68F9B52895F4D34E74112F3129B3B00D%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%MD5=B365AF317AE730A67C936F21432B9C71%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA1=A0BDFAC3CE1880B32FF9B696458327CE352E3B1D%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA1=C5E2018BF7C0F314FED4FD7FE7E69FA2E648359E%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=D4A0FE56316A2C45B9BA9AC1005363309A3EDC7ACF9E4DF64D326A0FF273E80F%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=BD2C2CF0631D881ED382817AFCCE2B093F4E412FFB170A719E2762F250ABFEA4%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=3695333C60DEDECDCAFF1590409AA462%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=04DE0AD9C37EB7BD52043D2ECAC958DF%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PUA - Radmin Viewer Utility Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects the execution of Radmin which can be abused by an adversary to remotely control Windows machines
rules.sql: Description='Radmin Viewer' OR Product='Radmin Viewer' OR OriginalFileName='Radmin.exe'

rules.title: PUA - Potential PE Metadata Tamper Using Rcedit
rules.author: Micah Babinski
rules.description: Detects the use of rcedit to potentially alter executable PE metadata properties, which could conceal efforts to rename system utilities for defense evasion.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of the tool by administrators or users to update metadata of a binary
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\rcedit-x64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rcedit-x86.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR Description='Edit resources of exe' OR Product='rcedit') AND CommandLine LIKE '%--set-%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%OriginalFileName%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%CompanyName%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%FileDescription%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ProductName%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ProductVersion%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%LegalCopyright%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PUA - Rclone Execution
rules.author: Bhabesh Raj, Sittikorn S, Aaron Greetham (@beardofbinary) - NCC Group
rules.description: Detects execution of RClone utility for exfiltration as used by various ransomwares strains like REvil, Conti, FiveHands, etc
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%--config %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--no-check-certificate %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% copy %' ESCAPE '\') OR ((Image LIKE '%\\rclone.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Description='Rsync for cloud storage') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%pass%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%user%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%copy%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%sync%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%config%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%lsd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%remote%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ls%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mega%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%pcloud%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ftp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ignore-existing%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%auto-confirm%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%transfers%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%multi-thread-streams%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%no-check-certificate %' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: PUA - RunXCmd Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of the RunXCmd tool to execute commands with System or TrustedInstaller accounts
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '% /account=system %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /account=ti %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%/exec=%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PUA - Seatbelt Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of the PUA/Recon tool Seatbelt via PE information of command line parameters
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\Seatbelt.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Seatbelt.exe' OR Description='Seatbelt' OR (CommandLine LIKE '% DpapiMasterKeys%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% InterestingProcesses%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% InterestingFiles%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% CertificateThumbprints%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ChromiumBookmarks%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ChromiumHistory%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ChromiumPresence%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% CloudCredentials%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% CredEnum%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% CredGuard%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% FirefoxHistory%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ProcessCreationEvents%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% -group=misc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -group=remote%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -group=chromium%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -group=slack%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -group=system%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -group=user%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -group=all%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '% -outputfile=%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PUA - System Informer Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of System Informer, a task manager tool to view and manipulate processes, kernel options and other low level operations
falsepositives: System Informer is regularly used legitimately by system administrators or developers. Apply additional filters accordingly
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\SystemInformer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='SystemInformer.exe' OR Description='System Informer' OR Product='System Informer' OR (Hashes LIKE '%MD5=19426363A37C03C3ED6FEDF57B6696EC%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA1=8B12C6DA8FAC0D5E8AB999C31E5EA04AF32D53DC%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=8EE9D84DE50803545937A63C686822388A3338497CDDB660D5D69CF68B68F287%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=B68908ADAEB5D662F87F2528AF318F12%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: PUA - WebBrowserPassView Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects the execution of WebBrowserPassView.exe. A password recovery tool that reveals the passwords stored by the following Web browsers, Internet Explorer (Version 4.0 - 11.0), Mozilla Firefox (All Versions), Google Chrome, Safari, and Opera
rules.sql: Description='Web Browser Password Viewer' OR Image LIKE '%\\WebBrowserPassView.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: PUA - Wsudo Suspicious Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of wsudo (Windows Sudo Utility). Which is a tool that let the user execute programs with different permissions (System, Trusted Installer, Administrator...etc)
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\wsudo.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wsudo.exe' OR Description='Windows sudo utility' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\wsudo-bridge.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%-u System%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-uSystem%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-u TrustedInstaller%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-uTrustedInstaller%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --ti %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Python Inline Command Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of python using the "-c" flag. This is could be used as a way to launch a reverse shell or execute live python code.
falsepositives: Python libraries that use a flag starting with "-c". Filter according to your environment
rules.sql: ((OriginalFileName='python.exe' OR (Image LIKE '%python.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%python3.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%python2.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND CommandLine LIKE '% -c%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Python%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Python%' ESCAPE '\') AND ParentImage LIKE '%\\python.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%-E -s -m ensurepip -U --default-pip%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Python%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Python%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-W ignore::DeprecationWarning%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%[''install'', ''--no-cache-dir'', ''--no-index'', ''--find-links'',%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%''--upgrade'', ''pip''%' ESCAPE '\'))), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentImage LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\Microsoft VS Code\\Code.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft VS Code\\Code.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft VS Code\\Code.exe' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%<pip-setuptools-caller>%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%exec(compile(%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Python Spawning Pretty TTY on Windows
rules.author: Nextron Systems
rules.description: Detects python spawning a pretty tty
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%python.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%python3.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%python2.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%import pty%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.spawn(%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%from pty import spawn%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Usage Of Qemu
rules.author: Muhammad Faisal (@faisalusuf), Hunter Juhan (@threatHNTR)
rules.description:
Detects potentially suspicious execution of the Qemu utility in a Windows environment.
Threat actors have leveraged this utility and this technique for achieving network access as reported by Kaspersky.
rules.sql: ((CommandLine LIKE '%-m 1M%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-m 2M%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-m 3M%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%restrict=off%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-netdev %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%connect=%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-nographic%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% -cdrom %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% type=virt %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -blockdev %' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Query Usage To Exfil Data
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of "query.exe" a system binary to exfil information such as "sessions" and "processes" for later use
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\query.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%session >%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%process >%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Rar Usage with Password and Compression Level
rules.author: @ROxPinTeddy
rules.description: Detects the use of rar.exe, on the command line, to create an archive with password protection or with a specific compression level. This is pretty indicative of malicious actions.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of Winrar command line version
Other command line tools, that use these flags
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '% -hp%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -m%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% a %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Greedy Compression Using Rar.EXE
rules.author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects RAR usage that creates an archive from a suspicious folder, either a system folder or one of the folders often used by attackers for staging purposes
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\rar.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Description='Command line RAR') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.exe a %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% a -m%' ESCAPE '\')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% -hp%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -r %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% _:\\*.%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% _:\\\\*.%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% _:\\$Recycle.bin\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% _:\\PerfLogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% _:\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% _:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% _:\\Windows\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% \%public\%%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Suspicious RASdial Activity
rules.author: juju4
rules.description: Detects suspicious process related to rasdial.exe
falsepositives: False positives depend on scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%rasdial.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Process Memory Dump via RdrLeakDiag.EXE
rules.author: Cedric MAURUGEON, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of the Microsoft Windows Resource Leak Diagnostic tool "rdrleakdiag.exe" to dump process memory
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\rdrleakdiag.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RdrLeakDiag.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-memdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/memdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–memdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—memdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―memdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%fullmemdmp%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -o %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /o %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –o %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —o %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―o %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -p %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /p %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –p %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —p %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―p %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Persistence Attempt Via Run Keys Using Reg.EXE
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious command line reg.exe tool adding key to RUN key in Registry
falsepositives: Legitimate software automatically (mostly, during installation) sets up autorun keys for legitimate reasons.
Legitimate administrator sets up autorun keys for legitimate reasons.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%reg%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% add %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\WOW6432Node\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\Run%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Add SafeBoot Keys Via Reg Utility
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "reg.exe" commands with the "add" or "copy" flags on safe boot registry keys. Often used by attacker to allow the ransomware to work in safe mode as some security products do not
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\SafeBoot%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% copy %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% add %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Reg Add BitLocker
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects suspicious addition to BitLocker related registry keys via the reg.exe utility
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%REG%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ADD%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Microsoft\\FVE%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/v%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/f%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%EnableBDEWithNoTPM%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%UseAdvancedStartup%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%UseTPM%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%UseTPMKey%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%UseTPMKeyPIN%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%RecoveryKeyMessageSource%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%UseTPMPIN%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%RecoveryKeyMessage%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Dropping Of Password Filter DLL
rules.author: Sreeman
rules.description: Detects dropping of dll files in system32 that may be used to retrieve user credentials from LSASS
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%HKLM\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%scecli\\0%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%reg add%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Windows Defender Folder Exclusion Added Via Reg.EXE
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects the usage of "reg.exe" to add Defender folder exclusions. Qbot has been seen using this technique to add exclusions for folders within AppData and ProgramData.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Exclusions\\Paths%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Microsoft Antimalware\\Exclusions\\Paths%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ADD %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/t %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%REG\_DWORD %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/v %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/d %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%0%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: SafeBoot Registry Key Deleted Via Reg.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Tim Shelton
rules.description: Detects execution of "reg.exe" commands with the "delete" flag on safe boot registry keys. Often used by attacker to prevent safeboot execution of security products
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% delete %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\SafeBoot%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Service Registry Key Deleted Via Reg.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "reg.exe" commands with the "delete" flag on services registry key. Often used by attacker to remove AV software services
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '% delete %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\services\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Desktop Background Change Using Reg.EXE
rules.author: Stephen Lincoln @slincoln-aiq (AttackIQ)
rules.description:
Detects the execution of "reg.exe" to alter registry keys that would replace the user's desktop background.
This is a common technique used by malware to change the desktop background to a ransom note or other image.
falsepositives: Administrative scripts that change the desktop background to a company logo or other image.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Control Panel\\Desktop%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%CurrentVersion\\Policies\\ActiveDesktop%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System%' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%/v NoChangingWallpaper%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/d 1%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/v Wallpaper%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/t REG\_SZ%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/v WallpaperStyle%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/d 2%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Direct Autorun Keys Modification
rules.author: Victor Sergeev, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects direct modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry using reg.exe.
falsepositives: Legitimate software automatically (mostly, during installation) sets up autorun keys for legitimate reasons.
Legitimate administrator sets up autorun keys for legitimate reasons.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\software\\WOW6432Node\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\Run%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\software\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon\\Userinit%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\software\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon\\Shell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\software\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Windows%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\system\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\SafeBoot\\AlternateShell%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Security Service Disabled Via Reg.EXE
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), John Lambert (idea), elhoim
rules.description: Detects execution of "reg.exe" to disable security services such as Windows Defender.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%reg%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%d 4%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%v Start%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppIDSvc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\MsMpSvc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\NisSrv%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\SecurityHealthService%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Sense%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\UsoSvc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\WdBoot%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\WdFilter%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\WdNisDrv%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\WdNisSvc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\WinDefend%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\wscsvc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\wuauserv%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Dumping of Sensitive Hives Via Reg.EXE
rules.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov, Endgame, JHasenbusch, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community, frack113
rules.description: Detects the usage of "reg.exe" in order to dump sensitive registry hives. This includes SAM, SYSTEM and SECURITY hives.
falsepositives: Dumping hives for legitimate purpouse i.e. backup or forensic investigation
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% save %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% export %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ˢave %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% eˣport %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%hklm%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%hk˪m%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%hkey\_local\_machine%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%hkey\_˪ocal\_machine%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%hkey\_loca˪\_machine%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%hkey\_˪oca˪\_machine%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\system%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\sam%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\security%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\ˢystem%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\syˢtem%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\ˢyˢtem%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\ˢam%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\ˢecurity%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Windows Recall Feature Enabled Via Reg.EXE
rules.author: Sajid Nawaz Khan
rules.description:
Detects the enabling of the Windows Recall feature via registry manipulation.
Windows Recall can be enabled by deleting the existing "DisableAIDataAnalysis" value, or setting it to 0.
Adversaries may enable Windows Recall as part of post-exploitation discovery and collection activities.
This rule assumes that Recall is already explicitly disabled on the host, and subsequently enabled by the adversary.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Microsoft\\Windows\\WindowsAI%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%DisableAIDataAnalysis%' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%0%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%delete%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Enumeration for Credentials in Registry
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may search the Registry on compromised systems for insecurely stored credentials.
The Windows Registry stores configuration information that can be used by the system or other programs.
Adversaries may query the Registry looking for credentials and passwords that have been stored for use by other programs or services
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% query %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/t %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%REG\_SZ%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/s%' ESCAPE '\')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%/f %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%HKLM%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/f %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%HKCU%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%HKCU\\Software\\SimonTatham\\PuTTY\\Sessions%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Suspicious Registry File Imported Via Reg.EXE
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali
rules.description: Detects the import of '.reg' files from suspicious paths using the 'reg.exe' utility
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '% import %' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%temp\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%tmp\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%appdata\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: RestrictedAdminMode Registry Value Tampering - ProcCreation
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Detects changes to the "DisableRestrictedAdmin" registry value in order to disable or enable RestrictedAdmin mode.
RestrictedAdmin mode prevents the transmission of reusable credentials to the remote system to which you connect using Remote Desktop.
This prevents your credentials from being harvested during the initial connection process if the remote server has been compromise
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%DisableRestrictedAdmin%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Modify Group Policy Settings
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detect malicious GPO modifications can be used to implement many other malicious behaviors.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows\\System%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%GroupPolicyRefreshTimeDC%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%GroupPolicyRefreshTimeOffsetDC%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%GroupPolicyRefreshTime%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%GroupPolicyRefreshTimeOffset%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%EnableSmartScreen%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ShellSmartScreenLevel%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Enable LM Hash Storage - ProcCreation
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects changes to the "NoLMHash" registry value in order to allow Windows to store LM Hashes.
By setting this registry value to "0" (DWORD), Windows will be allowed to store a LAN manager hash of your password in Active Directory and local SAM databases.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%NoLMHash%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% 0%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Configuration And Service Reconnaissance Via Reg.EXE
rules.author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects the usage of "reg.exe" in order to query reconnaissance information from the registry. Adversaries may interact with the Windows registry to gather information about credentials, the system, configuration, and installed software.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%query%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%currentVersion\\windows%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%winlogon\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%currentVersion\\shellServiceObjectDelayLoad%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%currentVersion\\run%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%currentVersion\\policies\\explorer\\run%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%currentcontrolset\\services%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Tampering With RDP Related Registry Keys Via Reg.EXE
rules.author: pH-T (Nextron Systems), @Kostastsale, TheDFIRReport
rules.description: Detects the execution of "reg.exe" for enabling/disabling the RDP service on the host by tampering with the 'CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server' values
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% add %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Terminal Server%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%REG\_DWORD%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /f%' ESCAPE '\')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%Licensing Core%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%EnableConcurrentSessions%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%AllowTSConnections%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%fDenyTSConnections%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%fEnableWinStation%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%fSingleSessionPerUser%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%IdleWinStationPoolCount%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%MaxInstanceCount%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SecurityLayer%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%TSAdvertise%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%TSAppCompat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%TSEnabled%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%TSUserEnabled%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%WinStations\\RDP-Tcp%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%SecurityLayer%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%02%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious ScreenSave Change by Reg.exe
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may establish persistence by executing malicious content triggered by user inactivity.
Screensavers are programs that execute after a configurable time of user inactivity and consist of Portable Executable (PE) files with a .scr file extension
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%HKEY\_CURRENT\_USER\\Control Panel\\Desktop%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%HKCU\\Control Panel\\Desktop%' ESCAPE '\')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%/v ScreenSaveActive%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/t REG\_SZ%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/d 1%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/f%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/v ScreenSaveTimeout%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/t REG\_SZ%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/d %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/f%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/v ScreenSaverIsSecure%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/t REG\_SZ%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/d 0%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/f%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/v SCRNSAVE.EXE%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/t REG\_SZ%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/d %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.scr%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/f%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Changing Existing Service ImagePath Value Via Reg.EXE
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
Adversaries may execute their own malicious payloads by hijacking the Registry entries used by services.
Adversaries may use flaws in the permissions for registry to redirect from the originally specified executable to one that they control, in order to launch their own code at Service start.
Windows stores local service configuration information in the Registry under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%add %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% ImagePath %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -d %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /d %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –d %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —d %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―d %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Detected Windows Software Discovery
rules.author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
rules.description: Adversaries may attempt to enumerate software for a variety of reasons, such as figuring out what security measures are present or if the compromised system has a version of software that is vulnerable.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%query%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\software\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/v%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%svcversion%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Reg Add Suspicious Paths
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects when an adversary uses the reg.exe utility to add or modify new keys or subkeys
falsepositives: Rare legitimate add to registry via cli (to these locations)
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppDataLow\\Software\\Microsoft\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows\\OOBE%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\Currentversion\\Winlogon%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\SecurityProviders\\WDigest%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Disabled Volume Snapshots
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects commands that temporarily turn off Volume Snapshots
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%\\Services\\VSS\\Diag%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/d Disabled%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Windows Defender Registry Key Tampering Via Reg.EXE
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the usage of "reg.exe" to tamper with different Windows Defender registry keys in order to disable some important features related to protection and detection
falsepositives: Rare legitimate use by administrators to test software (should always be investigated)
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender Security Center%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (((CommandLine LIKE '% add %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%d 0%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%DisallowExploitProtectionOverride%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%EnableControlledFolderAccess%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%MpEnablePus%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%PUAProtection%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SpynetReporting%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SubmitSamplesConsent%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%TamperProtection%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% add %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%d 1%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%DisableAccess%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableAntiSpyware%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableAntiSpywareRealtimeProtection%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableAntiVirus%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableAntiVirusSignatures%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableArchiveScanning%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableBehaviorMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableBlockAtFirstSeen%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableCloudProtection%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableConfig%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableEnhancedNotifications%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableIOAVProtection%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableNetworkProtection%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableOnAccessProtection%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisablePrivacyMode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableRealtimeMonitoring%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableRoutinelyTakingAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableScanOnRealtimeEnable%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableScriptScanning%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableSecurityCenter%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Notification\_Suppress%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SignatureDisableUpdateOnStartupWithoutEngine%' ESCAPE '\')))

rules.title: Write Protect For Storage Disabled
rules.author: Sreeman
rules.description:
Detects applications trying to modify the registry in order to disable any write-protect property for storage devices.
This could be a precursor to a ransomware attack and has been an observed technique used by cypherpunk group.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Control%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Write Protection%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%0%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%storage%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Execution Of Regasm/Regsvcs With Uncommon Extension
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects potentially suspicious execution of the Regasm/Regsvcs utilities with an uncommon extension.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\Regsvcs.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Regasm.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='RegSvcs.exe' OR OriginalFileName='RegAsm.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.dat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.gif%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpeg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.png%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.txt%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Execution Of Regasm/Regsvcs From Uncommon Location
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects potentially suspicious execution of the Regasm/Regsvcs utilities from a potentially suspicious location
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\Regsvcs.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Regasm.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='RegSvcs.exe' OR OriginalFileName='RegAsm.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Start Menu\\Programs\\Startup\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\PerfLogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Exports Critical Registry Keys To a File
rules.author: Oddvar Moe, Sander Wiebing, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects the export of a crital Registry key to a file.
falsepositives: Dumping hives for legitimate purpouse i.e. backup or forensic investigation
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\regedit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='REGEDIT.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -E %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /E %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –E %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —E %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―E %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%hklm%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%hkey\_local\_machine%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\system' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\sam' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\security' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Imports Registry Key From a File
rules.author: Oddvar Moe, Sander Wiebing, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects the import of the specified file to the registry with regedit.exe.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\regedit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='REGEDIT.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /i %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /s %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.reg%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((CommandLine LIKE '% -e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -a %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /a %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –a %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —a %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―a %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―c %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine REGEXP ':[^ \\]'), 0))

rules.title: Imports Registry Key From an ADS
rules.author: Oddvar Moe, Sander Wiebing, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects the import of a alternate datastream to the registry with regedit.exe.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\regedit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='REGEDIT.EXE') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% /i %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.reg%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine REGEXP ':[^ \\]')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% -e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -a %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /a %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –a %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —a %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―a %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―c %' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Regedit as Trusted Installer
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a regedit started with TrustedInstaller privileges or by ProcessHacker.exe
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\regedit.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentImage LIKE '%\\TrustedInstaller.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\ProcessHacker.exe' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Registry Modification From ADS Via Regini.EXE
rules.author: Eli Salem, Sander Wiebing, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects the import of an alternate data stream with regini.exe, regini.exe can be used to modify registry keys.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\regini.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='REGINI.EXE') AND CommandLine REGEXP ':[^ \\]'

rules.title: DLL Execution Via Register-cimprovider.exe
rules.author: Ivan Dyachkov, Yulia Fomina, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects using register-cimprovider.exe to execute arbitrary dll file.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\register-cimprovider.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-path%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%dll%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Enumeration for 3rd Party Creds From CLI
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects processes that query known 3rd party registry keys that holds credentials via commandline
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Aerofox\\Foxmail\\V3.1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Aerofox\\FoxmailPreview%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\DownloadManager\\Passwords%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\FTPWare\\COREFTP\\Sites%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\IncrediMail\\Identities%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Martin Prikryl\\WinSCP 2\\Sessions%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Mobatek\\MobaXterm\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\OpenSSH\\Agent\\Keys%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\OpenVPN-GUI\\configs%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\ORL\\WinVNC3\\Password%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Qualcomm\\Eudora\\CommandLine%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\RealVNC\\WinVNC4%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\RimArts\\B2\\Settings%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\SimonTatham\\PuTTY\\Sessions%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\SimonTatham\\PuTTY\\SshHostKeys\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Sota\\FFFTP%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\TightVNC\\Server%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\WOW6432Node\\Radmin\\v3.0\\Server\\Parameters\\Radmin%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%export%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%save%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: IE ZoneMap Setting Downgraded To MyComputer Zone For HTTP Protocols Via CLI
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects changes to Internet Explorer's (IE / Windows Internet properties) ZoneMap configuration of the "HTTP" and "HTTPS" protocols to point to the "My Computer" zone. This allows downloaded files from the Internet to be granted the same level of trust as files stored locally.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Internet Settings\\ZoneMap\\ProtocolDefaults%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% 0%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Debugger Registration Cmdline
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), oscd.community, Jonhnathan Ribeiro
rules.description: Detects the registration of a debugger for a program that is available in the logon screen (sticky key backdoor).
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%sethc.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%utilman.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%osk.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%magnify.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%narrator.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%displayswitch.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%atbroker.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%HelpPane.exe%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Persistence Via Logon Scripts - CommandLine
rules.author: Tom Ueltschi (@c_APT_ure)
rules.description: Detects the addition of a new LogonScript to the registry value "UserInitMprLogonScript" for potential persistence
falsepositives: Legitimate addition of Logon Scripts via the command line by administrators or third party tools
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%UserInitMprLogonScript%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Credential Dumping Attempt Using New NetworkProvider - CLI
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects when an attacker tries to add a new network provider in order to dump clear text credentials, similar to how the NPPSpy tool does it
falsepositives: Other legitimate network providers used and not filtred in this rule
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\NetworkProvider%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Python Function Execution Security Warning Disabled In Excel
rules.author: @Kostastsale
rules.description:
Detects changes to the registry value "PythonFunctionWarnings" that would prevent any warnings or alerts from showing when Python functions are about to be executed.
Threat actors could run malicious code through the new Microsoft Excel feature that allows Python to run within the spreadsheet.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Office\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Excel\\Security%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%PythonFunctionWarnings%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '% 0%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Privilege Escalation via Service Permissions Weakness
rules.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov
rules.description: Detect modification of services configuration (ImagePath, FailureCommand and ServiceDLL) in registry by processes with Medium integrity level
rules.sql: (IntegrityLevel='Medium' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-8192') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ControlSet%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%services%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\ImagePath%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\FailureCommand%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\ServiceDll%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Provisioning Registry Key Abuse For Binary Proxy Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
rules.description: Detects potential abuse of the provisioning registry key for indirect command execution through "Provlaunch.exe".
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Provisioning\\Commands\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential PowerShell Execution Policy Tampering - ProcCreation
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects changes to the PowerShell execution policy registry key in order to bypass signing requirements for script execution from the CommandLine
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%\\ShellIds\\Microsoft.PowerShell\\ExecutionPolicy%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows\\PowerShell\\ExecutionPolicy%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Bypass%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%RemoteSigned%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Unrestricted%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Hiding User Account Via SpecialAccounts Registry Key - CommandLine
rules.author: @Kostastsale, TheDFIRReport
rules.description: Detects changes to the registry key "HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\SpecialAccounts\Userlist" where the value is set to "0" in order to hide user account from being listed on the logon screen.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon\\SpecialAccounts\\UserList%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/v%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/d 0%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Persistence Via TypedPaths - CommandLine
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects modification addition to the 'TypedPaths' key in the user or admin registry via the commandline. Which might indicate persistence attempt
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Explorer\\TypedPaths%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Regsvr32 Commandline Flag Anomaly
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a potential command line flag anomaly related to "regsvr32" in which the "/i" flag is used without the "/n" which should be uncommon.
falsepositives: Administrator typo might cause some false positives
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -i:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –i:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —i:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―i:%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% -n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―n %' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Regsvr32 HTTP IP Pattern
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects regsvr32 execution to download and install DLLs located remotely where the address is an IP address.
falsepositives: FQDNs that start with a number such as "7-Zip"
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='REGSVR32.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /i:http://1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i:http://2%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i:http://3%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i:http://4%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i:http://5%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i:http://6%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i:http://7%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i:http://8%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i:http://9%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i:https://1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i:https://2%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i:https://3%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i:https://4%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i:https://5%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i:https://6%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i:https://7%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i:https://8%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /i:https://9%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i:http://1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i:http://2%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i:http://3%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i:http://4%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i:http://5%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i:http://6%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i:http://7%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i:http://8%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i:http://9%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i:https://1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i:https://2%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i:https://3%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i:https://4%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i:https://5%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i:https://6%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i:https://7%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i:https://8%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i:https://9%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Regsvr32 HTTP/FTP Pattern
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects regsvr32 execution to download/install/register new DLLs that are hosted on Web or FTP servers.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='REGSVR32.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ftp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Regsvr32 Execution From Remote Share
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects REGSVR32.exe to execute DLL hosted on remote shares
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '\\REGSVR32.EXE' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '% \\\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Child Process Of Regsvr32
rules.author: elhoim, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects potentially suspicious child processes of "regsvr32.exe".
falsepositives: Unlikely, but can rarely occur. Apply additional filters accordingly.
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%\\calc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\nltest.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\notepad.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\werfault.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\werfault.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -u -p %' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Regsvr32 Execution From Potential Suspicious Location
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of regsvr32 where the DLL is located in a potentially suspicious location.
falsepositives: Some installers might execute "regsvr32" with DLLs located in %TEMP% or in %PROGRAMDATA%. Apply additional filters if necessary.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='REGSVR32.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Regsvr32 Execution From Highly Suspicious Location
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of regsvr32 where the DLL is located in a highly suspicious locations
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='REGSVR32.EXE') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%:\\PerfLogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Registration\\CRMLog%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\com\\dmp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\FxsTmp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\Microsoft\\Crypto\\RSA\\MachineKeys\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\spool\\drivers\\color\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\spool\\PRINTERS\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\spool\\SERVERS\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\_Migrated\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\\Microsoft\\Windows\\SyncCenter\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\com\\dmp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\FxsTmp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\Tasks\\Microsoft\\Windows\\PLA\\System\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\Tasks\\Microsoft\\Windows\\SyncCenter\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Tracing\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% "C:\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% C:\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ''C:\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%D:\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Program Files (x86)\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Program Files\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% C:\\Windows\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% "C:\\Windows\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ''C:\\Windows\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine='' OR CommandLine IS NULL), 0))

rules.title: Regsvr32 DLL Execution With Suspicious File Extension
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), frack113
rules.description: Detects the execution of REGSVR32.exe with DLL files masquerading as other files
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='REGSVR32.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.bin' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bmp' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.cr2' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dat' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.eps' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.gif' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ico' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpeg' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpg' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.log' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.nef' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.orf' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.png' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.raw' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.rtf' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.sr2' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.temp' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.tif' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.tiff' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.tmp' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.txt' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Scripting/CommandLine Process Spawned Regsvr32
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects various command line and scripting engines/processes such as "PowerShell", "Wscript", "Cmd", etc. spawning a "regsvr32" instance.
falsepositives: Legitimate ".bat", ".hta", ".ps1" or ".vbs" scripts leverage legitimately often. Apply additional filter and exclusions as necessary
rules.sql: ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /s C:\\Windows\\System32\\RpcProxy\\RpcProxy.dll' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Regsvr32 DLL Execution With Uncommon Extension
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a "regsvr32" execution where the DLL doesn't contain a common file extension.
falsepositives: Other legitimate extensions currently not in the list either from third party or specific Windows components.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='REGSVR32.EXE') AND (NOT COALESCE(((CommandLine LIKE '%.ax%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.cpl%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ocx%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine IS NULL OR CommandLine=''), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%.ppl%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bav%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Remote Access Tool - AnyDesk Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
An adversary may use legitimate desktop support and remote access software, such as Team Viewer, Go2Assist, LogMein, AmmyyAdmin, etc, to establish an interactive command and control channel to target systems within networks.
These services are commonly used as legitimate technical support software, and may be allowed by application control within a target environment.
Remote access tools like VNC, Ammyy, and Teamviewer are used frequently when compared with other legitimate software commonly used by adversaries. (Citation: Symantec Living off the Land)
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\AnyDesk.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AnyDeskMSI.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR Description='AnyDesk' OR Product='AnyDesk' OR Company='AnyDesk Software GmbH'

rules.title: Remote Access Tool - AnyDesk Piped Password Via CLI
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects piping the password to an anydesk instance via CMD and the '--set-password' flag.
falsepositives: Legitimate piping of the password to anydesk
Some FP could occur with similar tools that uses the same command line '--set-password'
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%/c %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%echo %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.exe --set-password%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Remote Access Tool - AnyDesk Execution With Known Revoked Signing Certificate
rules.author: Sai Prashanth Pulisetti, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects the execution of an AnyDesk binary with a version prior to 8.0.8.
Prior to version 8.0.8, the Anydesk application used a signing certificate that got compromised by threat actors.
Use this rule to detect instances of older versions of Anydesk using the compromised certificate
This is recommended in order to avoid attackers leveraging the certificate and signing their binaries to bypass detections.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\AnyDesk.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Description='AnyDesk' OR Product='AnyDesk' OR Company='AnyDesk Software GmbH') AND (FileVersion LIKE '7.0.%' ESCAPE '\' OR FileVersion LIKE '7.1.%' ESCAPE '\' OR FileVersion LIKE '8.0.1%' ESCAPE '\' OR FileVersion LIKE '8.0.2%' ESCAPE '\' OR FileVersion LIKE '8.0.3%' ESCAPE '\' OR FileVersion LIKE '8.0.4%' ESCAPE '\' OR FileVersion LIKE '8.0.5%' ESCAPE '\' OR FileVersion LIKE '8.0.6%' ESCAPE '\' OR FileVersion LIKE '8.0.7%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% --remove%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --uninstall%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Remote Access Tool - AnyDesk Silent Installation
rules.author: Ján Trenčanský
rules.description: Detects AnyDesk Remote Desktop silent installation. Which can be used by attackers to gain remote access.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%--install%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--start-with-win%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--silent%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Remote Access Tool - Anydesk Execution From Suspicious Folder
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
An adversary may use legitimate desktop support and remote access software, such as Team Viewer, Go2Assist, LogMein, AmmyyAdmin, etc, to establish an interactive command and control channel to target systems within networks.
These services are commonly used as legitimate technical support software, and may be allowed by application control within a target environment.
Remote access tools like VNC, Ammyy, and Teamviewer are used frequently when compared with other legitimate software commonly used by adversaries. (Citation: Symantec Living off the Land)
falsepositives: Legitimate use of AnyDesk from a non-standard folder
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\AnyDesk.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AnyDeskMSI.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR Description='AnyDesk' OR Product='AnyDesk' OR Company='AnyDesk Software GmbH') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\AppData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%Program Files (x86)\\AnyDesk%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%Program Files\\AnyDesk%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Remote Access Tool - MeshAgent Command Execution via MeshCentral
rules.author: @Kostastsale
rules.description:
Detects the use of MeshAgent to execute commands on the target host, particularly when threat actors might abuse it to execute commands directly.
MeshAgent can execute commands on the target host by leveraging win-console to obscure their activities and win-dispatcher to run malicious code through IPC with child processes.
falsepositives: False positives can be found in environments using MeshAgent for remote management, analysis should prioritize the grandparent process, MeshAgent.exe, and scrutinize the resulting child processes triggered by any suspicious interactive commands directed at the target host.
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\meshagent.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Remote Access Tool - NetSupport Execution
rules.author: frack113
rules.description:
An adversary may use legitimate desktop support and remote access software, such as Team Viewer, Go2Assist, LogMein, AmmyyAdmin, etc, to establish an interactive command and control channel to target systems within networks.
These services are commonly used as legitimate technical support software, and may be allowed by application control within a target environment.
Remote access tools like VNC, Ammyy, and Teamviewer are used frequently when compared with other legitimate software commonly used by adversaries. (Citation: Symantec Living off the Land)
rules.sql: Description='NetSupport Client Configurator' OR Product='NetSupport Remote Control' OR Company='NetSupport Ltd' OR OriginalFileName='PCICFGUI.EXE'

rules.title: Remote Access Tool - NetSupport Execution From Unusual Location
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of client32.exe (NetSupport RAT) from an unusual location (outside of 'C:\Program Files')
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\client32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Product LIKE '%NetSupport Remote Control%' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '%client32.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=a9d50692e95b79723f3e76fcf70d023e%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Remote Access Tool - RURAT Execution From Unusual Location
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of Remote Utilities RAT (RURAT) from an unusual location (outside of 'C:\Program Files')
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\rutserv.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rfusclient.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR Product='Remote Utilities') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Remote Utilities%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Remote Utilities%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Remote Access Tool - ScreenConnect Installation Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects ScreenConnect program starts that establish a remote access to a system.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%e=Access&%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%y=Guest&%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%&p=%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%&c=%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%&k=%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Remote Access Tool - ScreenConnect Potential Suspicious Remote Command Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), @Kostastsale
rules.description: Detects potentially suspicious child processes launched via the ScreenConnect client service.
falsepositives: If the script being executed make use of any of the utilities mentioned in the detection then they should filtered out or allowed.
rules.sql: (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\TEMP\\ScreenConnect\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%run.cmd%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Image LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\curl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\dllhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\nltest.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wevtutil.exe' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Remote Access Tool - ScreenConnect Server Web Shell Execution
rules.author: Jason Rathbun (Blackpoint Cyber)
rules.description: Detects potential web shell execution from the ScreenConnect server process.
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\ScreenConnect.Service.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\csc.exe' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Remote Access Tool - Simple Help Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
An adversary may use legitimate desktop support and remote access software, such as Team Viewer, Go2Assist, LogMein, AmmyyAdmin, etc, to establish an interactive command and control channel to target systems within networks.
These services are commonly used as legitimate technical support software, and may be allowed by application control within a target environment.
Remote access tools like VNC, Ammyy, and Teamviewer are used frequently when compared with other legitimate software commonly used by adversaries. (Citation: Symantec Living off the Land)
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\JWrapper-Remote Access\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\JWrapper-Remote Support\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%\\SimpleService.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.author: frack113

An adversary may use legitimate desktop support and remote access software, such as Team Viewer, Go2Assist, LogMein, AmmyyAdmin, etc, to establish an interactive command and control channel to target systems within networks.

rules.title: Renamed AdFind Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of a renamed Adfind.exe. AdFind continues to be seen across majority of breaches. It is used to domain trust discovery to plan out subsequent steps in the attack chain.
rules.sql: ((CommandLine LIKE '%domainlist%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%trustdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dcmodes%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%adinfo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% dclist %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%computer\_pwdnotreqd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%objectcategory=%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-subnets -f%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%name="Domain Admins"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-sc u:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%domainncs%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dompol%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% oudmp %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%subnetdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%gpodmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%fspdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%users\_noexpire%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%computers\_active%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%computers\_pwdnotreqd%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=BCA5675746D13A1F246E2DA3C2217492%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=53E117A96057EAF19C41380D0E87F1C2%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=d144de8117df2beceaba2201ad304764%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=12ce1c0f3f5837ecc18a3782408fa975%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=4fbf3f084fbbb2470b80b2013134df35%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=49b639b4acbecc49d72a01f357aa4930%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=680dad9e300346e05a85023965867201%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=21aa085d54992511b9f115355e468782%' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='AdFind.exe') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\AdFind.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Renamed AutoHotkey.EXE Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali
rules.description: Detects execution of a renamed autohotkey.exe binary based on PE metadata fields
rules.sql: (Product LIKE '%AutoHotkey%' ESCAPE '\' OR Description LIKE '%AutoHotkey%' ESCAPE '\' OR (OriginalFileName='AutoHotkey.exe' OR OriginalFileName='AutoHotkey.rc')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((Image LIKE '%\\AutoHotkey.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AutoHotkey32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AutoHotkey32\_UIA.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AutoHotkey64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AutoHotkey64\_UIA.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AutoHotkeyA32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AutoHotkeyA32\_UIA.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AutoHotkeyU32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AutoHotkeyU32\_UIA.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AutoHotkeyU64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AutoHotkeyU64\_UIA.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR Image LIKE '%\\AutoHotkey%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Renamed AutoIt Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects the execution of a renamed AutoIt2.exe or AutoIt3.exe.
AutoIt is a scripting language and automation tool for Windows systems. While primarily used for legitimate automation tasks, it can be misused in cyber attacks.
Attackers can leverage AutoIt to create and distribute malware, including keyloggers, spyware, and botnets. A renamed AutoIt executable is particularly suspicious.
rules.sql: ((CommandLine LIKE '% /AutoIt3ExecuteScript%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /ErrorStdOut%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=FDC554B3A8683918D731685855683DDF%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=CD30A61B60B3D60CECDB034C8C83C290%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=F8A00C72F2D667D2EDBB234D0C0AE000%' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='AutoIt3.exe' OR OriginalFileName='AutoIt2.exe' OR OriginalFileName='AutoIt.exe')) AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\AutoIt.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AutoIt2.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AutoIt3\_x64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AutoIt3.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.description: Detects the execution of a renamed binary often used by attackers or malware leveraging new Sysmon OriginalFileName datapoint.
falsepositives: Custom applications use renamed binaries adding slight change to binary name. Typically this is easy to spot and add to whitelist

rules.author: Matthew Green - @mgreen27, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), frack113
rules.description: Detects the execution of a renamed binary often used by attackers or malware leveraging new Sysmon OriginalFileName datapoint.

rules.title: Renamed BOINC Client Execution
rules.author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)
rules.description: Detects the execution of a renamed BOINC binary.
rules.sql: OriginalFileName='BOINC.exe' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\BOINC.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Renamed BrowserCore.EXE Execution
rules.author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects process creation with a renamed BrowserCore.exe (used to extract Azure tokens)
rules.sql: OriginalFileName='BrowserCore.exe' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\BrowserCore.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Renamed CreateDump Utility Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects uses of a renamed legitimate createdump.exe LOLOBIN utility to dump process memory
falsepositives: Command lines that use the same flags
rules.sql: (OriginalFileName LIKE 'FX\_VER\_INTERNALNAME\_STR' ESCAPE '\' OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% -u %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -f %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dmp%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% --full %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% --name %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dmp%' ESCAPE '\'))) AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\createdump.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Renamed CURL.EXE Execution
rules.author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of a renamed "CURL.exe" binary based on the PE metadata fields
rules.sql: (OriginalFileName='curl.exe' OR Description='The curl executable') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\curl%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Renamed ZOHO Dctask64 Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects a renamed "dctask64.exe" execution, a signed binary by ZOHO Corporation part of ManageEngine Endpoint Central.
This binary can be abused for DLL injection, arbitrary command and process execution.
rules.sql: (Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=6834B1B94E49701D77CCB3C0895E1AFD%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=1BB6F93B129F398C7C4A76BB97450BBA%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=FAA2AC19875FADE461C8D89DCF2710A3%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=F1039CED4B91572AB7847D26032E6BBF%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\dctask64.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Renamed FTP.EXE Execution
rules.author: Victor Sergeev, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects the execution of a renamed "ftp.exe" binary based on the PE metadata fields
rules.sql: OriginalFileName='ftp.exe' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\ftp.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Renamed Gpg.EXE Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113
rules.description: Detects the execution of a renamed "gpg.exe". Often used by ransomware and loaders to decrypt/encrypt data.
rules.sql: OriginalFileName='gpg.exe' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\gpg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\gpg2.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Renamed Jusched.EXE Execution
rules.author: Markus Neis, Swisscom
rules.description: Detects the execution of a renamed "jusched.exe" as seen used by the cobalt group
rules.sql: (Description='Java Update Scheduler' OR Description='Java(TM) Update Scheduler') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\jusched.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Renamed Mavinject.EXE Execution
rules.author: frack113, Florian Roth
rules.description: Detects the execution of a renamed version of the "Mavinject" process. Which can be abused to perform process injection using the "/INJECTRUNNING" flag
rules.sql: (OriginalFileName='mavinject32.exe' OR OriginalFileName='mavinject64.exe') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\mavinject32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mavinject64.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Renamed MegaSync Execution
rules.author: Sittikorn S
rules.description: Detects the execution of a renamed MegaSync.exe as seen used by ransomware families like Nefilim, Sodinokibi, Pysa, and Conti.
falsepositives: Software that illegally integrates MegaSync in a renamed form
rules.sql: OriginalFileName='megasync.exe' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\megasync.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Renamed Msdt.EXE Execution
rules.author: pH-T (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of a renamed "Msdt.exe" binary
rules.sql: OriginalFileName='msdt.exe' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\msdt.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Renamed Microsoft Teams Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of a renamed Microsoft Teams binary.
rules.sql: (OriginalFileName='msteams.exe' OR OriginalFileName='teams.exe') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\msteams.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\teams.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Renamed NetSupport RAT Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of a renamed "client32.exe" (NetSupport RAT) via Imphash, Product and OriginalFileName strings
rules.sql: (Product LIKE '%NetSupport Remote Control%' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '%client32.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=A9D50692E95B79723F3E76FCF70D023E%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\client32.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Renamed NirCmd.EXE Execution
rules.author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of a renamed "NirCmd.exe" binary based on the PE metadata fields.
rules.sql: OriginalFileName='NirCmd.exe' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\nircmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\nircmdc.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))
