rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\ntvdm.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\csrstub.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Abused Debug Privilege by Arbitrary Parent Processes
rules.author: Semanur Guneysu @semanurtg, oscd.community
rules.description: Detection of unusual child processes by different system processes
rules.sql: (((ParentImage LIKE '%\\winlogon.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\services.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\lsass.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\csrss.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\smss.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\wininit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\spoolsv.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\searchindexer.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (User LIKE '%AUTHORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%AUTORI%' ESCAPE '\')) AND ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe'))) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% route %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% ADD %' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: User Added to Local Administrators Group
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects addition of users to the local administrator group via "Net" or "Add-LocalGroupMember".
rules.sql: ((CommandLine LIKE '%localgroup %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /add%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%Add-LocalGroupMember %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -Group %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '% administrators %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% administrateur%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: User Added To Highly Privileged Group
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects addition of users to highly privileged groups via "Net" or "Add-LocalGroupMember".
falsepositives: Administrative activity that must be investigated
rules.sql: ((CommandLine LIKE '%localgroup %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /add%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%Add-LocalGroupMember %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -Group %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Group Policy Creator Owners%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Schema Admins%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: User Added to Remote Desktop Users Group
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects addition of users to the local Remote Desktop Users group via "Net" or "Add-LocalGroupMember".
rules.sql: ((CommandLine LIKE '%localgroup %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /add%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%Add-LocalGroupMember %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -Group %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Remote Desktop Users%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Utilisateurs du Bureau à distance%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Usuarios de escritorio remoto%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Execute From Alternate Data Streams
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects execution from an Alternate Data Stream (ADS). Adversaries may use NTFS file attributes to hide their malicious data in order to evade detection
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%txt:%' ESCAPE '\' AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%type %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% > %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%makecab %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.cab%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%reg %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% export %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%regedit %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /E %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%esentutl %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /y %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /d %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /o %' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Always Install Elevated Windows Installer
rules.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov (idea), Mangatas Tondang (rule), oscd.community
rules.description: Detects Windows Installer service (msiexec.exe) trying to install MSI packages with SYSTEM privilege
rules.sql: (((Image LIKE '%\\Windows\\Installer\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%msi%' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%tmp' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384'))) AND (User LIKE '%AUTHORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%AUTORI%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\services.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%\\system32\\msiexec.exe /V' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%\\system32\\msiexec.exe /V' ESCAPE '\') OR ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\ProgramData\\Sophos\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\ProgramData\\Avira\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Avast Software\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Avast Software\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Google\\Update\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Google\\Update\\%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Windows App Activity
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects potentially suspicious child process of applications launched from inside the WindowsApps directory. This could be a sign of a rogue ".appx" package installation/execution
falsepositives: Legitimate packages that make use of external binaries such as Windows Terminal
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%C:\\Program Files\\WindowsApps\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ((Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Base64%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentImage LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\WindowsApps\\Microsoft.WindowsTerminal%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentImage LIKE '%\\WindowsTerminal.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\')) OR (ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\WindowsApps\\Microsoft.SysinternalsSuite%' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Arbitrary Shell Command Execution Via Settingcontent-Ms
rules.author: Sreeman
rules.description: The .SettingContent-ms file type was introduced in Windows 10 and allows a user to create "shortcuts" to various Windows 10 setting pages. These files are simply XML and contain paths to various Windows 10 settings binaries.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%.SettingContent-ms%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%immersivecontrolpanel%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Phishing Pattern ISO in Archive
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects cases in which an ISO files is opend within an archiver like 7Zip or Winrar, which is a sign of phishing as threat actors put small ISO files in archives as email attachments to bypass certain filters and protective measures (mark of web)
falsepositives: Legitimate cases in which archives contain ISO or IMG files and the user opens the archive and the image via clicking and not extraction
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\Winrar.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\7zFM.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\peazip.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (Image LIKE '%\\isoburn.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\PowerISO.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\ImgBurn.exe' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Automated Collection Command Prompt
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Once established within a system or network, an adversary may use automated techniques for collecting internal data.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%.doc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.docx%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.xls%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.xlsx%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ppt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.pptx%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.rtf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.pdf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.txt%' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%dir %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /b %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /s %' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='FINDSTR.EXE' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /si %' ESCAPE '\')))

rules.title: Bad Opsec Defaults Sacrificial Processes With Improper Arguments
rules.author: Oleg Kolesnikov @securonix invrep_de, oscd.community, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects attackers using tooling with bad opsec defaults.
E.g. spawning a sacrificial process to inject a capability into the process without taking into account how the process is normally run.
One trivial example of this is using rundll32.exe without arguments as a sacrificial process (default in CS, now highlighted by c2lint), running WerFault without arguments (Kraken - credit am0nsec), and other examples.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\WerFault.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%WerFault.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\regsvcs.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%regsvcs.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\regasm.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%regasm.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentImage LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\EdgeUpdate\\Install\\{%' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\BraveSoftware\\Brave-Browser\\Application\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND ParentImage LIKE '%\\Installer\\setup.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%--uninstall %' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Potential Suspicious Browser Launch From Document Reader Process
rules.author: Joseph Kamau
rules.description: Detects when a browser process or browser tab is launched from an application that handles document files such as Adobe, Microsoft Office, etc. And connects to a web application over http(s), this could indicate a possible phishing attempt.
falsepositives: Unlikely in most cases, further investigation should be done in the commandline of the browser process to determine the context of the URL accessed.
rules.sql: ((ParentImage LIKE '%Acrobat Reader%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%Microsoft Office%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%PDF Reader%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Image LIKE '%\\brave.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\chrome.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\firefox.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\msedge.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\opera.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\maxthon.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\seamonkey.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\vivaldi.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%http://ad.foxitsoftware.com/adlog.php_%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://globe-map.foxitservice.com/go.php_do=redirect%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Child Process Created as System
rules.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov, Roberto Rodriguez (@Cyb3rWard0g), Open Threat Research (OTR)
rules.description: Detection of child processes spawned with SYSTEM privileges by parents with LOCAL SERVICE or NETWORK SERVICE accounts
rules.sql: ((ParentUser LIKE '%AUTHORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentUser LIKE '%AUTORI%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ParentUser LIKE '%\\NETWORK SERVICE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentUser LIKE '%\\LOCAL SERVICE' ESCAPE '\') AND (User LIKE '%AUTHORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%AUTORI%' ESCAPE '\') AND (User LIKE '%\\SYSTEM' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%\\Système' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%\\СИСТЕМА' ESCAPE '\') AND (IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384')) AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%DavSetCookie%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Potential Commandline Obfuscation Using Escape Characters
rules.author: juju4
rules.description: Detects potential commandline obfuscation using known escape characters
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%h^t^t^p%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%h"t"t"p%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential CommandLine Obfuscation Using Unicode Characters From Suspicious Image
rules.author: frack113, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Josh Nickels
rules.description:
Detects potential commandline obfuscation using unicode characters.
Adversaries may attempt to make an executable or file difficult to discover or analyze by encrypting, encoding, or otherwise obfuscating its contents on the system or in transit.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (OriginalFileName='Cmd.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='cscript.exe' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName LIKE 'PowerShell\_ISE.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll' OR OriginalFileName='wscript.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ˣ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%˪%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ˢ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%∕%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%⁄%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%¯%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%®%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%¶%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%⠀%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Command Line Path Traversal Evasion Attempt
rules.author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects potential evasion or obfuscation attempts using bogus path traversal via the commandline
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\Windows\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\..\\Windows\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\..\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\..\\..\\%' ESCAPE '\')) OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe\\..\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%\\Google\\Drive\\googledrivesync.exe\\..\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Citrix\\Virtual Smart Card\\Citrix.Authentication.VirtualSmartcard.Launcher.exe\\..\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Potential Browser Data Stealing
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Adversaries may acquire credentials from web browsers by reading files specific to the target browser.
Web browsers commonly save credentials such as website usernames and passwords so that they do not need to be entered manually in the future.
Web browsers typically store the credentials in an encrypted format within a credential store.
rules.sql: ((CommandLine LIKE '%copy-item%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%copy %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cpi %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% cp %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%move %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%move-item%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% mi %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% mv %' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\esentutl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\xcopy.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\robocopy.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='esentutl.exe' OR OriginalFileName='XCOPY.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='robocopy.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Amigo\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\BraveSoftware\\Brave-Browser\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\CentBrowser\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Chromium\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\CocCoc\\Browser\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Comodo\\Dragon\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Elements Browser\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Epic Privacy Browser\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Google\\Chrome Beta\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE rules.title: Copy From Or To Admin Share Or Sysvol Folder
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), oscd.community, Teymur Kheirkhabarov @HeirhabarovT, Zach Stanford @svch0st, Nasreddine Bencherchali
rules.description: Detects a copy command or a copy utility execution to or from an Admin share or remote
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\%\\%$%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Sysvol\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (((Image LIKE '%\\robocopy.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\xcopy.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='robocopy.exe' OR OriginalFileName='XCOPY.EXE')) OR ((Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%copy%' ESCAPE '\') OR (((Image LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe%' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName LIKE 'powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%copy-item%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%copy %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cpi %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% cp %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%move %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% move-item%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% mi %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% mv %' ESCAPE '\')))

rules.title: Suspicious Copy From or To System Directory
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Markus Neis, Tim Shelton (HAWK.IO), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects a suspicious copy operation that tries to copy a program from system (System32, SysWOW64, WinSxS) directories to another on disk.
Often used to move LOLBINs such as 'certutil' or 'desktopimgdownldr' to a different location with a different name in order to bypass detections based on locations.
falsepositives: Depend on scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment (For example an admin scripts like https://www.itexperience.net/sccm-batch-files-and-32-bits-processes-on-64-bits-os/)
When cmd.exe and xcopy.exe are called directly
When the command contains the keywords but not in the correct order
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%copy %' ESCAPE '\') OR ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%copy-item%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% copy %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cpi %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% cp %' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((Image LIKE '%\\robocopy.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\xcopy.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='robocopy.exe' OR OriginalFileName='XCOPY.EXE'))) AND CommandLine REGEXP '(?i)\s[''"]?C:\\Windows\\(?:System32|SysWOW64|WinSxS)' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/c copy%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\avira\_system\_speedup.exe%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Program Files\\Avira\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Avira\\%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: ETW Logging Tamper In .NET Processes Via CommandLine
rules.author: Roberto Rodriguez (Cyb3rWard0g), OTR (Open Threat Research)
rules.description:
Detects changes to environment variables related to ETW logging via the CommandLine.
This could indicate potential adversaries stopping ETW providers recording loaded .NET assemblies.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%COMPlus\_ETWEnabled%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%COMPlus\_ETWFlags%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: ETW Trace Evasion Activity
rules.author: @neu5ron, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects command line activity that tries to clear or disable any ETW trace log which could be a sign of logging evasion.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%cl%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Trace%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%clear-log%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Trace%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%sl%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/e:false%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%set-log%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/e:false%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%logman%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%update%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%trace%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--p%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-ets%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%Remove-EtwTraceProvider%' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%Set-EtwTraceProvider%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%0x11%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Eventlog Clearing or Configuration Change Activity
rules.author: Ecco, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community, D3F7A5105, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects the clearing or configuration tampering of EventLog using utilities such as "wevtutil", "powershell" and "wmic".
This technique were seen used by threat actors and ransomware strains in order to evade defenses.
falsepositives: Scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment
rules.sql: (((Image LIKE '%\\wevtutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wevtutil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%clear-log %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% cl %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%set-log %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% sl %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%lfn:%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%Clear-EventLog %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Remove-EventLog %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Limit-EventLog %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Clear-WinEvent %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%Eventing.Reader.EventLogSession%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ClearLog%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%Diagnostics.EventLog%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Clear%' ESCAPE '\'))) OR ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%ClearEventLog%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '% sl %' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Execution From Parent Process In Public Folder
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a potentially suspicious execution of a parent process located in the "\Users\Public" folder executing a child process containing references to shell or scripting binaries and commandlines.
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ((Image LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%bitsadmin%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%certutil%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mshta%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%regsvr32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wscript%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Process Execution From A Potentially Suspicious Folder
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Tim Shelton
rules.description: Detects a potentially suspicious execution from an uncommon folder.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%:\\Perflogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Users\\All Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Users\\Default\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Users\\NetworkService\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\addins\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\debug\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Fonts\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Help\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\IME\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Media\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\repair\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\security\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%$Recycle.bin%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\config\\systemprofile\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Intel\\Logs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\RSA\\MachineKeys\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE 'C:\\Users\\Public\\IBM\\ClientSolutions\\Start\_Programs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR (Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\config\\systemprofile\\Citrix\\UpdaterBinaries\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\CitrixReceiverUpdater.exe' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious File Characteristics Due to Missing Fields
rules.author: Markus Neis, Sander Wiebing
rules.description: Detects Executables in the Downloads folder without FileVersion,Description,Product,Company likely created with py2exe
rules.sql: ((Description='?' AND FileVersion='?') OR (Description='?' AND Product='?') OR (Description='?' AND Company='?')) AND Image LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Reconnaissance Activity Via GatherNetworkInfo.VBS
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of the built-in script located in "C:\Windows\System32\gatherNetworkInfo.vbs". Which can be used to gather information about the target machine
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%gatherNetworkInfo.vbs%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Potential Hidden Directory Creation Via NTFS INDEX_ALLOCATION Stream - CLI
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Scoubi (@ScoubiMtl)
rules.description: Detects command line containing reference to the "::$index_allocation" stream, which can be used as a technique to prevent access to folders or files from tooling such as "explorer.exe" or "powershell.exe"
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%::$index\_allocation%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Writing Of Malicious Files To The Fonts Folder
rules.author: Sreeman
rules.description: Monitors for the hiding possible malicious files in the C:\Windows\Fonts\ location. This folder doesn't require admin privillege to be written and executed from.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%echo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%copy%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%type%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%file createnew%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cacls%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bin%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.cmd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.js%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.msh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.reg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.scr%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ps%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vb%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jar%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.pl%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.inf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.cpl%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.hta%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.msi%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Homoglyph Attack Using Lookalike Characters
rules.author: Micah Babinski, @micahbabinski
rules.description:
Detects the presence of unicode characters which are homoglyphs, or identical in appearance, to ASCII letter characters.
This is used as an obfuscation and masquerading techniques. Only "perfect" homoglyphs are included; these are characters that
are indistinguishable from ASCII characters and thus may make excellent candidates for homoglyph attack characters.
falsepositives: Commandlines with legitimate Cyrillic text; will likely require tuning (or not be usable) in countries where these alphabets are in use.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%А%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%В%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Е%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%К%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%М%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Н%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%О%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Р%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%С%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Т%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Х%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ѕ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%І%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ј%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ү%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ӏ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ԍ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ԛ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ԝ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Α%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Β%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ε%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ζ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Η%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ι%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Κ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Μ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ν%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ο%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ρ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Τ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Υ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Χ%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%а%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%е%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%о%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%р%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%с%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%х%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ѕ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%і%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ӏ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ј%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%һ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ԁ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ԛ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ԝ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ο%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Execution Of Non-Existing File
rules.author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects process creation events where the Image field lacks an absolute path,
which occurs when the backing file no longer exists on disk at the time of
logging - commonly caused by Process Ghosting or other unorthodox process creation techniques.
rules.sql: (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((Image IS NULL OR (Image='-' OR Image='') OR ((Image='MemCompression' OR Image='Registry' OR Image='System' OR Image='vmmem' OR Image='vmmemWSL') OR (CommandLine='MemCompression' OR CommandLine='Registry' OR CommandLine='vmmem' OR CommandLine='vmmemWSL'))), 0))

rules.title: Base64 MZ Header In CommandLine
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects encoded base64 MZ header in the commandline
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%TVqQAAMAAAAEAAAA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%TVpQAAIAAAAEAA8A%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%TVqAAAEAAAAEABAA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%TVoAAAAAAAAAAAAA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%TVpTAQEAAAAEAAAA%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential WinAPI Calls Via CommandLine
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the use of WinAPI Functions via the commandline. As seen used by threat actors via the tool winapiexec
falsepositives: Some legitimate action or applications may use these functions. Investigate further to determine the legitimacy of the activity.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%AddSecurityPackage%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AdjustTokenPrivileges%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Advapi32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%CloseHandle%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%CreateProcessWithToken%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%CreatePseudoConsole%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%CreateRemoteThread%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%CreateThread%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%CreateUserThread%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DangerousGetHandle%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DuplicateTokenEx%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%EnumerateSecurityPackages%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%FreeHGlobal%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%FreeLibrary%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%GetDelegateForFunctionPointer%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%GetLogonSessionData%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%GetModuleHandle%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%GetProcAddress%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%GetProcessHandle%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%GetTokenInformation%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ImpersonateLoggedOnUser%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%kernel32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%LoadLibrary%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%memcpy%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%MiniDumpWriteDump%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ntdll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%OpenDesktop%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%OpenProcess%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%OpenProcessToken%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%OpenThreadToken%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%OpenWindowStation%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%PtrToString%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%QueueUserApc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ReadProcessMemory%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%RevertToSelf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%RtlCreateUserThread%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%secur32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SetThreadToken%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%VirtualAlloc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%VirtualFree%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%VirtualProtect%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%WaitForSingleObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%WriteInt32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%WriteProcessMemory%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ZeroFreeGlobalAllocUnicode%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((Image LIKE '%\\MpCmdRun.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%GetLoadLibraryWAddress32%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentImage LIKE '%\\CompatTelRunner.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%FreeHGlobal%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%PtrToString%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%kernel32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%CloseHandle%' ESCAPE '\'))), 0))

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious JWT Token Search Via CLI
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), kagebunsher
rules.description:
Detects potentially suspicious search for JWT tokens via CLI by looking for the string "eyJ0eX" or "eyJhbG".
JWT tokens are often used for access-tokens across various applications and services like Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, and others.
Threat actors may search for these tokens to steal them for lateral movement or privilege escalation.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%find %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%find.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%findstr%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%select-string %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%strings%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%eyJ0eXAiOi%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%eyJhbGciOi%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% eyJ0eX%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% "eyJ0eX"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ''eyJ0eX''%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% eyJhbG%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% "eyJhbG"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ''eyJhbG''%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: LOLBIN Execution From Abnormal Drive
rules.author: Christopher Peacock '@securepeacock', SCYTHE '@scythe_io', Angelo Violetti - SEC Consult '@angelo_violetti', Aaron Herman
rules.description: Detects LOLBINs executing from an abnormal or uncommon drive such as a mounted ISO.
falsepositives: Rare false positives could occur on servers with multiple drives.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\calc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmstp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\installutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='CALC.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='CertUtil.exe' OR OriginalFileName='CMSTP.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='cscript.exe' OR OriginalFileName='installutil.exe' OR OriginalFileName='MSHTA.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='REGSVR32.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='wscript.exe')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CurrentDirectory LIKE '%C:\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CurrentDirectory='' OR CurrentDirectory IS NULL), 0))

rules.title: LSASS Dump Keyword In CommandLine
rules.author: E.M. Anhaus, Tony Lambert, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the presence of the keywords "lsass" and ".dmp" in the commandline, which could indicate a potential attempt to dump or create a dump of the lsass process.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%lsass.dmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%lsass.zip%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%lsass.rar%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Andrew.dmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Coredump.dmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%NotLSASS.zip%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%lsass\_2%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%lsassdump%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%lsassdmp%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%lsass%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dmp%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%SQLDmpr%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.mdmp%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%nanodump%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dmp%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential File Download Via MS-AppInstaller Protocol Handler
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
rules.description:
Detects usage of the "ms-appinstaller" protocol handler via command line to potentially download arbitrary files via AppInstaller.EXE
The downloaded files are temporarly stored in ":\Users\%username%\AppData\Local\Packages\Microsoft.DesktopAppInstaller_8wekyb3d8bbwe\AC\INetCache\<RANDOM-8-CHAR-DIRECTORY>"
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%ms-appinstaller://_source=%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Scan Loop Network
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of other systems by IP address, hostname, or other logical identifier on a network that may be used for Lateral Movement from the current system
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%for %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%foreach %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%nslookup%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ping%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Network Sniffing Activity Using Network Tools
rules.author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects potential network sniffing via use of network tools such as "tshark", "windump".
Network sniffing refers to using the network interface on a system to monitor or capture information sent over a wired or wireless connection.
An adversary may place a network interface into promiscuous mode to passively access data in transit over the network, or use span ports to capture a larger amount of data.
falsepositives: Legitimate administration activity to troubleshoot network issues
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\tshark.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-i%' ESCAPE '\') OR Image LIKE '%\\windump.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Process Launched Without Image Name
rules.author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)
rules.description: Detect the use of processes with no name (".exe"), which can be used to evade Image-based detections.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Execution of Suspicious File Type Extension
rules.author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects whether the image specified in a process creation event doesn't refer to an ".exe" (or other known executable extension) file. This can be caused by process ghosting or other unorthodox methods to start a process.
This rule might require some initial baselining to align with some third party tooling in the user environment.
rules.sql: (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%.bin' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%.cgi' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%.com' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%.scr' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%.tmp' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE(((Image='System' OR Image='Registry' OR Image='MemCompression' OR Image='vmmem') OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Installer\\MSI%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\DriverStore\\FileRepository\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR (Image LIKE '%:\\Config.Msi\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%.rbf' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%.rbs' ESCAPE '\')) OR (ParentImage LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR Image LIKE '%:\\$Extend\\$Deleted\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR (Image='-' OR Image='') OR Image IS NULL), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%:\\ProgramData\\Avira\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR (Image LIKE '%NVIDIA\\NvBackend\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%.dat' ESCAPE '\') OR ((Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\WINPAKPRO\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\WINPAKPRO\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%.ngn' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\MyQ\\Server\\pcltool.dll' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\MyQ\\Server\\pcltool.dll' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Packages\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\LocalState\\rootfs\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR Image LIKE '%\\LZMA\_EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\Mozilla Firefox\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\services.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%com.docker.service' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Non-privileged Usage of Reg or Powershell
rules.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov (idea), Ryan Plas (rule), oscd.community
rules.description: Search for usage of reg or Powershell by non-privileged users to modify service configuration in registry
rules.sql: ((CommandLine LIKE '%reg %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%set-itemproperty%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% sp %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%new-itemproperty%' ESCAPE '\')) AND ((IntegrityLevel='Medium' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-8192') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ControlSet%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Services%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ImagePath%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%FailureCommand%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ServiceDLL%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Suspicious Process Patterns NTDS.DIT Exfil
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious process patterns used in NTDS.DIT exfiltration
rules.sql: (((Image LIKE '%\\NTDSDump.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\NTDSDumpEx.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%ntds.dit%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%system.hiv%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%NTDSgrab.ps1%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%ac i ntds%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%create full%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/c copy %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\windows\\ntds\\ntds.dit%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%activate instance ntds%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%create full%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ntds.dit%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%ntds.dit%' ESCAPE '\' AND ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\apache%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\tomcat%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\AppData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\PerfLogs\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\apache%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\tomcat%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\AppData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\PerfLogs\\%' ESCAPE '\')))

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Call To Win32_NTEventlogFile Class
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the WMI class "Win32_NTEventlogFile" in a potentially suspicious way (delete, backup, change permissions, etc.) from a PowerShell script
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%Win32\_NTEventlogFile%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.BackupEventlog(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ChangeSecurityPermissions(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ChangeSecurityPermissionsEx(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ClearEventLog(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.Delete(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.DeleteEx(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.Rename(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.TakeOwnerShip(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.TakeOwnerShipEx(%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Use Short Name Path in Image
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali
rules.description: Detect use of the Windows 8.3 short name. Which could be used as a method to avoid Image detection
falsepositives: Applications could use this notation occasionally which might generate some false positives. In that case Investigate the parent and child process.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%~1\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~2\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\Dism.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\cleanmgr.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR ((Image LIKE '%\\AppData\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%~1\\unzip.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~1\\7zG.exe' ESCAPE '\'))), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%\\WebEx\\WebexHost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\thor\\thor64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (Product='InstallShield (R)' OR Description='InstallShield (R) Setup Engine' OR Company='InstallShield Software Corporation')), 0))

rules.title: Use NTFS Short Name in Command Line
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detect use of the Windows 8.3 short name. Which could be used as a method to avoid command-line detection
falsepositives: Applications could use this notation occasionally which might generate some false positives. In that case Investigate the parent and child process.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%~1.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~1.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~1.msi%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~1.vbe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~1.vbs%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~1.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~1.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~1.js%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~1.hta%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~2.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~2.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~2.msi%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~2.vbe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~2.vbs%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~2.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~2.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~2.js%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~2.hta%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentImage LIKE '%\\WebEx\\WebexHost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\thor\\thor64.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\xampp\\vcredist\\VCREDI~1.EXE%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Use NTFS Short Name in Image
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detect use of the Windows 8.3 short name. Which could be used as a method to avoid Image based detection
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%~1.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~1.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~1.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~1.hta%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~1.js%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~1.msi%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~1.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~1.tmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~1.vbe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~1.vbs%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~2.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~2.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~2.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~2.hta%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~2.js%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~2.msi%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~2.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~2.tmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~2.vbe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%~2.vbs%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%\\WebEx\\WebexHost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\thor\\thor64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\PROGRA~1\\WinZip\\WZPREL~1.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\VCREDI~1.EXE' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Obfuscated IP Download Activity
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects use of an encoded/obfuscated version of an IP address (hex, octal...) in an URL combined with a download command
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-WebRequest%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%iwr %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-RestMethod%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%irm %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wget %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%curl %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DownloadFile%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DownloadString%' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% 0x%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%//0x%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.0x%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.00x%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%http://\%%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\%2e%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine REGEXP 'https?://[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.0[0-9]{3,4}' OR CommandLine REGEXP 'https?://[0-9]{1,3}\.0[0-9]{3,7}' OR CommandLine REGEXP 'https?://0[0-9]{3,11}' OR CommandLine REGEXP 'https?://(?:0[0-9]{1,11}\.){3}0[0-9]{1,11}' OR CommandLine REGEXP 'https?://0[0-9]{1,11}' OR CommandLine REGEXP ' [0-7]{7,13}')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine REGEXP 'https?://(?:(?:25[0-5]|(?:2[0-4]|1\d|[1-9])?\d)(?:\.|\b)){4}'), 0))

rules.title: Obfuscated IP Via CLI
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of an encoded/obfuscated version of an IP address (hex, octal, etc.) via command line
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\ping.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\arp.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% 0x%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%//0x%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.0x%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.00x%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%http://\%%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\%2e%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine REGEXP 'https?://[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.0[0-9]{3,4}' OR CommandLine REGEXP 'https?://[0-9]{1,3}\.0[0-9]{3,7}' OR CommandLine REGEXP 'https?://0[0-9]{3,11}' OR CommandLine REGEXP 'https?://(?:0[0-9]{1,11}\.){3}0[0-9]{1,11}' OR CommandLine REGEXP 'https?://0[0-9]{1,11}' OR CommandLine REGEXP ' [0-7]{7,13}')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine REGEXP 'https?://(?:(?:25[0-5]|(?:2[0-4]|1\d|[1-9])?\d)(?:\.|\b)){4}'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Process Parents
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious parent processes that should not have any children or should only have a single possible child program
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\minesweeper.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\winver.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\csrss.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\eventvwr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\calc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\notepad.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((Image LIKE '%\\WerFault.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wermgr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mmc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\win32calc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\notepad.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR Image IS NULL), 0)))

rules.title: Potential PowerShell Execution Via DLL
rules.author: Markus Neis, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects potential PowerShell execution from a DLL instead of the usual PowerShell process as seen used in PowerShdll.
This detection assumes that PowerShell commands are passed via the CommandLine.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\InstallUtil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\RegAsm.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\RegSvcs.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='InstallUtil.exe' OR OriginalFileName='RegAsm.exe' OR OriginalFileName='RegSvcs.exe' OR OriginalFileName='REGSVR32.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Default.GetString%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DownloadString%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ICM %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%IEX %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-Command%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-Expression%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Privilege Escalation via Named Pipe Impersonation
rules.author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)
rules.description: Detects a remote file copy attempt to a hidden network share. This may indicate lateral movement or data staging activity.
falsepositives: Other programs that cause these patterns (please report)
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%echo%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%>%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\.\\pipe\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Private Keys Reconnaissance Via CommandLine Tools
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Adversaries may search for private key certificate files on compromised systems for insecurely stored credential
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%.key%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.pgp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.gpg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ppk%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.p12%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.pem%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.pfx%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.cer%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.p7b%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.asc%' ESCAPE '\') AND (((Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%dir %' ESCAPE '\') OR (((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND CommandLine LIKE '%Get-ChildItem %' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\findstr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='FINDSTR.EXE'))

rules.title: Suspicious RunAs-Like Flag Combination
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious command line flags that let the user set a target user and command as e.g. seen in PsExec-like tools
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '% -u system %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --user system %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -u NT%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -u "NT%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -u ''NT%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --system %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -u administrator %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -c cmd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -c "cmd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -c powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -c "powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --command cmd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --command powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -c whoami%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -c wscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -c cscript%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Program Names
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious patterns in program names or folders that are often found in malicious samples or hacktools
falsepositives: Legitimate tools that accidentally match on the searched patterns
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\CVE-202%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\CVE202%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\poc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\artifact.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\artifact64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\artifact\_protected.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\artifact32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\artifact32big.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%obfuscated.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%obfusc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\meterpreter' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%inject.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-CVE%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%pupy.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%payload.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%beacon.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%PowerView.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%bypass.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%obfuscated.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%obfusc.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%obfus.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%obfs.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%evil.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%MiniDogz.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\_enc.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\shell.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\rshell.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%revshell.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\av.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\av\_test.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%adrecon.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mimikatz.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\PowerUp\_%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%powerup.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temp\\a.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temp\\p.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temp\\1.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Hound.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%encode.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%powercat.ps1%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Recon Information for Export with Command Prompt
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Once established within a system or network, an adversary may use automated techniques for collecting internal data.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\tree.com' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\WMIC.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\doskey.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\sc.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='wmic.exe' OR OriginalFileName='DOSKEY.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='sc.exe')) AND (ParentCommandLine LIKE '% > \%TEMP\%\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% > \%TMP\%\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Process Execution From Fake Recycle.Bin Folder
rules.author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects process execution from a fake recycle bin folder, often used to avoid security solution.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%RECYCLERS.BIN\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%RECYCLER.BIN\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Redirection to Local Admin Share
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a suspicious output redirection to the local admins share, this technique is often found in malicious scripts or hacktool stagers
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%>%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\127.0.0.1\\admin$\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\localhost\\admin$\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Registry Modification of MS-settings Protocol Handler
rules.author: frack113, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects registry modifications to the 'ms-settings' protocol handler, which is frequently targeted for UAC bypass or persistence.
Attackers can modify this registry to execute malicious code with elevated privileges by hijacking the command execution path.
rules.sql: (((Image LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\') OR (((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='powershell.exe' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%New-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Set-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ni %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%sp %' ESCAPE '\'))) AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\ms-settings\\shell\\open\\command%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Remote Desktop Tunneling
rules.author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)
rules.description: Detects potential use of an SSH utility to establish RDP over a reverse SSH Tunnel. This can be used by attackers to enable routing of network packets that would otherwise not reach their intended destination.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%:3389%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -L %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -P %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -R %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -pw %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ssh %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Defense Evasion Via Right-to-Left Override
rules.author: Micah Babinski, @micahbabinski, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems), Luc Génaux
rules.description:
Detects the presence of the "u202+E" character, which causes a terminal, browser, or operating system to render text in a right-to-left sequence.
This character is used as an obfuscation and masquerading techniques by adversaries to trick users into opening malicious files.
falsepositives: Commandlines that contains scriptures such as arabic or hebrew might make use of this character
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%\\u202e%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%[U+202E]%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%‮%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Script Interpreter Execution From Suspicious Folder
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects suspicious script execution from suspicious directories or folders accessible by environment variables that may indicate malware activity.
Script interpreters (cscript, wscript, mshta, powershell) executing from folders like Temp, Public, or user profile directories may suggest attempts to evade detection or execute malicious scripts.
falsepositives: Various legitimate software have been observed to use similar techniques for installation or update purposes;thus, it is recommended to review and tune filters for your environment to reduce false positives before deploying to production.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -ep bypass %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ExecutionPolicy bypass %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -w hidden %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/e:javascript %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/e:Jscript %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/e:vbscript %' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='cscript.exe' OR OriginalFileName='mshta.exe' OR OriginalFileName='wscript.exe')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Perflogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\\%Public\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temporary Internet%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Start Menu\\Programs\\Startup\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%TEMP\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%TMP\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%LocalAppData\%\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Favorites\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Favourites\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Contacts\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Documents\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Music\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Pictures\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Videos\\%' ESCAPE '\'))) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\Msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\Msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Install-Chocolatey.ps1%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Sensitive File Access Via Volume Shadow Copy Backup
rules.author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems), Tobias Michalski (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a command that accesses the VolumeShadowCopy in order to extract sensitive files such as the Security or SAM registry hives or the AD database (ntds.dit)
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\?\\GLOBALROOT\\Device\\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\NTDS.dit%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\SYSTEM%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\SECURITY%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious New Service Creation
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects creation of a new service via "sc" command or the powershell "new-service" cmdlet with suspicious binary paths
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\sc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%create%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%binPath=%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%New-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-BinaryPathName%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mshta%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%svchost%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dllhost%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /k%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /r%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Users\\Public%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Start Menu\\Programs\\Startup\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\TEMP\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Service Binary Directory
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Tasks Folder Evasion
rules.author: Sreeman
rules.description:
The Tasks folder in system32 and syswow64 are globally writable paths.
Adversaries can take advantage of this and load or influence any script hosts or ANY .NET Application
in Tasks to load and execute a custom assembly into cscript, wscript, regsvr32, mshta, eventvwr
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%echo %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%copy %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%type %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%file createnew%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% C:\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% C:\\Windows\\SysWow64\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Malicious PE Execution by Microsoft Visual Studio Debugger
rules.author: Agro (@agro_sev), Ensar Şamil (@sblmsrsn), oscd.community
rules.description:
There is an option for a MS VS Just-In-Time Debugger "vsjitdebugger.exe" to launch specified executable and attach a debugger.
This option may be used adversaries to execute malicious code by signed verified binary.
The debugger is installed alongside with Microsoft Visual Studio package.
falsepositives: The process spawned by vsjitdebugger.exe is uncommon.
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\vsjitdebugger.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\vsimmersiveactivatehelper%.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\devenv.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Userinit Child Process
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Samir Bousseaden (idea)
rules.description: Detects a suspicious child process of userinit
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\userinit.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%\\netlogon\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR (Image LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='explorer.exe' OR CommandLine LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\Explorer.EXE' ESCAPE '\') OR Image IS NULL), 0))

rules.title: Weak or Abused Passwords In CLI
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects weak passwords or often abused passwords (seen used by threat actors) via the CLI.
An example would be a threat actor creating a new user via the net command and providing the password inline
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of the passwords by users via commandline (should be discouraged)
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%123456789%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%123123qwE%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Asd123.aaaa%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Decryptme%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%P@ssw0rd!%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Pass8080%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%password123%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%test@202%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.author: James Pemberton / @4A616D6573, Endgame, JHasenbusch, oscd.community, Austin Songer @austinsonger
rules.description: Detects the use of various web request commands with commandline tools and Windows PowerShell cmdlets (including aliases) via CommandLine
falsepositives: Use of Get-Command and Get-Help modules to reference Invoke-WebRequest and Start-BitsTransfer.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%[System.Net.WebRequest]::create%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%curl %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-RestMethod%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-WebRequest%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% irm %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%iwr %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Resume-BitsTransfer%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Start-BitsTransfer%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wget %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%WinHttp.WinHttpRequest%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a suspicious process command line that uses whoami as first parameter (as e.g. used by EfsPotato)
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%.exe whoami%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.author: Maxime Thiebaut (@0xThiebaut)
rules.description: Detects using WorkFolders.exe to execute an arbitrary control.exe
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of the uncommon Windows Work Folders feature.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\control.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentImage LIKE '%\\WorkFolders.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\control.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspect Svchost Activity
rules.author: David Burkett, @signalblur
rules.description: It is extremely abnormal for svchost.exe to spawn without any CLI arguments and is normally observed when a malicious process spawns the process and injects code into the process memory space.
falsepositives: Rpcnet.exe / rpcnetp.exe which is a lojack style software. https://www.blackhat.com/docs/us-14/materials/us-14-Kamlyuk-Kamluk-Computrace-Backdoor-Revisited.pdf
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentImage LIKE '%\\rpcnet.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\rpcnetp.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine IS NULL), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Process Masquerading As SvcHost.EXE
rules.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
rules.description:
Detects a suspicious process that is masquerading as the legitimate "svchost.exe" by naming its binary "svchost.exe" and executing from an uncommon location.
Adversaries often disguise their malicious binaries by naming them after legitimate system processes like "svchost.exe" to evade detection.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE(((Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='svchost.exe'), 0))

rules.description: Detects a process spawned by the terminal service server process (this could be an indicator for an exploitation of CVE-2019-0708)

rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects an uncommon svchost parent process
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentImage LIKE '%\\Mrt.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\MsMpEng.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\ngen.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\rpcnet.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\services.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\TiWorker.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR ParentImage IS NULL OR (ParentImage='-' OR ParentImage='')), 0))

rules.title: Permission Check Via Accesschk.EXE
rules.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov (idea), Mangatas Tondang, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the usage of the "Accesschk" utility, an access and privilege audit tool developed by SysInternal and often being abused by attacker to verify process privileges
rules.sql: (Product LIKE '%AccessChk' ESCAPE '\' OR Description LIKE '%Reports effective permissions%' ESCAPE '\' OR (Image LIKE '%\\accesschk.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\accesschk64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\accesschk64a.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='accesschk.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%uwcqv %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%kwsu %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%qwsu %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%uwdqs %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Active Directory Database Snapshot Via ADExplorer
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of Sysinternals ADExplorer with the "-snapshot" flag in order to save a local copy of the active directory database. This can be used by attackers to extract data for Bloodhound, usernames for password spraying or use the meta data for social engineering. The snapshot doesn't contain password hashes but there have been cases, where administrators put passwords in the comment field.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\ADExp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\ADExplorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\ADExplorer64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\ADExplorer64a.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='AdExp' OR Description='Active Directory Editor' OR Product='Sysinternals ADExplorer') AND CommandLine LIKE '%snapshot%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Active Directory Database Snapshot Via ADExplorer
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of Sysinternals ADExplorer with the "-snapshot" flag in order to save a local copy of the active directory database to a suspicious directory. This can be used by attackers to extract data for Bloodhound, usernames for password spraying or use the meta data for social engineering. The snapshot doesn't contain password hashes but there have been cases, where administrators put passwords in the comment field.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\ADExp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\ADExplorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\ADExplorer64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\ADExplorer64a.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='AdExp' OR Description='Active Directory Editor' OR Product='Sysinternals ADExplorer') AND CommandLine LIKE '%snapshot%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Memory Dumping Activity Via LiveKD
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of LiveKD based on PE metadata or image name
falsepositives: Administration and debugging activity (must be investigated)
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\livekd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\livekd64.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='livekd.exe'

rules.title: Kernel Memory Dump Via LiveKD
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of LiveKD with the "-m" flag to potentially dump the kernel memory
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\livekd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\livekd64.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='livekd.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -m%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /m%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –m%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —m%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―m%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Procdump Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of the SysInternals Procdump utility
falsepositives: Legitimate use of procdump by a developer or administrator
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\procdump.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\procdump64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\procdump64a.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential SysInternals ProcDump Evasion
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects uses of the SysInternals ProcDump utility in which ProcDump or its output get renamed, or a dump file is moved or copied to a different name
falsepositives: False positives are expected in cases in which ProcDump just gets copied to a different directory without any renaming
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%copy procdump%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%move procdump%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%copy %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dmp %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%2.dmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%lsass%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%out.dmp%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%copy lsass.exe\_%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%move lsass.exe\_%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential LSASS Process Dump Via Procdump
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects potential credential harvesting attempts through LSASS memory dumps using ProcDump.
This rule identifies suspicious command-line patterns that combine memory dump flags (-ma, -mm, -mp) with LSASS-related process markers.
LSASS (Local Security Authority Subsystem Service) contains sensitive authentication data including plaintext passwords, NTLM hashes, and Kerberos tickets in memory.
Attackers commonly dump LSASS memory to extract credentials for lateral movement and privilege escalation.
falsepositives: Unlikely, because no one should dump an lsass process memory
Another tool that uses command line flags similar to ProcDump
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '% -ma %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /ma %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –ma %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —ma %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―ma %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -mm %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /mm %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –mm %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —mm %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―mm %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -mp %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /mp %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –mp %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —mp %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―mp %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% ls%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% keyiso%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% samss%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Psexec Execution
rules.author: omkar72
rules.description: Detects user accept agreement execution in psexec commandline
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\psexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='psexec.c'
