rules.title: Potential PsExec Remote Execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects potential psexec command that initiate execution on a remote systems via common commandline flags used by the utility
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%accepteula%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -u %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -p %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% \\\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\localhost%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\127.%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: PsExec Service Execution
rules.author: Thomas Patzke, Romaissa Adjailia, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects launch of the PSEXESVC service, which means that this system was the target of a psexec remote execution
rules.sql: Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\PSEXESVC.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='psexesvc.exe'

rules.title: Suspicious Use of PsLogList

rules.title: Sysinternals PsService Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of Sysinternals PsService which can be abused for service reconnaissance and tampering
falsepositives: Legitimate use of PsService by an administrator
rules.sql: OriginalFileName='psservice.exe' OR (Image LIKE '%\\PsService.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\PsService64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\PsService64a.exe' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Sysinternals PsSuspend Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects usage of Sysinternals PsSuspend which can be abused to suspend critical processes
rules.sql: OriginalFileName='pssuspend.exe' OR (Image LIKE '%\\pssuspend.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pssuspend64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pssuspend64a.exe' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Sysinternals PsSuspend Suspicious Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious execution of Sysinternals PsSuspend, where the utility is used to suspend critical processes such as AV or EDR to bypass defenses
rules.sql: (OriginalFileName='pssuspend.exe' OR (Image LIKE '%\\pssuspend.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pssuspend64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pssuspend64a.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND CommandLine LIKE '%msmpeng.exe%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential File Overwrite Via Sysinternals SDelete
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Detects the use of SDelete to erase a file not the free space
rules.sql: OriginalFileName='sdelete.exe' AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% -h%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -z%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /?%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Sysprep on AppData Folder
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious sysprep process start with AppData folder as target (as used by Trojan Syndicasec in Thrip report by Symantec)
falsepositives: False positives depend on scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\sysprep.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Signing Bypass Via Windows Developer Features
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects when a user enable developer features such as "Developer Mode" or "Application Sideloading". Which allows the user to install untrusted packages.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\SystemSettingsAdminFlows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='SystemSettingsAdminFlows.EXE') AND CommandLine LIKE '%TurnOnDeveloperFeatures%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%DeveloperUnlock%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%EnableSideloading%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Recursive Takeown
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Adversaries can interact with the DACLs using built-in Windows commands takeown which can grant adversaries higher permissions on specific files and folders
falsepositives: Scripts created by developers and admins
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\takeown.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/f %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/r%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Tap Installer Execution
rules.author: Daniil Yugoslavskiy, Ian Davis, oscd.community
rules.description: Well-known TAP software installation. Possible preparation for data exfiltration using tunneling techniques
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\tapinstall.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE(((Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\Avast Software\\SecureLine VPN\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\Avast Software\\SecureLine VPN\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\OpenVPN Connect\\drivers\\tap\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\Proton Technologies\\ProtonVPNTap\\installer\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Taskkill Symantec Endpoint Protection
rules.author: Ilya Krestinichev, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects one of the possible scenarios for disabling Symantec Endpoint Protection.
Symantec Endpoint Protection antivirus software services incorrectly implement the protected service mechanism.
As a result, the NT AUTHORITY/SYSTEM user can execute the taskkill /im command several times ccSvcHst.exe /f, thereby killing the process belonging to the service, and thus shutting down the service.
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%taskkill%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /F %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /IM %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ccSvcHst.exe%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Loaded Module Enumeration Via Tasklist.EXE
rules.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
rules.description:
Detects the enumeration of a specific DLL or EXE being used by a binary via "tasklist.exe".
This is often used by attackers in order to find the specific process identifier (PID) that is using the DLL in question.
In order to dump the process memory or perform other nefarious actions.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\tasklist.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='tasklist.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-m%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/m%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–m%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—m%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―m%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%rdpcorets.dll%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Taskmgr as LOCAL_SYSTEM
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the creation of taskmgr.exe process in context of LOCAL_SYSTEM
rules.sql: (User LIKE '%AUTHORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%AUTORI%' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%\\taskmgr.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Command Targeting Teams Sensitive Files
rules.author: @SerkinValery
rules.description:
Detects a commandline containing references to the Microsoft Teams database or cookies files from a process other than Teams.
The database might contain authentication tokens and other sensitive information about the logged in accounts.
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Teams\\Cookies%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Teams\\Local Storage\\leveldb%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Teams\\current\\Teams.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: New Virtual Smart Card Created Via TpmVscMgr.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "Tpmvscmgr.exe" to create a new virtual smart card.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\tpmvscmgr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND OriginalFileName='TpmVscMgr.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%create%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious TSCON Start as SYSTEM
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a tscon.exe start as LOCAL SYSTEM
rules.sql: (User LIKE '%AUTHORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%AUTORI%' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%\\tscon.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious RDP Redirect Using TSCON
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects a suspicious RDP session redirect using tscon.exe
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '% /dest:rdp-tcp#%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential RDP Session Hijacking Activity
rules.author: @juju4
rules.description: Detects potential RDP Session Hijacking activity on Windows systems
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\tscon.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='tscon.exe') AND (IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384')

rules.title: UAC Bypass Using ChangePK and SLUI
rules.author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects an UAC bypass that uses changepk.exe and slui.exe (UACMe 61)
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\changepk.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentImage LIKE '%\\slui.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (IntegrityLevel='High' OR IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-12288')

rules.title: UAC Bypass Using Disk Cleanup
rules.author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using scheduled tasks and variable expansion of cleanmgr.exe (UACMe 34)
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%"\\system32\\cleanmgr.exe /autoclean /d C:' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\system32\\svchost.exe -k netsvcs -p -s Schedule' ESCAPE '\' AND (IntegrityLevel='High' OR IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-12288')

rules.title: Bypass UAC via CMSTP
rules.author: E.M. Anhaus (originally from Atomic Blue Detections, Endgame), oscd.community
rules.description: Detect commandline usage of Microsoft Connection Manager Profile Installer (cmstp.exe) to install specially formatted local .INF files
falsepositives: Legitimate use of cmstp.exe utility by legitimate user
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\cmstp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CMSTP.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/s%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-s%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/au%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-au%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/ni%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-ni%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: UAC Bypass Tools Using ComputerDefaults
rules.author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects tools such as UACMe used to bypass UAC with computerdefaults.exe (UACMe 59)
rules.sql: ((IntegrityLevel='High' OR IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-12288') AND Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\ComputerDefaults.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%:\\Program Files%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: UAC Bypass Using Consent and Comctl32 - Process
rules.author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using consent.exe and comctl32.dll (UACMe 22)
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\consent.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\werfault.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (IntegrityLevel='High' OR IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-12288')

rules.title: UAC Bypass Using Event Viewer RecentViews
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using Event Viewer RecentViews
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Event Viewer\\RecentViews%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\EventV~1\\RecentViews%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%>%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: UAC Bypass via Windows Firewall Snap-In Hijack
rules.author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)
rules.description: Detects attempts to bypass User Account Control (UAC) by hijacking the Microsoft Management Console (MMC) Windows Firewall snap-in
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\mmc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%WF.msc%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\WerFault.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: UAC Bypass via ICMLuaUtil
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Elastic (idea)
rules.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using ICMLuaUtil Elevated COM interface
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\dllhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%/Processid:{3E5FC7F9-9A51-4367-9063-A120244FBEC7}%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%/Processid:{D2E7041B-2927-42FB-8E9F-7CE93B6DC937}%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\WerFault.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='WerFault.exe'), 0))

rules.title: UAC Bypass Using IEInstal - Process
rules.author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using IEInstal.exe (UACMe 64)
rules.sql: (IntegrityLevel='High' OR IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-12288') AND ParentImage LIKE '%\\ieinstal.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%consent.exe' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: UAC Bypass Using MSConfig Token Modification - Process
rules.author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using a msconfig GUI hack (UACMe 55)
rules.sql: (IntegrityLevel='High' OR IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-12288') AND ParentImage LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\pkgmgr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '"C:\\Windows\\system32\\msconfig.exe" -5' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: UAC Bypass Using NTFS Reparse Point - Process
rules.author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using NTFS reparse point and wusa.exe DLL hijacking (UACMe 36)
rules.sql: (CommandLine LIKE '"C:\\Windows\\system32\\wusa.exe"  /quiet C:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\update.msu' ESCAPE '\' AND (IntegrityLevel='High' OR IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-12288')) OR (ParentCommandLine LIKE '"C:\\Windows\\system32\\dism.exe" /online /quiet /norestart /add-package /packagepath:"C:\\Windows\\system32\\pe386" /ignorecheck' ESCAPE '\' AND (IntegrityLevel='High' OR IntegrityLevel='System') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\dismhost.exe {%' ESCAPE '\') AND Image LIKE '%\\DismHost.exe' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: UAC Bypass Using PkgMgr and DISM
rules.author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using pkgmgr.exe and dism.exe (UACMe 23)
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\pkgmgr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\dism.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (IntegrityLevel='High' OR IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-12288')

rules.title: Potential UAC Bypass Via Sdclt.EXE
rules.author: Roberto Rodriguez (Cyb3rWard0g), OTR (Open Threat Research)
rules.description: A General detection for sdclt being spawned as an elevated process. This could be an indicator of sdclt being used for bypass UAC techniques.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%sdclt.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (IntegrityLevel='High' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-12288')

rules.title: TrustedPath UAC Bypass Pattern
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects indicators of a UAC bypass method by mocking directories
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%C:\\Windows \\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%C:\\Windows \\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: UAC Bypass Using Windows Media Player - Process
rules.author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using Windows Media Player osksupport.dll (UACMe 32)
rules.sql: (Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Windows Media Player\\osk.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '"C:\\Windows\\system32\\mmc.exe" "C:\\Windows\\system32\\eventvwr.msc" /s' ESCAPE '\')) AND (IntegrityLevel='High' OR IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-12288')

rules.title: Bypass UAC via WSReset.exe
rules.author: E.M. Anhaus (originally from Atomic Blue Detections, Tony Lambert), oscd.community, Florian Roth
rules.description: Detects use of WSReset.exe to bypass User Account Control (UAC). Adversaries use this technique to execute privileged processes.
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\wsreset.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CONHOST.EXE'), 0))

rules.title: UAC Bypass WSReset
rules.author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass via WSReset usable by default sysmon-config
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\wsreset.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (IntegrityLevel='High' OR IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-12288')

rules.title: Use of UltraVNC Remote Access Software
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: An adversary may use legitimate desktop support and remote access software,to establish an interactive command and control channel to target systems within networks
rules.sql: Description='VNCViewer' OR Product='UltraVNC VNCViewer' OR Company='UltraVNC' OR OriginalFileName='VNCViewer.exe'

rules.title: Suspicious UltraVNC Execution
rules.author: Bhabesh Raj
rules.description: Detects suspicious UltraVNC command line flag combination that indicate a auto reconnect upon execution, e.g. startup (as seen being used by Gamaredon threat group)
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%-autoreconnect %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-connect %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-id:%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Uninstall Crowdstrike Falcon Sensor
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: Adversaries may disable security tools to avoid possible detection of their tools and activities by uninstalling Crowdstrike Falcon
falsepositives: Administrator might leverage the same command line for debugging or other purposes. However this action must be always investigated
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%\\WindowsSensor.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /uninstall%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /quiet%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Uncommon Userinit Child Process
rules.author: Tom Ueltschi (@c_APT_ure), Tim Shelton
rules.description: Detects uncommon "userinit.exe" child processes, which could be a sign of uncommon shells or login scripts used for persistence.
falsepositives: Legitimate logon scripts or custom shells may trigger false positives. Apply additional filters accordingly.
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\userinit.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%:\\WINDOWS\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE(((CommandLine LIKE '%netlogon.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%UsrLogon.cmd%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine='PowerShell.exe' OR (Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\proquota.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\proquota.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\Citrix\\HDX\\bin\\cmstart.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\Citrix\\HDX\\bin\\icast.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\Citrix\\System32\\icast.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\Citrix\\HDX\\bin\\cmstart.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\Citrix\\HDX\\bin\\icast.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\Citrix\\System32\\icast.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR Image IS NULL), 0))

rules.title: Windows Credential Manager Access via VaultCmd
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: List credentials currently stored in Windows Credential Manager via the native Windows utility vaultcmd.exe
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\VaultCmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='VAULTCMD.EXE') AND CommandLine LIKE '%/listcreds:%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Verclsid.exe Runs COM Object
rules.author: Victor Sergeev, oscd.community
rules.description: Detects when verclsid.exe is used to run COM object via GUID
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\verclsid.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='verclsid.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/S%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/C%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\System32\\RuntimeBroker.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%verclsid.exe" /S /C {%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%} /I {%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious VBoxDrvInst.exe Parameters
rules.author: Konstantin Grishchenko, oscd.community
rules.description:
Detect VBoxDrvInst.exe run with parameters allowing processing INF file.
This allows to create values in the registry and install drivers.
For example one could use this technique to obtain persistence via modifying one of Run or RunOnce registry keys
falsepositives: Legitimate use of VBoxDrvInst.exe utility by VirtualBox Guest Additions installation process
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\VBoxDrvInst.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%driver%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%executeinf%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Persistence Via VMwareToolBoxCmd.EXE VM State Change Script
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of the "VMwareToolBoxCmd.exe" with the "script" and "set" flag to setup a specific script to run for a specific VM state
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\VMwareToolBoxCmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='toolbox-cmd.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% script %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% set %' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Persistence Via VMwareToolBoxCmd.EXE VM State Change Script
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of the "VMwareToolBoxCmd.exe" with the "script" and "set" flag to setup a specific script that's located in a potentially suspicious location to run for a specific VM state
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\VMwareToolBoxCmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='toolbox-cmd.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% script %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% set %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\PerfLogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: VMToolsd Suspicious Child Process
rules.author: bohops, Bhabesh Raj
rules.description: Detects suspicious child process creations of VMware Tools process which may indicate persistence setup
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\vmtoolsd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ((Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe' OR OriginalFileName='cscript.exe' OR OriginalFileName='MSHTA.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll' OR OriginalFileName='REGSVR32.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='wscript.exe'))) AND (NOT COALESCE(((Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\VMware\\VMware Tools\\poweron-vm-default.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\VMware\\VMware Tools\\poweroff-vm-default.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\VMware\\VMware Tools\\resume-vm-default.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\VMware\\VMware Tools\\suspend-vm-default.bat%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine='') OR (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine IS NULL)), 0))

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Child Process Of VsCode
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects uncommon or suspicious child processes spawning from a VsCode "code.exe" process. This could indicate an attempt of persistence via VsCode tasks or terminal profiles.
falsepositives: In development environment where VsCode is used heavily. False positives may occur when developers use task to compile or execute different types of code. Remove or add processes accordingly
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\code.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ((Image LIKE '%\\calc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR ((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-Expressions%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%IEX%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-Command%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ICM%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DownloadString%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%regsvr32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cscript%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (Image LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Visual Studio Code Tunnel Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), citron_ninja
rules.description: Detects Visual Studio Code tunnel execution. Attackers can abuse this functionality to establish a C2 channel
falsepositives: Legitimate use of Visual Studio Code tunnel
rules.sql: (OriginalFileName IS NULL AND CommandLine LIKE '%.exe tunnel' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.exe tunnel%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--accept-server-license-terms%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentCommandLine LIKE '% tunnel' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/d /c %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\servers\\Stable-%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%code-server.cmd%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Visual Studio Code Tunnel Shell Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the execution of a shell (powershell, bash, wsl...) via Visual Studio Code tunnel. Attackers can abuse this functionality to establish a C2 channel and execute arbitrary commands on the system.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of Visual Studio Code tunnel and running code from there
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\servers\\Stable-%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentImage LIKE '%\\server\\node.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%.vscode-server%' ESCAPE '\') AND (((Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\terminal\\browser\\media\\shellIntegration.ps1%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\wsl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Renamed Visual Studio Code Tunnel Execution
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects renamed Visual Studio Code tunnel execution. Attackers can abuse this functionality to establish a C2 channel
rules.sql: (((OriginalFileName IS NULL AND CommandLine LIKE '%.exe tunnel' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.exe tunnel%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--accept-server-license-terms%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%tunnel %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%service%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%internal-run%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%tunnel-service.log%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\code-tunnel.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\code.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))) OR ((ParentCommandLine LIKE '% tunnel' ESCAPE '\' AND Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/d /c %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\servers\\Stable-%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%code-server.cmd%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE '%\\code-tunnel.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\code.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))

rules.title: Visual Studio Code Tunnel Service Installation
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects the installation of VsCode tunnel (code-tunnel) as a service.
falsepositives: Legitimate installation of code-tunnel as a service
rules.sql: CommandLine LIKE '%tunnel %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%service%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%internal-run%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%tunnel-service.log%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Potential Binary Proxy Execution Via VSDiagnostics.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "VSDiagnostics.exe" with the "start" command in order to launch and proxy arbitrary binaries.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage for tracing and diagnostics purposes
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\VSDiagnostics.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='VSDiagnostics.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%start%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /launch:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -launch:%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Suspicious Vsls-Agent Command With AgentExtensionPath Load
rules.author: bohops
rules.description: Detects Microsoft Visual Studio vsls-agent.exe lolbin execution with a suspicious library load using the --agentExtensionPath parameter
falsepositives: False positives depend on custom use of vsls-agent.exe
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\vsls-agent.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--agentExtensionPath%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%Microsoft.VisualStudio.LiveShare.Agent.%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Use of W32tm as Timer
rules.author: frack113
rules.description: When configured with suitable command line arguments, w32tm can act as a delay mechanism
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\w32tm.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='w32time.dll') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/stripchart%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/computer:%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/period:%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/dataonly%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/samples:%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Wab Execution From Non Default Location
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of wab.exe (Windows Contacts) and Wabmig.exe (Microsoft Address Book Import Tool) from non default locations as seen with bumblebee activity
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\wab.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wabmig.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Windows Mail\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Windows Mail\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Wab/Wabmig Unusual Parent Or Child Processes
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects unusual parent or children of the wab.exe (Windows Contacts) and Wabmig.exe (Microsoft Address Book Import Tool) processes as seen being used with bumblebee activity
rules.sql: ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\WmiPrvSE.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\dllhost.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (Image LIKE '%\\wab.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wabmig.exe' ESCAPE '\')) OR (ParentImage LIKE '%\\wab.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\wabmig.exe' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: All Backups Deleted Via Wbadmin.EXE
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects the deletion of all backups or system state backups via "wbadmin.exe".
This technique is used by numerous ransomware families and actors.
This may only be successful on server platforms that have Windows Backup enabled.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\wbadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='WBADMIN.EXE') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%delete%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%backup%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%keepVersions:0%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Windows Backup Deleted Via Wbadmin.EXE
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description:
Detects the deletion of backups or system state backups via "wbadmin.exe".
This technique is used by numerous ransomware families and actors.
This may only be successful on server platforms that have Windows Backup enabled.
falsepositives: Legitimate backup activity from administration scripts and software.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\wbadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='WBADMIN.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%delete %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%backup%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%keepVersions:0%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Sensitive File Dump Via Wbadmin.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113
rules.description:
Detects the dump of highly sensitive files such as "NTDS.DIT" and "SECURITY" hive.
Attackers can leverage the "wbadmin" utility in order to dump sensitive files that might contain credential or sensitive information.
falsepositives: Legitimate backup operation by authorized administrators. Matches must be investigated and allowed on a case by case basis.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\wbadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='WBADMIN.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%start%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%backup%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\SAM%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\SECURITY%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\SYSTEM%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\NTDS\\NTDS.dit%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: File Recovery From Backup Via Wbadmin.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113
rules.description:
Detects the recovery of files from backups via "wbadmin.exe".
Attackers can restore sensitive files such as NTDS.DIT or Registry Hives from backups in order to potentially extract credentials.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\wbadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='WBADMIN.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% recovery%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%recoveryTarget%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%itemtype:File%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Sensitive File Recovery From Backup Via Wbadmin.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113
rules.description:
Detects the dump of highly sensitive files such as "NTDS.DIT" and "SECURITY" hive.
Attackers can leverage the "wbadmin" utility in order to dump sensitive files that might contain credential or sensitive information.
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\wbadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='WBADMIN.EXE') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% recovery%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%recoveryTarget%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%itemtype:File%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\SAM%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\SECURITY%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\SYSTEM%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\NTDS\\NTDS.dit%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious WebDAV LNK Execution
rules.author: Micah Babinski
rules.description: Detects possible execution via LNK file accessed on a WebDAV server.
rules.sql: ParentImage LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\DavWWWRoot\\%' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Chopper Webshell Process Pattern
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), MSTI (query)
rules.description: Detects patterns found in process executions cause by China Chopper like tiny (ASPX) webshells
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\w3wp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\w3wp.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%&ipconfig&echo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%&quser&echo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%&whoami&echo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%&c:&echo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%&cd&echo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%&dir&echo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%&echo [E]%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%&echo [S]%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Webshell Hacking Activity Patterns
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects certain parent child patterns found in cases in which a web shell is used to perform certain credential dumping or exfiltration activities on a compromised system
rules.sql: ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\caddy.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\httpd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\nginx.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\php-cgi.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\w3wp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\ws\_tomcatservice.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\java.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\javaw.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (ParentImage LIKE '%-tomcat-%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\tomcat%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\java.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\javaw.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%catalina.jar%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%CATALINA\_HOME%' ESCAPE '\'))) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%comsvcs%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -hp%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% a %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -m%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%net%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% user %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /add%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%net%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% localgroup %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% administrators %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/add%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Image LIKE '%\\ntdsutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\ldifde.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\adfind.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\procdump.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\Nanodump.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\vssadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\fsutil.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -decode %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -NoP %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -W Hidden %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /decode %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /ticket:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% sekurlsa%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dmp full%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.downloadfile(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.downloadstring(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%process call create%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%reg save %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%whoami /priv%' ESCAPE '\'))

rules.title: Webshell Detection With Command Line Keywords
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, Anton Kutepov, oscd.community, Chad Hudson, Matt Anderson
rules.description: Detects certain command line parameters often used during reconnaissance activity via web shells
rules.sql: ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\w3wp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\php-cgi.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\nginx.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\httpd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR rules.author: Thomas Patzke, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Zach Stanford @svch0st, Tim Shelton, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\qprocess.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\query.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE rules.title: Webshell Tool Reconnaissance Activity
rules.author: Cian Heasley, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects processes spawned from web servers (PHP, Tomcat, IIS, etc.) that perform reconnaissance looking for the existence of popular scripting tools (perl, python, wget) on the system via the help commands
rules.sql: ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\caddy.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\httpd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\nginx.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\php-cgi.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\w3wp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\ws\_tomcatservice.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\java.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\javaw.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (ParentImage LIKE '%-tomcat-%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\tomcat%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((ParentImage LIKE '%\\java.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentImage LIKE '%\\javaw.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%CATALINA\_HOME%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%catalina.jar%' ESCAPE '\'))) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%perl --help%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%perl -h%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%python --help%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%python -h%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%python3 --help%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%python3 -h%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wget --help%' ESCAPE '\')

rules.title: Potential Credential Dumping Via WER
rules.author: @pbssubhash , Nasreddine Bencherchali
rules.description: Detects potential credential dumping via Windows Error Reporting LSASS Shtinkering technique which uses the Windows Error Reporting to dump lsass
falsepositives: Windows Error Reporting might produce similar behavior. In that case, check the PID associated with the "-p" parameter in the CommandLine.
rules.sql: ((Image LIKE '%\\Werfault.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='WerFault.exe') AND ((ParentUser LIKE '%AUTHORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentUser LIKE '%AUTORI%' ESCAPE '\') AND (User LIKE '%AUTHORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%AUTORI%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -u -p %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -ip %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -s %' ESCAPE '\'))) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentImage LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\lsass.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Potential ReflectDebugger Content Execution Via WerFault.EXE
rules.author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects execution of "WerFault.exe" with the "-pr" commandline flag that is used to run files stored in the ReflectDebugger key which could be used to store the path to the malware in order to masquerade the execution flow
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\WerFault.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='WerFault.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '% -pr %' ESCAPE '\'

rules.title: Suspicious Child Process Of Wermgr.EXE
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious Windows Error Reporting manager (wermgr.exe) child process
rules.sql: (ParentImage LIKE '%\\wermgr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\ipconfig.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\netstat.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\nslookup.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\systeminfo.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\whoami.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\system32\\WerConCpl.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%LaunchErcApp %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-queuereporting%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-responsepester%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious Execution Location Of Wermgr.EXE
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects suspicious Windows Error Reporting manager (wermgr.exe) execution location.
rules.sql: Image LIKE '%\\wermgr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))

rules.title: Suspicious File Download From IP Via Wget.EXE
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
rules.description: Detects potentially suspicious file downloads directly from IP addresses using Wget.exe
rules.sql: (Image LIKE '%\\wget.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wget.exe') AND CommandLine REGEXP '://[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}' AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine REGEXP '\s-O\s' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--output-document%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.ps1' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ps1''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ps1"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dat' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dat''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dat"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.msi' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.msi''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.msi"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bat' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bat''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bat"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbe' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbe''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbe"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.hta' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.hta''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.hta"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.psm1' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.psm1''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.psm1"' ESCAPE '\')
